articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Priyanshi Yadav as Doree Thakur: Manasi and Anand's daughter; Ganga's adopted daughter; Neetu's step-daughter; Parvati's half-sister; Maan's wife; Shubhi's aunt and adoptive mother (2025) ** Mahi Bhanushali as Child Doree Thakur (2023-2024; 2025) * Amar Upadhyay as Ganga "Agni" Thakur: Mahendra and Kailashi's son; Rukmani's stepson; Yash, Anand and Raj's half-brother; Manasi's widower; Doree's adoptive father; Shubhi's adoptive grandfather (2023–2024; 2025) * Sudha Chandran as ** Rukmani Thakur / Fake Kailashi Thakur: Kailashi's twin sister; Mahendra's second wife; Yash, Anand, Raj and Maya's mother; Ganga's stepmother; Doree and Parvati's grandmother; Vansh's adoptive grandmother (2023–2024; 2025) ** Kailashi Thakur: Rukmani's twin sister; Mahendra's first wife; Ganga's mother; Yash, Anand and Raj's stepmother; Doree and Parvati's step-grandmother (2024) * Ishaan Dhawan as Advocate Maan Thakur: Meera and Surendra's son; Rajnandini and Deep's cousin; Doree's husband; Shubi's uncle and adoptive father (2025) * Sreejita De as Rajnandini Thakur: Ambika and Vijendra's daughter; Deep's sister; Maan's cousin; Pratham's mother; Neelu's murderer (2025) (Dead)

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Due to decrease in TRP, the show is scheduled to last aired on 26 June 2024. But however it is also planned to bring up the second season showcasing a new grown up Doree and her challenges against women empowerment.
In January 2025, the promo of Doree 2 was shown wherein Priyanshi Yadav is now playing the character of elder Doree which will eventually begin from 21 January 2025.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Karan Vohra were approached for the lead role, but Ishaan Dhawan was finalized for the role of Maan. Sreejita De was roped as Rajnandini Thakur, the main female antagonist. In the second season, Soni Singh who played Neelu in the first season reprise her role. Upadhyay also reprise him role, Ganga in second season. In February 2025, Upadhyay who known playing Ganga quit the show.

episodesList.title: Ganga Saves Doree
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi's son condemns her infant daughter, Doree. Ganga Prasad rescues her, seeking a safe haven. Will he find one?

episodesList.title: Doree Runs Into Trouble
episodesList.summary: Doree sneaks out of the house to go to the temple. Later, she gets into an argument with Kailashi Devi and ends up angering her. What consequences will this altercation bring?

episodesList.title: Doree-Vansh In a Race!
episodesList.summary: Doree races Vansh for money to help her father. Meanwhile, Ganga Prasad lies injured on the road. Will anyone find him?

episodesList.title: Doree Loses Her Home
episodesList.summary: Ganga is found injured and unconscious. Her mother blames Doree and throws her out. Where will Doree go?

episodesList.title: Mansi Bumps Into Doree
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi throws a baby shower for her second daughter-in-law. Mansi, at the temple, encounters Doree in need. Can she recognize her long-lost daughter?

episodesList.title: Doree Reaches Kailashi Devi's House
episodesList.summary: Doree's bracelet is lost in Mansi's pooja plate.  Following Mansi home, Doree finds Kailashi Devi. Will she get her bracelet back?

episodesList.title: Mansi Consoles Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree's unexpected arrival stuns Kailashi Devi's family. What will happen when they discover her secret?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Questions Doree
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi demands Doree's eviction, but Mansi steps in to protect her. Anand is tasked with discarding Doree. Can Mansi save her?

episodesList.title: Ganga Begs For Doree's Life
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad finds Doree near the garbage dump, unresponsive. Mansi guides him, and he desperately prays for her life. Will Doree recover?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Becomes Furious
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad's refusal leaves Anand in a bind. Kailashi Devi's fury demands action. Can Anand change Ganga Prasad's mind?

episodesList.title: Anand Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Doree's complaint against Anand leads to his arrest. His workers plead with Doree to withdraw it, fearing for their jobs. Will she relent?

episodesList.title: Anand Vows Revenge
episodesList.summary: Anand resolves to take revenge against Doree and Ganga Prasad for getting him arrested. However, Kailashi Devi advises him to spare them. Will he pay heed to her words?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Strikes The Deal!
episodesList.summary: Doree demands jobs for her community in exchange for Ganga Prasad's service. Humiliated, Kailashi Devi agrees. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Mansi is Taken Aback
episodesList.summary: Doree sells sarees at Kailashi Devi's showroom, while Mansi grapples with a shocking truth: Dai Maa didn't kill her firstborn.  What secrets are hidden?

episodesList.title: A New Obstacle For Ganga
episodesList.summary: Ganga and Doree's new Banarasi saree venture takes flight with Kailashi Devi's supplies. But Ganga is shaken by Mansi's desperate search for her missing daughter.

episodesList.title: Ganga Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Mansi's desperate prayer for her lost daughter intertwines with Ganga Prasad's unwavering commitment to Doree. Fate holds unforeseen twists for them both.

episodesList.title: Ganga Gets Robbed
episodesList.summary: Doree's family is drugged and robbed. Ganga discovers the theft and his missing wife. Can he find her before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Mansi Sees The Bracelet
episodesList.summary: Neelu pawns Doree's stolen bracelet. Mansi, recognizing it, sets out to find the seller. Will their paths collide?

episodesList.title: Mansi is Thrown Out!
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi throws her daughter, Mansi, out of the house for taking birth control pills. Will Anand intervene?

episodesList.title: Neelu Plans to Ruin The Event
episodesList.summary: Neelu plots to ruin Ganga's prized Banarasi saree at Kailashi Devi's event. But Doree catches her red-handed! Will Neelu escape the consequences?

episodesList.title: Doree's Shocking Revelation!
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi claims credit for the Banarasi saree, but Doree escapes and exposes the truth: Ganga Prasad is the real weaver. Will Kailashi Devi face the consequences?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi's Vengeful Pledge
episodesList.summary: Doree's confession haunts her, but Ganga Prasad offers comfort. Kailashi Devi's vengeful plot threatens their peace. Will they survive her wrath?

episodesList.title: Doree's Quest to Free Ganga
episodesList.summary: Doree desperately begs Neelu to free Ganga, offering anything in return. Neelu has a price: a dangerous challenge.

episodesList.title: Doree Reunites With Ganga
episodesList.summary: Kailashi and Vansh exploit Doree's vulnerability. Neelu discovers Doree is Mansi's daughter, sparking a cunning plan.

episodesList.title: Mansi is Devastated
episodesList.summary: Mansi meets with Neelu, when the latter reveals that she has some information of her long-lost daughter. But Mansi is devastated when Neelu lies to her that her daughter is dead.

episodesList.title: Ganga Offers to Help Komal
episodesList.summary: Komal's clumsy spy mission turns into a scary fall.  Fearing a miscarriage, Mansi and Komal face a difficult decision: accept Ganga's help?

episodesList.title: Mansi Becomes Concerned
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi prays for a baby boy for Komal. But Komal gives birth to a girl, leaving Mansi worried. Will Kailashi Devi accept this change?

episodesList.title: Doree Prays For The Baby
episodesList.summary: Komal's newborn son struggles to breathe. As the doctor fights to save him, Doree's prayer and a holy thread offer a glimmer of hope. Will the miracle happen?

episodesList.title: Anand's Plan Dangerously Backfires
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi's granddaughter is stolen, but the police intervene. Anand plots to harm Doree, but Vansh is caught in the crossfire. Can he survive?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Gets Concerned!
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi seeks astrological guidance to end her family's turmoil. But with more obstacles predicted, will she find a way to prevent them?

episodesList.title: Mansi Dolls Up Doree
episodesList.summary: Mansi, believing Doree is dressed as Choti Maa Durga, presents her to Kailashi Devi for a special occasion. Meanwhile, Neelu and Anand plot a scheme.

episodesList.title: Anand's Nefarious Plan!
episodesList.summary: Doree, disguised as Choti Maa Durga, witnesses a ceremony orchestrated by Mansi. Neelu and Anand, seeking to hide their crime, burn down Doree's house. Will they be exposed?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Feels Apprehensive
episodesList.summary: Anand and Neelu's arson plan against Ganga Prasad's house succeeds.  Kailashi Devi, realizing her sarees were stored there, faces a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Anand to Get Caught?
episodesList.summary: The police confront Anand about his involvement in setting fire to Ganga Prasad's house after discovering his lighter at the crime scene. Will Anand confess his crime?

episodesList.title: Anand Seeks Revenge
episodesList.summary: Seeking refuge, Ganga Prasad and his family accept Anand's father's offer of shelter. But Anand has a sinister plan: to eliminate them in their sleep.

episodesList.title: Doree-ganga At Thakur Mansion
episodesList.summary: Doree, Ganga, and his mother seek refuge in the Thakur mansion. Mansi's welcome contrasts with Kailashi Devi's strict rules. Can they find belonging?

episodesList.title: Doree Takes Care Of The Baby
episodesList.summary: Doree disobeys Kailashi Devi, taking care of her unsupervised granddaughter and even sitting on her throne. Will she be caught?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Forgives Doree
episodesList.summary: Anand condemns Doree's actions and seeks to punish Ganga.  Doree begs Kailashi for forgiveness, and surprisingly, Kailashi grants her plea. Why?

episodesList.title: Ganga Incurs a Penalty
episodesList.summary: Kailashi blames Ganga for a torn saree and demands payment. Doree, loyal to Ganga, seeks the truth behind the damage. Can she uncover the secret?

episodesList.title: Anand Feels Apprehensive
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi welcomes Purohitji for rituals, but Anand worries. Purohitji senses a girl's birth, leaving Anand in a tricky situation.

episodesList.title: Doree Proves Ganga's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Doree exposes Vansh's lie, clearing Ganga of sabotage charges. Will Kailashi Devi seek justice for the wronged?

episodesList.title: Anand Confronts Mansi
episodesList.summary: Mansi, consumed by grief for her lost daughter, seeks solace in Doree's dress. Anand discovers her in Ganga Prasad's room, leading to a tense confrontation. What will Mansi do?

episodesList.title: Ganga Faces a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Anand's doubts shatter Mansi, while Kailashi Devi's strict training for Doree puts Ganga Prasad in a tough spot. Can he navigate this crisis?

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Receives Dreadful News
episodesList.summary: A brain clot throws Ganga Prasad's life into turmoil. The doctor's ultimatum: surgery, but time is running out. Can he raise the funds?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Assigns Work
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi burdens Doree with a grueling task: filling pots, chopping vegetables, and making 50 rotis. Can Doree overcome her every mistake and complete this arduous chore?

episodesList.title: Doree's Life In Jeopardy
episodesList.summary: Doree, injured and desperate, begs Kailashi Devi for help. But a mysterious woman seeks to silence her, leaving Doree unconscious and trapped. Can she escape?

episodesList.title: Doree Finds Her Bracelet
episodesList.summary: Ganga's panic escalates when Doree disappears. Her escape and reunion with her father reveal a missing bracelet, leaving Ganga and Kailashi Devi in shock.

episodesList.title: Doree vs The Thakurs!
episodesList.summary: Doree's connection to the Thakurs is questioned by Kailashi Devi.  Manasi's discovery of Doree's truth leads to an accident. Is Doree truly related?

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Becomes Furious
episodesList.summary: Sent to Surat to boost saree production, Ganga Prasad discovers Kailashi Devi's cruelty. Will he expose her?

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: Mansi's heart aches as she discovers Doree is her daughter, while Ganga Prasad vows to stay by her side. What lies ahead for Doree?

episodesList.title: A Massive Eye-opener For Ganga!
episodesList.summary: Mansi's life crumbles without her daughter. Daai Maa reveals Doree's true parentage, placing her in Ganga Prasad's protective care. Can he shield her from the Thakurs' wrath?

episodesList.title: Doree to Save Ganga's Life?
episodesList.summary: Doree grows anxious about Ganga Prasad's deteriorating health. Afterwards, she resolves to safeguard her father's life and raise funds for his medical treatment. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Doree's Life is In Danger!
episodesList.summary: In a desperate attempt to save her ailing father, Doree takes part in Naga Nathaiya. Unfortunately, she falls victim to a venomous snake's fang. Will she survive the ordeal?

episodesList.title: Anand's Heinous Act
episodesList.summary: Doree survives a snake bite.  Anand buries Ganga Prasad alive in a coffin. Can Ganga escape his deadly trap?

episodesList.title: Ganga's Life is In Danger!
episodesList.summary: Komal stumbles upon Kailashi Devi's secret trap door in the library. Meanwhile, Ganga Prasad escapes his confinement but meets with an accident. Will he survive?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi does The Unimaginable
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi's shocking revelation about Ganga Prasad's connection to Mahendra Thakur shatters his world. To protect a dark secret, she takes his life. Can she evade justice?

episodesList.title: Mansi is In a Tight Spot!
episodesList.summary: Doree's obliviousness to Ganga Prasad's death chills Mansi. Will she confront the tragedy, or remain unaware?

episodesList.title: The Past Of Ganga Prasad
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad's life takes a shocking turn as his mother reveals a startling truth: he was given to her by a stranger. How will his family cope with this revelation?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Silences Mahendra!
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi's sinister plan to silence Mahendra Thakur succeeds. Ganga Prasad is gone, and Doree faces an uncertain future.

episodesList.title: Doree Fails to Comprehend
episodesList.summary: Doree refuses to let go of Ganga Prasad, blocking his funeral. Kailashi Devi, hiding at the crime scene, learns the police are claiming the body. What will she do?

episodesList.title: Doree's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Doree mourns Ganga Prasad's passing, haunted by their past. Meanwhile, Kailashi Devi faces suspicion from the inspector. Can she escape the consequences?

episodesList.title: Doree Misses Ganga Prasad
episodesList.summary: Doree can't accept her father's death. A fake saint exploits her grief, trapping her in a dangerous situation.

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Tricks Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree's pursuit of the Pandit leads to peril. Kailashi Devi, feigning concern, steps in to rescue her - but her motives are far from pure. Will she steal the bracelet?

episodesList.title: Doree Takes a Stand!
episodesList.summary: Ganga's death is overshadowed by Kailashi Devi's accusation of theft. Doree, convinced of her father's innocence, must fight for his reputation.

episodesList.title: Doree Pleads With Her Grandmother
episodesList.summary: Doree witnesses her grandmother's suicide attempt and begs her to stop, but her grandmother refuses, claiming disrespect. Can Doree prevent her?

episodesList.title: Neelu's Wicked Plan
episodesList.summary: Sarla, heeding Neelu's advice, sends Doree away as a maid, secretly planning to exploit her.  Can Doree escape her grim fate?

episodesList.title: Mansi Grows Worried
episodesList.summary: Doree is manipulated into begging for a cruel businesswoman.  Mansi, worried for Doree's safety, vows to help. Can she save her friend?

episodesList.title: Neelu Murders Mansi!
episodesList.summary: Rani's violent threat to Doree clashes with Neelu's confession of Mansi's murder to secure Anand. How will Anand react to this shocking revelation?

episodesList.title: Mansi's Brave Move!
episodesList.summary: Mansi, wounded but resolute, fights to free Doree from Rani's clutches.  Collapsing from her injuries, Mansi's fate hangs in the balance. Can Doree save her?

episodesList.title: Doree Saves Mansi
episodesList.summary: Doree stays by Mansi and a mysterious woman connected to Kailashi Devi in the past helps Mansi. Further, Doree takes a unconscious Mansi home. Will Kailashi Devi see Doree there?

episodesList.title: Will Doree Discover The Truth?
episodesList.summary: Kailashi questions Anand about Mansi's health, but he accuses her of deception. Mahendra tries to reveal the truth about Ganga to Doree. Will she believe him?

episodesList.title: Mansi Confronts Anand
episodesList.summary: Mansi is horrified to discover Anand's plan to kill her. She confronts him, denouncing his evil intentions. How will Anand react?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Plans to Kill Doree!
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi kidnaps Doree, revealing her role in Ganga Prasad's death.  To protect her secret, Kailashi plans to kill Doree. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi has a Twin?
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi's captive, Doree, has escaped. But a mysterious lookalike cares for Doree, cursing the real Kailashi Devi. Who is this woman?

episodesList.title: Doree Gains Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Doree awakens to a shocking truth - the mysterious woman is the real Kailashi Devi, Mahendra Thakur's hidden wife. What horrors await?

episodesList.title: Mansi Lies to The Police
episodesList.summary: Anand accuses Doree of attacking Mansi, presenting the wounded woman to the police. Doree denies it, but is arrested. Will Mansi reveal the truth?

episodesList.title: Doree Gets Threatened
episodesList.summary: Doree's refusal risks deadly consequences, as Kailashi Devi threatens the lives of her closest ones for not going to rehab. What challenges await Doree in her future?

episodesList.title: Yash Makes a Comeback!
episodesList.summary: Yash blames Kailashi Devi for Ganga Prasad's death, leaving Mahendra Thakur in a dire state.  He inherits the Thakur family's burden. Will Kailashi Devi support him?

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Kailashi Devi
episodesList.summary: Mansi's prayers are answered, Doree awakens, but Kailashi Devi's composure crumbles when Chandni calls her Rukmini. What secret does this name hold?

episodesList.title: Doree Reaches a Wrong Place
episodesList.summary: Wilderness-lost Doree finds unlikely aid in a prostitute. Their sanctuary turns deadly when Neelu abducts Vansh and Ansh for trafficking. Will they be saved?

episodesList.title: Doree Makes an Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: Doree plans a daring escape, rescuing the other children from Chandni. She almost makes it, but gets caught. Can she save herself now?

episodesList.title: Kailashi's Shocking Transformation
episodesList.summary: Chandni's ultimatum forces Kailashi to embrace her past. Meanwhile, Doree finds Ansh in a locked room and races to save Vansh from danger.

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Hides From Mansi
episodesList.summary: Vansh and Ansh are safe, but the hunt for Doree continues. Mansi and the inspector confront Chandni, alerting Kailashi Devi. Will Mansi expose their secret pact?

episodesList.title: A Mysterious Man Saves Doree
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi hides her true purpose, claiming to be at Chandni's. Meanwhile, a mysterious savior rescues Doree from Hira, leaving her questioning his identity.

episodesList.title: Kailashi Devi Feels Anxious
episodesList.summary: Yash pushes Kailashi Devi away from Mahendra, fearing it hinders his recovery. Meanwhile, Kailashi Devi and Anand plot against Doree, who is alive. What dangers await Doree?

episodesList.title: Doree Seeks Justice
episodesList.summary: Doree defies fear, leading her community to seek justice for Ganga Prasad. Accusing Kailashi Devi of murder, will she face consequences?

episodesList.title: Mansi Tells The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mansi clears Doree, revealing he saved her life. Kailashi Devi, arrested for Ganga Prasad's murder, faces justice.

episodesList.title: Mansi Struggles to Save Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree vows to punish Kailashi Devi for Ganga Prasad's murder. Elsewhere, Mansi struggles to prevent Anand's vengeful pursuit against Doree. Will Mansi be able to save Doree's life?

episodesList.title: Neelu Brainwashes Anand
episodesList.summary: Neelu's sinister plot to inherit the Thakur's kingdom involves manipulating Anand to murder Kailashi Devi. The shocking truth awaits the police inspector.

episodesList.title: Doree Seeks Help
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi, rumoured dead, shocks the Thakur Brothers with her survival. Doree seeks her aid to avenge her father's murder. Will justice be served?

episodesList.title: Neelu Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Doree finds a powerful ally in a mysterious woman, who agrees to testify against Kailashi Devi. But Neelu, seeking forgiveness, reveals the evidence, jeopardizing Doree's case.

episodesList.title: Doree In a Difficult Situation
episodesList.summary: Mansi warns Doree of Kailashi Devi's conspiracies. Doree rushes to save the witness, but finds her room ablaze. How will Doree fight for justice with the witness eliminated?

episodesList.title: Mai Testifies In Court
episodesList.summary: Mai's testimony against Kailashi Devi, accusing her of holding Doree captive, faces a shocking twist. Will Kailashi Devi's attempt to expose Mai's identity derail the case?

episodesList.title: Anand Cuts Ties With Mansi!
episodesList.summary: Anand revels in his court victory, mocking Mansi's despair. He cuts all ties, evicting her from their home. How will Mansi face this brutal betrayal?

episodesList.title: Kailashi Hatches a Plan
episodesList.summary: Kailashi, wronged by Rukmani, seeks revenge. But as Rukmani worries about Kailashi's fate, will she uncover the truth about her own actions?

episodesList.title: Rukmani Saves Ganga
episodesList.summary: Rukmani recalls the way she found Ganga Prasad alive on his deathbed and awaits to share the news with Doree. Meanwhile, Doree flees from Anand's clasp. Will she manage to escape?

episodesList.title: Ganga Rescues Mansi
episodesList.summary: Trapped by thugs, Mansi's hope fades. But Ganga Prasad bursts in, saving her. Will Mansi be relieved or surprised by his arrival?

episodesList.title: Rukmani Discovers The Truth
episodesList.summary: Rukmani's joy at finding her son Ganga Prasad turns to fear as Kailashi attacks her. Can she escape and tell Doree her father is alive?

episodesList.title: Mansi Makes a Comeback
episodesList.summary: Mansi arrives at the Thakur mansion, demanding respect for herself and her relationship with Anand.  But why has she brought Doree along?

episodesList.title: Doree Shadows Kailashi
episodesList.summary: Doree follows Kailashi into a secret passage, only to find Rukmani trapped inside. Can Doree free her?

episodesList.title: Mansi Hatches a Plan!
episodesList.summary: Mansi witnesses Kailashi using a secret passage. With Doree, she devises a plan to steal the keys and uncover its mystery. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Doree Attempts to Expose Rukmani
episodesList.summary: Doree's attempt to expose Rukmani's true identity as Kailashi fails.  Rukmani laughs at her defeat. Can Doree find proof to expose her?

episodesList.title: Nani Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Mansi endures Anand's abuse, while Doree fights media lies. Nani, heartbroken, chooses a tragic end with Doree. Is there no escape?

episodesList.title: A Tough Situation For Doree
episodesList.summary: Nani unknowingly eats poisoned Kheer, sharing it with Doree. As Nani falls ill, Doree senses the danger. Can she escape the poison's grip before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Doree Meets Ganga!
episodesList.summary: Ganga, amnesiac, saves Nani and Doree from poison. Rukmini worries for his safety while he denies his bond with Doree. Will his memory loss sever their connection?

episodesList.title: Ganga Loses Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Unconscious and amnesiac, Ganga is admitted to the hospital by Doree. Meanwhile, Rukmini is stunned to learn of his existence. What sinister plan does she have in store?

episodesList.title: Ganga Tries to Recall His Memories
episodesList.summary: Mansi is shocked to find Ganga Prasad alive. Meanwhile, Ganga struggles to remember her, seeing her at the hospital. Can he unlock the past?

episodesList.title: Ganga Snubs Mansi
episodesList.summary: Mansi tries to remind Ganga of his past with Doree, hoping to spark his memory. Ganga, however, insists he is Agni. Will he ever remember who he truly is?

episodesList.title: Doree is Determined
episodesList.summary: Kailashi Devi's fear unleashes a fierce attack on Ganga. Doree fights to awaken his memory, desperate to bring him home. Will their paths converge?

episodesList.title: Doree Discovers The Truth
episodesList.summary: Maya insists on accompanying Ganga when he agrees to return home with Doree. Meanwhile, Doree overhears Neelu confessing the truth to Anand. Will she confront them?

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Visits His Home
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad returns to his former home, where Doree awaits. Can the familiar surroundings reignite his lost memories?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Lays Down The Law
episodesList.summary: Rukmini holds Kailashi Devi captive, silencing Mahendra Thakur. Can he free Kailashi and expose Rukmini's crimes?

episodesList.title: Rukmini In a Fix
episodesList.summary: Mahendra Thakur's hidden son, the eldest of his children, is revealed. The Thakurs confront Rukmini, demanding answers.

episodesList.title: Anand Astonishes Ganga Prasad
episodesList.summary: Anand confronts Ganga Prasad, demanding Doree's debt be paid. Ganga Prasad's response is shocking: he disowns Doree. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Mansi Persuades Ganga
episodesList.summary: Komal plots against pregnant Sudha. Mansi convinces Ganga Prasad to return to Doree. Will he answer her prayers?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Comes Across Ganga!
episodesList.summary: Rukmini seeks holy water from the Ganga. Fatefully, Ganga Prasad arrives, drawn to Rukmini.  He follows her back to her mansion, a journey that will change both their lives.

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad's Life In Peril
episodesList.summary: Surrounded by serpents, Ganga Prasad's life hangs in the balance. Doree acts fast, attempting a daring rescue. Will her quick thinking save him?

episodesList.title: Rukmini is Taken Aback!
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad makes a shocking reappearance at the Thakurs' doorstep, leaving Rukmini reeling in disbelief. How will the rest of the Thakurs react to this shocking reappearance?

episodesList.title: Doree Retells The Story
episodesList.summary: Using sketches as prompts, Doree attempts to spark Ganga's memory by visually recounting their shared past. Will her efforts culminate in the retrieval of Ganga's lost memories?

episodesList.title: Nani Connects The Dots
episodesList.summary: Nani stumbles upon Ganga's infant garment and pieces together the link between the cloth and the Thakurs. Will she be able to uncover his connection to them?

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Murderous Plan
episodesList.summary: Rukmini's grand fashion show hides a deadly secret: Ganga Prasad is her target. Can he expose her sinister plan before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Doree Senses The Danger
episodesList.summary: Dadi reveals Ganga's family secret to Doree. As Rukmini plots Ganga's demise, Doree senses danger. Will she intervene in time?

episodesList.title: Doree to Save Ganga Prasad's Life?
episodesList.summary: Rukmini plots to kill Ganga Prasad with a bomb at the fashion show. Doree, fearing for his life, secretly enters the mansion to save him. Can she succeed?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Receives a Jolt
episodesList.summary: Rukmini is taken aback upon learning that Doree is aware of the truth regarding Ganga Prasad being Kailashi Devi's eldest child. How will she react to this revelation?

episodesList.title: Doree Makes a Tough Call
episodesList.summary: In an effort to ensure Ganga Prasad's safety, Doree opts to disassociate herself from him, asserting that he is not her true father. How will Ganga react to this?

episodesList.title: Anand's Sinister Scheme
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad prays for Rukmini's health, unaware of Anand's deadly intentions. Will Rukmini survive Anand's sinister plot?

episodesList.title: Anand is Caught Red-handed
episodesList.summary: Ganga catches Anand in the act of attempting to murder Rukmini. Subsequently, a physical fight erupts between them. Can Ganga stop Anand from killing Rukmini?

episodesList.title: Anand Confronts Mahendra
episodesList.summary: Anand confronts Mahendra, accusing him of concealing Ganga's true identity and neglecting his other sons. How will Mahendra react?

episodesList.title: Doree Ki Iccha
episodesList.summary: Anand learns the true heir is arriving, while Doree confronts Ganga about his marriage and demands he stop pretending to be Agni. Will Ganga listen?

episodesList.title: Ganga Returns to Thakur Mansion
episodesList.summary: Ganga returns home with his new wife, Neelu, shocking the Thakurs. A couple claims Doree as their lost daughter. Can she expose their lies?

episodesList.title: Doree Runs Away
episodesList.summary: Rukmini blames Anand, ignoring his pleas for help. Meanwhile, Doree is whisked away by a strange couple. Can they be found?

episodesList.title: Neelu Incites Rukmini's Anger
episodesList.summary: Neelu's ambition to join the Thakur family leads her to challenge Rukmini's authority. Will her defiance earn her a place or a punishment?

episodesList.title: Ganga Risks His Life
episodesList.summary: As the earthquake hits, Ganga Prasad rushes into the precarious building to help the trapped. Without second thoughts, Doree trails behind him. Will they make it out alive?

episodesList.title: Doree's Brave Act Saves Ganga
episodesList.summary: Doree heroically rescues Ganga Prasad from the crumbling building, but tragically gets trapped inside as it collapses. What ensued for Doree after the disaster?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Executes a Sinister Plot
episodesList.summary: Rukmini slips a potent hallucinogenic substance into Ganga's drink, intending to send him spiralling into a state of madness. How will Ganga's body respond to it after consumption?

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Plan Bears Fruit
episodesList.summary: Rukmini's drug unleashes Ganga Prasad's wild side, shocking his family. Will she exploit his altered state for her own gain?

episodesList.title: Doree Transforms Into a Boy
episodesList.summary: In order to save Ganga Prasad from harm's way, Doree transforms herself into a boy. Meanwhile, Rukmini conducts a pooja to ensure her plan is fruitful. Will Ganga survive?

episodesList.title: Neelu-mansi Get Into a Fight
episodesList.summary: Neelu's intentions are exposed, sparking a bitter argument with Mansi. Meanwhile, Doree's Bhola disguise faces its first test in the community. Will her secret be revealed?

episodesList.title: Doree Enters The Thakurs' House
episodesList.summary: Doree, now disguised as Bhola, sneaks into the Thakurs' residence to keep a close eye on Ganga Prasad. Will Ganga Prasad uncover Doree's true identity?

episodesList.title: Doree's Holi Celebration
episodesList.summary: Doree interrupts Rukmini's plans, coloring Manasi and Ganga. Invited to Holi, Doree introduces a game with an unknown motive.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Trembles In Fear
episodesList.summary: Rukmini drinks the Thandai and starts feeling intoxicated. Meanwhile, Doree awaits to lure out a confession from Rukmini as the latter trembles in fear. Will Doree succeed?

episodesList.title: Ganga Apologises to The People
episodesList.summary: Ganga issues a heartfelt apology to those who suffered discomfort after wearing the clothes distributed by the Thakurs. But will this be enough to mend fences?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Becomes Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Rukmini's precious sarees are mysteriously destroyed. Suspecting Ganga Prasad, she embarks on a quest for truth. Can she expose his hidden secrets?

episodesList.title: Anand Apologises to Mansi
episodesList.summary: Anand returns home dressed like a yogi, to everyone's surprise. However, Mansi refuses to fall for his act when he begs for forgiveness. How will he persuade her?

episodesList.title: Doree to Recreate The Scene
episodesList.summary: Doree relives her first meeting with Ganga, but Rukmini's trick leads to a local backlash. Can Ganga find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Doree In a Challenging Situation
episodesList.summary: Doree's plan to control Ganga backfires, leaving her facing blame for the weaver's ruined machines. Can she salvage the situation?

episodesList.title: Mansi Learns a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Mansi eavesdrops on the discussion between Neelu and Ganga Prasad, discovering that Neelu is pregnant with Anand's child. Will she address Neelu about this matter?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Receives Dreadful News
episodesList.summary: Rukmini faces double trouble: her grandson's illness and a looming threat to her family. Can she overcome both?

episodesList.title: Doree Guarantees Protection
episodesList.summary: Rukmini fears for her family's safety. Doree, sensing her distress, promises protection and asks to stay with them. Will Rukmini accept?

episodesList.title: Doree's Unconventional Commitment
episodesList.summary: Doree's devotion to Ganga compels her to embrace Rukmini's unorthodox methods, enduring the pain for her family. Will her sacrifice and unwavering commitment shape her destiny?

episodesList.title: Doree Catches an Infection
episodesList.summary: Despite the potential for infection, Doree tends to Ganga Prasad out of love, ultimately falling ill herself. How will Ganga Prasad react to this revelation?

episodesList.title: Doree Falls Sick
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad finds Bhola unconscious and ill. He admits him in the hospital and tends to his needs. Will he realise that Bhola is indeed Doree in disguise?

episodesList.title: Doree Makes a Recovery
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad regains spirit as Doree bounces back from her sickness, leading him to joyfully bring her home. Will this joyous return create tension with Rukmini?

episodesList.title: Doree Receives Parental Love
episodesList.summary: Doree's illness brings out Mansi and Ganga's love. But Rukmini's cruelty challenges Ganga. Can her actions inspire change?

episodesList.title: Doree Gets Trapped
episodesList.summary: Rukmini demands Ganga sacrifice a goat, trapping Doree in an icy salt pool to enforce it. Can Doree escape this chilling fate?

episodesList.title: Mansi Pleads With Ganga
episodesList.summary: Mansi exposes Rukmini's true plan to Ganga, urging him to change his mind. Meanwhile, Doree escapes her predicament and races to stop Ganga from a catastrophic act.

episodesList.title: Doree Stops The Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Determined to save the goat, Doree rushes in with its calf, halting Ganga Prasad's sacrifice ritual in its tracks. Could this unexpected intervention provoke Ganga's anger?

episodesList.title: Mahendra Threatens Rukmini
episodesList.summary: Mahendra Thakur presses Rukmini, threatening to strip away her guise before the family, unless she presents evidence that Kailashi Devi is alive. Will she yield to his ultimatum?

episodesList.title: Doree Gathers Evidence
episodesList.summary: Ganga's lost memories threaten Rukmini's secrets. Mansi uncovers the truth, but Doree's secret plan to expose Rukmini could change everything. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Doree Gathers Proof
episodesList.summary: Doree reveals her true identity to Ganga Prasad, presenting evidence against Rukmini. Mansi uses a retrieval system to help Ganga remember his past. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Steals The Evidence
episodesList.summary: Rukmini discovers Doree's secret plans. Neelu stumbles upon a shocking truth about Doree. Will she tell Rukmini?

episodesList.title: Mansi Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mansi elaborates to Ganga Prasad that Maya is not his biological sister. Further, she discloses that Maya and Neelu are scheming against him. Will Ganga trust her assertions?

episodesList.title: Neelu Fabricates Doree's Death
episodesList.summary: Neelu spins a web of deceit, presenting an unknown body as Doree's. Nani, who is certain that Doree is alive, sets out to expose Neelu's lie. Will Nani expose Neelu's deception?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Plans to Kill Doree
episodesList.summary: Rukmini, enraged by Doree's secret, plans her demise. Meanwhile, Mansi is shocked to learn Bhola is Doree, living under her roof. Can she save her before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Ganga Saves Kailashi Devi
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad rescues Kailashi Devi from her imprisonment and reunites with his mother. Meanwhile, Maya holds Rukmini hostage and compels Doree to kill her. Will she comply?

episodesList.title: Rukmini-anand's Cruel Act
episodesList.summary: Trapped inside a hollow idol, Doree faces her ultimate fate. Can she escape before it's submerged?

episodesList.title: Mansi Discovers a Lead
episodesList.summary: Rukmini deceives Ganga Prasad with a forged signature on property documents. Mansi, searching for Doree, finds her locket on the road. Will this clue lead her to Doree?

episodesList.title: Anand-neelu's Heinous Act!
episodesList.summary: Doree's fate hangs in the balance as Neelu and Anand encase her in a sack and throw her into the cremation ground. Will Doree be able to survive this grave danger?

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Rescues Doree
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad rescues Doree from a tragic fate, triggering his lost memories. He returns to Thakur Mansion, but hides his regained past. What is his secret plan?

episodesList.title: Ganga-doree Go Undercover
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad and Doree disguise themselves in order to rescue Mansi from her imprisonment. Meanwhile, Anand and Neelu catch Rukmini scheming against them. Will they confront her?

episodesList.title: Mansi Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: Mansi exposes Rukmani, a deceitful imposter posing as Kailashi Devi, to the family. The truth unravels, leaving the family reeling.

episodesList.title: Mansi Urges Ganga Prasad
episodesList.summary: Doree witnesses Rukmini's brutal act against Maya. As police approach, Mansi urges Ganga Prasad to flee with Doree. Will he heed her warning?

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Vows to Protect Doree
episodesList.summary: Mansi sacrifices herself for Maya, shielding Doree. Ganga Prasad rescues Doree from Rukmini's clutches, vowing to protect her. Will his efforts succeed?

episodesList.title: Ganga-doree Attempt to Escape
episodesList.summary: Anand and Neelu's desperate chase to save Ganga and Doree from Rukmini's clutches intensifies. Torture threatens Kailashi and Amma. Will they escape?

episodesList.title: Doree Manages to Flee
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad and Doree are ambushed by Anand and Neelu. Subsequently, Ganga throws himself into the fight, creating a window for Doree to flee. Will Ganga be able to escape too?

episodesList.title: Doree Falls Into a Pit
episodesList.summary: Trapped in the woods with eagles hot on her trail, Doree races through the trees only to stumble into a pit. Will she manage to break free and locate her way back to safety?

episodesList.title: Ganga's Earnest Prayer
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad becomes anxious over Doree's disappearance. Subsequently, he fervently beseeches God for assistance in locating her. Will his heartfelt plea be heard?

episodesList.title: Ganga Receives Good News!
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad races to the hospital, desperate for news of Doree after her accident. His reaction upon seeing her will be the defining moment.

episodesList.title: Pressure Mounts On Anand
episodesList.summary: Veerender forces Anand to reconcile with his sister, Mansi, threatening to cripple the Thakurs' business if he refuses. Will they succumb to his demands?

episodesList.title: Doree In a Tight Spot!
episodesList.summary: Flora's scheme to cheat a child backfires when Doree intervenes. Seeking revenge, Flora frames Doree for theft. Can Doree clear her name?

episodesList.title: Ganga Apprehends Flora's Intent
episodesList.summary: Ganga stops Komal from harshly punishing Doree, urging her to check CCTV footage.  Flora's fake unconsciousness is exposed by Ganga. Will Flora apologize?

episodesList.title: Flora Exudes Arrogance
episodesList.summary: Flora, spoiled and demanding, rejects Ganga Prasad's gift and Doree's kindness. Will Doree's patience wear thin?

episodesList.title: Ganga Lashes Out At Pavitra
episodesList.summary: Pavitra's return ignites Ganga Prasad's fury. Accusing her of disrupting his life, he unleashes a torrent of anger and pain. Will Pavitra face his wrath?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Receives Shocking News
episodesList.summary: Flora's party spirals into chaos, shattering Ganga's family. Anand's bombshell: Doree owns everything! Rukmini's world crumbles. What's her next move?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Bribes Pavitra
episodesList.summary: Rukmini manipulates Flora to distract Ganga Prasad from Doree, who stirs trouble by questioning Mansi's engagement to Anand. Will her plan work?

episodesList.title: Mansi's Secret and Sacred Vow!
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad and Doree try to convince Mansi to leave Anand, but she hides her true feelings, keeping her promise to her brother.

episodesList.title: Pavitra Implores Ganga Prasad
episodesList.summary: Mansi's remarriage protects Doree and Ganga Prasad, but Pavitra's shocking secret about Flora's origins threatens their safety. Will Ganga Prasad accept the truth?

episodesList.title: Pavitra Blames Doree
episodesList.summary: Flora's world shatters as she learns Ganga Prasad is her father. Pavitra blames Doree for their separation, putting her in a difficult position.

episodesList.title: Ganga Prasad Becomes Anxious
episodesList.summary: Mansi regrets her choice, while Ganga worries as Pavitra takes Flora to the roof. Will he stop their suicide attempt?

episodesList.title: A Tough Situation For Ganga Prasad
episodesList.summary: Flora's heart disease throws Ganga Prasad into turmoil. Pavitra pleads for him to accept her as his daughter. Will love conquer his reservations?

episodesList.title: Will Ganga Lose Doree's Custody?
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad faces a heartbreaking dilemma: child services threaten to take Doree away unless he formally adopts her.  Will he be separated from his daughter?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Carries Out Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Rukmini plots to kill Doree with Flora's help. Ganga Prasad, worried for Doree's safety, waits for her at his home. Will he uncover the scheme before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Mansi Confronts Ganga
episodesList.summary: Mansi rescues Doree and accuses Ganga Prasad of neglecting her upon his family's return, revealing his abandonment. How will he respond to her allegations?

episodesList.title: Flora Becomes Furious
episodesList.summary: Pavitra unites Doree with Ganga Prasad through adoption, but Flora's anger threatens Doree's new family. Will Doree survive her stepmother's wrath?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Manipulates Doree
episodesList.summary: Rukmini, disguised as Kailashi Devi, plots to separate Doree and Ganga Prasad for Flora's happiness. Will Ganga's adoption plans expose her scheme?

episodesList.title: Doree Feels Left Out!
episodesList.summary: Doree's left out of the Mother's Day competition, feeling downcast. Ganga Prasad steps in to try and cheer her up. Can he succeed?

episodesList.title: Ganga's Heartfelt Speech
episodesList.summary: Stepping onto the stage, Ganga Prasad opens up about his heartfelt efforts to bridge the maternal gap for Doree. How will Doree react to Ganga's speech?

episodesList.title: Ganga Faces False Allegations
episodesList.summary: Ganga faces accusations of mistreating Doree, jeopardizing his custody.  Doree fights back, determined to prove his innocence. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Hope Dawns On Ganga!
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad's hope for Doree's custody hinges on proving his parenting skills. What plan will he devise to win her over?

episodesList.title: Pavitra Executes Rukmini's Plan
episodesList.summary: Rukmini orders Pavitra to drug Doree's dessert before a crucial exam.  Will Doree's admission chances be sabotaged?

episodesList.title: Doree Saves Rukmini's Life
episodesList.summary: Doree's heroic CPR saves Rukmini's life, earning her admission to the school. Will this change Rukmini's negative view of Doree?

episodesList.title: Flora Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Doree sees Flora vanish with two goons, headed for Rukmini's mansion. When Doree and Ganga confront Rukmini, will she reveal Flora's fate?

episodesList.title: Doree is Ridiculed
episodesList.summary: Doree's first day is sabotaged by Flora, following Rukmini's orders. Ridiculed for her bag, Doree must face the bullies and navigate a challenging start.

episodesList.title: Doree In a Bind!
episodesList.summary: Flora cunningly ensnares Doree, confining her within a room accompanied by a wild goose. What strategy will Doree employ to elude this untamed creature?

episodesList.title: Ganga to Lose Doree?
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad's unfit home life puts Doree's well-being at risk. Child welfare steps in, threatening to separate them. Will Ganga fight to keep his child?

episodesList.title: Ganga Toils Beyond His Limit!
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad's desperate efforts to save Doree from the Children Welfare Committee push him to his limits. Can he sacrifice his health for her?

episodesList.title: Mansi Accuses Rukmini
episodesList.summary: Mansi's shocking find - Sudha's abortion records - points to Rukmini's dark secret. Will she confess to gender-based killings, or silence the truth?

episodesList.title: Doree Takes a Tough Decision
episodesList.summary: Doree bids farewell to Ganga Prasad, leaving Flora in charge. Will Ganga Prasad accept her decision?

episodesList.title: Doree Encounters a Veiled Lady
episodesList.summary: Doree comes across a veiled lady at the adoption facility who assures her of leading her to her biological parents. Will Doree uncover the truth about her origins?

episodesList.title: Doree Confronts Mansi
episodesList.summary: Doree confronts Mansi about her true parentage, while Anand is shaken by the veiled woman's reveal. Will the truth about Doree's birth family be exposed?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Hides Doree From Ganga
episodesList.summary: Ganga Prasad seeks Doree, hiding in Rukmini's home. Will Rukmini's cunning deception succeed, or will Ganga Prasad find her?

episodesList.title: Doree Escapes From The Dungeon!
episodesList.summary: Doree escapes Thakur's dungeon but faces a new challenge: escaping the mansion undetected. Can she outsmart her captors?

episodesList.title: Doree's Life is In Danger!
episodesList.summary: Doree's rescue mission fails, leaving her trapped by the sinister Rukmini. Can she break free before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Mansi Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Ganga risks everything to rescue Mansi, revealing a shocking truth: Doree is her lost daughter. Rukmini, losing the property papers, faces her downfall.

episodesList.title: Rukimi Reveals Her Monster Side!
episodesList.summary: Rukmini confesses to trying to kill Doree's granddaughter, vowing to eliminate all female heirs in the Thakur family.  Their reaction will determine the fate of future generations.

episodesList.title: Anand Kidnaps Doree
episodesList.summary: In Mumbai, Mansi & Ganga fight to protect Doree from Anand's wicked plot to seize their new life and property.

episodesList.title: Pavitra Hatches an Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Doree's world shatters as she learns the truth about her birth parents. Pavitra's evil plan targets Ganga Prasad and Mansi. Will she triumph?

episodesList.title: Doree Unveils The Truth!
episodesList.summary: A wandering healer saves Mansi and Ganga, but their troubles are far from over. Doree exposes Anand and Rukmini's crimes. Will justice prevail?

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Desperate Move
episodesList.summary: Rukmini, cornered by police, seizes a weapon and takes a child hostage. Can they stop her escape and save the child?

episodesList.title: Flora's World Falls to Pieces
episodesList.summary: Flora's world crumbles after Pavithra's tragic accident. Ganga Prasad and Doree offer comfort. Can they mend her shattered heart?

episodesList.title: Anand's Heinous Act!
episodesList.summary: Anand's surprise for Neelu turns into a nightmare. Sold to a stranger for profit, can she find a way out?

episodesList.title: Mansi-ganga's Life is In Danger!
episodesList.summary: Anand shoots Mansi, then flees. Ganga Prasad tries to stop him, but gets shot himself. Will they both survive?

episodesList.title: Anand Threatens Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree's family is held hostage. Anand demands she signs property papers or they die. Will she betray her loved ones?

episodesList.title: Mansi Resolves to Punish Anand
episodesList.summary: Haunted by Anand's crimes, Mansi burns with fury. He begs for mercy, confessing his sins. Will she grant him a second chance?

episodesList.title: Rukmini Faces Public Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Humiliated during her arrest, Rukmini vows vengeance upon her neighbourhood. What will her revenge entail?

episodesList.title: Mansi Pleads With Veerendra
episodesList.summary: Mansi yearns for Ganga Prasad's hand, but her brother, Veerendra, stands in her way. Can she sway him before he forces her back home?

episodesList.title: Mansi-ganga Prasad Tie The Knot
episodesList.summary: Doree celebrates Mansi and Ganga Prasad's wedding, unaware of Rukmini's vengeful plot to destroy her happiness. Will Doree's joy be short-lived?

episodesList.title: Doree Returns With a New Hope!
episodesList.summary: Now an adult, Doree dreams of becoming a successful fashion designer in Varanasi. Meanwhile, Rajnandini's men attack Ganga for witnessing them throw a baby girl into the river.

episodesList.title: Doree Heeds Ganga's Advice
episodesList.summary: Doree rescues the child from the river and finds an injured Ganga, who urges him to protect the child. Doree obeys, shielding the child from pursuing goons.

episodesList.title: Doree's Bold Claim
episodesList.summary: Neelu blocks Doree from entering the house with the strange child. Remembering her promise to Ganga, Doree insists the child is hers. Will Neelu believe Doree?

episodesList.title: Ganga Loses His Memory!
episodesList.summary: Doree learns about Ganga's memory loss when he cannot identify the baby. Later, she visits the temple for the baby's naming ceremony, where Mann joins her.

episodesList.title: Rajnandini Names Her Child
episodesList.summary: Rajnandini suggests 'Pratham' as the perfect name for Pushpa's son. She urges Pushpa to let go of her daughter's memory and embrace Pratham as her own.

episodesList.title: Doree Fights Back For Her Dignity
episodesList.summary: When Deep and his friends harass Doree, she fights bravely to protect her dignity. Meanwhile, Rajnandini is impressed by Doree's design and becomes eager to find her.

episodesList.title: Doree Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Sattu proposes to Doree, hoping to shield her from criticism as an unmarried mother, but she declines. Meanwhile, Doree faces a financial crisis and strives to sell sarees.

episodesList.title: Doree Rejects Rajnandini's Offer
episodesList.summary: Maan and Doree get into an argument as she stops him from using her saree to clean the car. Rajnandini summons Doree and offers her a job, but she turns it down.

episodesList.title: Rajnandini's Cruel Scheme
episodesList.summary: While Doree sets up her saree stall in the market, Rajnandini plots to set it on fire. Later, Ganga and Doree are devastated when they spot the flames.

episodesList.title: Maan Rescues Doree-ganga
episodesList.summary: Maan races to save Doree and Ganga while trapped inside the stall. To gain Doree's attention, Rajnandini pretends to undergo stringent penance.

episodesList.title: Rajnandini Deceives Doree
episodesList.summary: Rajnandini tricks Doree into making Banarasi sarees for her show, hiding her deceitful plans. Sattu is shocked by Rajnandani's deceit and rushes to alert Doree about it.

episodesList.title: Doree Faces Rajnandini's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Neelu steals the special saree for Paro's wedding while Rajnandini anxiously waits for it. Later, Rajnandini humiliates Doree for failing to deliver the saree.

episodesList.title: Doree Fights For Paro's Dignity
episodesList.summary: When Deep publicly disrobes Paro to take the saree, Doree steps in to defend her dignity. Later, Doree takes Paro to Rajnandini's fashion show to reveal Rajnandini's cruelty.

episodesList.title: Doree Exposes Rajnandini
episodesList.summary: Doree confronts Rajnandini's guests for supporting a woman who disrespects others. With the media's pressure mounting, will Rajnandini apologise for humiliating Paro?

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree is horrified to find her aunt murdered, but the police arrest her father for the crime. As she pleads his innocence, Rajnandini watches from afar.

episodesList.title: Doree Feels Helpless
episodesList.summary: Doree finds herself helpless as no lawyer in the city agrees to take Ganga Prasad's case. Later, she becomes determined to meet Maan Thakur and convince him to fight for her.

episodesList.title: Rajnandini Gets Blackmailed
episodesList.summary: Kavya tells Rajnandini she knows about her pregnancy and the father's identity. She demands that Rajnandini arrange her marriage with Maan or face exposure.

episodesList.title: Maan's Demand Stuns Doree!
episodesList.summary: Doree is shocked when Maan demands a huge sum to take on her case. Elsewhere, Rajnandini brings Kavya home, determined to fix her marriage with Maan.

episodesList.title: Maan's Offer to Doree
episodesList.summary: Maan tries to convince Doree about the contract marriage and strikes a deal to save Ganga. Meanwhile, Rajnandini and her mother plot to ruin him by forcing him to marry Kavya.

episodesList.title: Doree Agrees to Marry Maan
episodesList.summary: Doree tells Maan she is willing to stage a fake wedding to convince his family they are married. Later, Maan asks her to sign an NDA.

episodesList.title: Maan Legally Represents Ganga
episodesList.summary: Doree and Maan strike a deal, agreeing to each other's terms for the fake marriage. Later, Doree introduces Maan to Ganga and reveals that he will be his lawyer.

episodesList.title: Maan-doree Get Married
episodesList.summary: Maan lies to his grandmother and seeks her blessing before marrying Doree. He marries Doree at the temple before going to the marriage registry office to complete the formalities.

episodesList.title: Maan Confesses to His Family
episodesList.summary: Kavya confronts Maan's family, accusing them of betrayal and claiming that Maan secretly married someone at a temple. Later, Maan returns home and confirms her claim.

episodesList.title: Maan's Bold Claim
episodesList.summary: Rajnandini panics seeing Doree as Maan's wife and tries to cast her out by questioning her about the father of her child. Maan surprises everyone by claiming to be the father.

episodesList.title: Doree's Painful Homecoming
episodesList.summary: Maan arrives home with Doree and Subhi, but Rajnandini sets fire to the entrance to stop them. During Doree's welcome ceremony, she falls victim to Rajnandini's wicked schemes.

episodesList.title: Maan Stands Up For Doree
episodesList.summary: Maan notices the wound on Doree's feet and questions her about it. Upon learning the truth, he confronts his family and endures the pain by stepping into the ritual plate.

episodesList.title: Maan-doree's Pretentious Romance
episodesList.summary: RN and Kavya doubt Maan and Doree’s wedding, planting a sexy nightwear for Doree. She refuses to wear it, but Maan spots Kavya hiding and fakes a romantic moment to prove their love.

episodesList.title: Doree's Unwavering Stance
episodesList.summary: RN urges Maan to evict Doree, but Maan asks Doree to apologize to ease tensions. Doree refuses and vows to prove that RN and Deep have wronged her sister.

episodesList.title: A Turning Point In Doree’s Life
episodesList.summary: Paro and Anand join RN to accuse Doree during her post-wedding rituals, claiming she caused the wedding and fashion show debacle to exploit RN’s name and extort money.

episodesList.title: Doree is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Maan is left speechless after Anand and Paro reveal that Doree intentionally tried to defame RN. RN has Doree arrested and appoints Maan as her lawyer.

episodesList.title: Doree Proves Her Innocence
episodesList.summary: Doree proves her innocence to Maan and demands an apology from RN. However, RN turns the tables in her favor by blaming Deep instead.

episodesList.title: Doree Sees Maan’s True Face
episodesList.summary: Maan is brutally beaten by goons, and Doree learns he hired them himself, punishing himself over losing his relationships and family.

episodesList.title: Maan Saves Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree's saree catches fire, and Maan rescues her. She accuses him of exploiting her, but Maan teases her before revealing he never changed her clothes.

episodesList.title: Rn Orchestrates a Romantic Date
episodesList.summary: To uncover the truth about Maan and Doree's wedding, RN arranges a romantic date for them with a hidden camera.

episodesList.title: Doree Discovers a Clue
episodesList.summary: Doree finds her first clue linking Shubhi to the Thakur family, while RN plots to convince Dadi that Doree is an ill fated daughter in law.

episodesList.title: Doree Performs The Ritual
episodesList.summary: Dadi orders Doree to walk on her knees to the temple for Maan's safety. When Maan learns about it, he confronts Dadi.

episodesList.title: Kavya Learns Maan and Doree's Wedding is Fake
episodesList.summary: Dadi questions Maan and Doree's fake marriage, but they turn it to their advantage. She then asks them to light the Holika pyre together, blessing their union forever.

episodesList.title: Deep Kidnaps Doree
episodesList.summary: Deep kidnaps Doree on RN's orders to create a rift with Dadi, but Doree arrives for Holika Dahan, leaving Deep and RN shocked and confused. How did she escape?

episodesList.title: Doree Unites Everyone For Holika Dahan
episodesList.summary: Doree unites the family for Holika Dahan, moving Dadi and Maan. Their last gathering like this was when Maan’s mother was alive, making the celebration nostalgic and special.

episodesList.title: Doree Faces a Challenging Situation
episodesList.summary: RN and Deep invite an intoxicated Sattu to Holi, putting Doree in a tough spot. Her character is questioned, and Deep punishes her by forcing her to dance at the celebration.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree's First Holi
episodesList.summary: Doree's dance brings the essence of Krishna and Radha to the Holi celebration. Maan, learning of her humiliation, joins her and becomes the first to apply her sacred gulaal.

episodesList.title: Maan's Surprise For Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree stops Maan from punishing RN, Deep, Kavya, and Ambika, urging unity. Maan takes Doree to her Bunkar Basti family, while RN and Kavya plot to expose their secret with bhang.

episodesList.title: Will Rn Learn About The Marriage Contract?
episodesList.summary: RN serves Maan and Doree bhang gujiyas to expose their wedding, but the plates swap. RN eats them instead and nearly reveals to the family that she is an unwed mother.

episodesList.title: Doree Learns About Rn's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Doree overhears RN thanking Kavya for hiding her pregnancy and later learns from Maan that RN was away for nine months. She starts suspecting Shubhi is RN’s daughter.

episodesList.title: Doree Conducts Rn-shubhi Dna Test
episodesList.summary: Doree sends samples for a DNA test to confirm if Shubhi is RN's daughter. Meanwhile, Dadi asks her to find a groom for RN. In RN and Kavya’s plan, Doree and Maan get trapped.

episodesList.title: Rn Learns That Doree was Never Pregnant
episodesList.summary: RN gets Doree's pictures from Anand Thakur and plans to reveal the truth during Shubhi's annaprashan ceremony that Doree was never pregnant and Shubhi is not her and Maan's daughter.

episodesList.title: Doree Ke Sach Ka Khulasa
episodesList.summary: RN reveals photos to expose Doree's fake pregnancy but is shocked to see altered images proving she was pregnant. Maan had intervened to protect Doree and their marriage.

episodesList.title: Doree is Questioned Of Shubhi's Origin
episodesList.summary: Maan questions Doree about Shubhi's origin, but she stays silent, and he leaves angrily. Later, at the hospital, Doree learns her blood type doesn’t match Shubhi’s, exposing RN’s ploy.

episodesList.title: Maan Donates Blood to Save Shubhi
episodesList.summary: Kavya kidnaps Doree for revenge, but Doree overpowers the goons. Maan rescues her, stands up to RN, and donates blood to save Shubhi at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Doree Confronts Rn
episodesList.summary: Doree confronts RN, revealing she knows RN caused Shubhi’s fall and her secret of being an unwed mother. She warns RN to stop harming them, leaving RN stunned.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree Questioned
episodesList.summary: RN exposes that Maan and Doree only pretend to be in love and don’t share the same bed. Their relationship is questioned, but Maan skillfully covers it up.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree's Teamwork
episodesList.summary: Doree learns Maan's colleagues will visit, but he warns her to stay away. Meanwhile, RN and Kavya burden her with chores, but Maan helps, and they finish everything.

episodesList.title: Doree Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Maan tells his friends that Doree is unwell and can't attend the party. However, Doree surprises everyone by showing up and winning them over with her warmth and hospitality.

episodesList.title: Maan Kisses Doree
episodesList.summary: Kavya and RN plot to embarrass Doree, but Maan protects her, sharing a tender moment. Meanwhile, the goon who threw Shubhi into the Ganges learns she is alive.

episodesList.title: Doree Finds a Clue
episodesList.summary: Ratan tells Doree that Shubhi is alive but hides the culprit’s name fearing RN. Doree texts RN using Ratan’s phone, leading to a tense face-off between her and RN.

episodesList.title: Will Doree Learn The Truth?
episodesList.summary: Doree meets the woman behind Shubhi’s fall. RN plans to shoot Ratan but Kavya stops him, revealing it’s Doree. Maan arrives as Doree reveals Ratan’s truth and Shubhi’s survival.

episodesList.title: Doree Gets Thrown Out Of The House
episodesList.summary: Dadi and Thakur family are shattered learning Doree was never pregnant. When she tries to explain, RN and Kavya throw her out of the house.

episodesList.title: Maan's Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Maan visits Bunkar Basti to bring Doree back but she refuses. Ambika and RN manipulate him emotionally reminding him of his strained relationships.

episodesList.title: Doree Becomes The Saviour
episodesList.summary: Surendra sees Maan break down and calls Doree for help. As Maan sets things on fire in distress Doree calms him with her presence promising she will never leave him.

episodesList.title: Doree Probes Maan's Past
episodesList.summary: Doree tries to learn about Maan's past but he avoids it. Meanwhile, Dadi names Shubhi a rightful Thakur, adding her to the will, which leaves RN furious.

episodesList.title: Shubhi Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Pushpa discovers Shubhi is her daughter. RN, with Anand, plans her kidnapping to traffic her and other children internationally. Doree uncovers a clue about the kidnapper.

episodesList.title: Maan Gets Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Maan and Doree infiltrate the godown to rescue Shubhi. Maan fights bravely but gets stabbed by a goon during the intense confrontation.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree Save Shubhi
episodesList.summary: Maan and Doree rescue Shubhi, but police ask for adoption papers or they'll lose her. It turns out this legal trap was part of RN's plan all along.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree Adopt Shubhi
episodesList.summary: During the Kanjak Pooja celebrations, Maan proposes to Doree that they adopt Shubhi. Later, they sign the legal adoption papers, officially becoming Shubhi's parents.

episodesList.title: Doree Finds Out The Truth
episodesList.summary: Doree learns the truth, while Maan meets with an accident planned by Rajnandini.

episodesList.title: Doree Meets Ganga
episodesList.summary: Doree saves Maan but RN sets the lab on fire. Ganga returns and Doree finally meets him.

episodesList.title: Doree Shows Rn's Picture
episodesList.summary: Doree shows RN's picture to Ganga, triggering the past, but in vain. Maan realizes his love and proposes to Doree, while RN learns that Ganga is back.

episodesList.title: Maan Proposes to Doree
episodesList.summary: Maan proposes his love to Doree. Meanwhile Rn discovers their contract marriage and plans to expose the truth.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree Marry
episodesList.summary: Maan and Doree's contract marriage is exposed. They try to calm Dadi, and Maan confesses his love for Doree, marrying her with rituals. Ganga arrives and witnesses it.

episodesList.title: Maan Accepts His Love For Doree
episodesList.summary: Maan confesses love before Dadi and Ganga, promising Doree's happiness. But Doree thinks he’s pretending to protect Dadi and Ganga, unaware of his true feelings.

episodesList.title: Doree Struggles to Understand Maan's Love
episodesList.summary: Doree learns Maan plans to propose, leaving her conflicted. Meanwhile, Ganga recalls RN killing Neelu and visits Thakur Haveli to inform Doree about it.

episodesList.title: Maan Finds Clue About His Mother's Death
episodesList.summary: Maan finds a video revealing Ganga killed his mother. It’s revealed that Ambika and RN fabricated the video to create a rift between Maan and Doree.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree's First Rift
episodesList.summary: Doree learns Ganga’s bail is revoked and Maan is behind it, accusing Ganga of killing Meera. Doree refuses to believe him and chooses Ganga, leaving Maan heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree's Separation
episodesList.summary: Maan confesses his love to Doree and proposes, but she chooses Ganga over him. Doree leaves Thakur Haveli, determined to gather evidence to prove Ganga's innocence.

episodesList.title: Doree Meets Meera
episodesList.summary: Maan recalls moments with his mother Meera, while Doree finds her alive. She discovers a Thakur heirloom and faces a new enemy at the asylum, who tries to kill her.

episodesList.title: Doree Learns Maan is In Danger
episodesList.summary: Doree learns Deep’s plan to harm Maan with sedative laced kheer. She escapes snakes and rushes to Thakur Haveli as Maan is about to eat it. Will she save him in time?

episodesList.title: Maan's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Doree stops Maan from eating the kheer and says Meera is alive. But he gets angry at the asylum when it’s not her. RN and Ambika find Meera inside a gift box.

episodesList.title: Maan's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: Maan struggles with his life, while Doree dances to win back her life. When Maan wakes, Doree claims her rights as his wife, but in anger, he announces his wedding to Kavya.

episodesList.title: Doree Discovers Ambika’s Truth
episodesList.summary: Doree returns to Thakur Haveli, claiming her rights as Maan's wife and vowing to find Meera. She succeeds, forcing Ambika to confess and promising to reunite Maan and Meera.

episodesList.title: Doree Realises Maan's Love For Her
episodesList.summary: Doree realises Maan still loves her and believes he won’t marry Kavya. Meanwhile, RN finds KD, and together, they plot to ruin Doree.

episodesList.title: Doree is Attacked
episodesList.summary: Doree holds Maan captive, promising to bring Meera. After finding Ambika, Doree reaches Meera but is attacked by RN. In a cruel twist, Ambika buries Doree alive in a coffin.

episodesList.title: Maan Saves Doree
episodesList.summary: KD ensures Doree's survival, believing her true pain lies in losing all ties. As Maan comes to her rescue, Doree reveals the culprit along with proof.

episodesList.title: Ambika is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Ambika's true motives are revealed to the Thakur family as she attempts to burn Meera alive. Doree rushes to protect her, but both get trapped in the fire, escalating the danger.

episodesList.title: Doree Comes Face to Face With Kd
episodesList.summary: When Maan apologises, Doree forgives him.Later, she is shocked to see KD and reveals how he destroyed her childhood.

episodesList.title: Doree to Confess Her Love?
episodesList.summary: Meera spots KD, prompting Maan to insist he stay at Thakur Haveli for her safety. During a surprise date, Doree is ready to confess her feelings, but Maan falls asleep.

episodesList.title: Doree Joins Hands With Anand
episodesList.summary: KD warns Doree that the party she planned with Maan will be a stage for cold-blooded murder. Meanwhile, Doree teams up with Anand to expose KD’s deadly scheme in time.

episodesList.title: Maan is Arrested
episodesList.summary: During the Thakurs' celebration, Anand arrives to expose KD. Lights go out during a scuffle and Anand is found stabbed. Maan is arrested as KD smirks at Doree.

episodesList.title: Maan Escapes From The Cops
episodesList.summary: KD warns Doree that Maan won’t survive prison, so she helps him escape. They feel safe until cops surround their hideout, putting them in grave danger.

episodesList.title: Doree's Search For Truth
episodesList.summary: Doree finds fake blood and heartbeat-slowing medicine in her almirah, proving KD faked Anand’s death. She alerts Maan and rushes to the autopsy center for the truth.

episodesList.title: Doree’s Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: Doree records KD and Anand to prove Anand is alive. They drug her and send her for post-mortem. Maan sees her heartbeat drop, rushes to save her but gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Maan Comes to Doree’s Rescue
episodesList.summary: Maan saves Doree and surrenders to protect her. Meanwhile, Doree tricks KD by taking his phone, bringing cops, and exposing him, proving she planned to save Maan all along.

episodesList.title: A New Beginning For Maan and Doree
episodesList.summary: Doree proves Maan’s innocence, bringing them closer. Meanwhile, KD and RN discover that Shubhi is Pushpa’s daughter, and KD plots to push her off the terrace.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree Face a Rift
episodesList.summary: Pushpa rescues Shubhi but RN captures them again. At Thakur Haveli, Maan learns Pushpa is Shubhi's mother but accuses Doree of lying when she reveals RN tried to kill Shubhi.

episodesList.title: Doree Finds Shubhi
episodesList.summary: Maan apologises to Doree and reveals that RN and KD are behind the kidnapping. As KD plants a bomb, Doree arrives at the hideout to save Pushpa and Shubhi.

episodesList.title: Doree’s Life In Danger!
episodesList.summary: Maan tries to save Doree but a blast makes the cops declare her dead. Before Pushpa can expose RN, the latter tricks Dadi into transferring the property.

episodesList.title: Sattu Saves Doree
episodesList.summary: The police tell Maan that Doree died, but Sattu manages to save her. Though in a coma, the doctor informs about her good recovery.

episodesList.title: Doree Loses Her Memory
episodesList.summary: Maan meets Doree but she treats him like a stranger. Shocked, he learns from Sattu that Doree has lost all memories from the past two years.

episodesList.title: Doree Fights Rn’s Cruelty
episodesList.summary: Doree defends the bunkars from RN’s cruelty. RN plans to exploit Doree’s memory loss, while Maan informs Surendra, who urges him to help Doree recall her past.

episodesList.title: Maan's Efforts For Doree
episodesList.summary: Maan tries to revive Doree’s memories by recreating past moments but fails. Pushpa meets Doree with Shubhi, yet Doree treats them as strangers, unaware of their bond.

episodesList.title: Doree Remembers Deep
episodesList.summary: Deep attacks Doree on RN’s orders, but she defends herself and recalls a past escape from him. RN is furious after learning about Deep’s earlier failed attempt.

episodesList.title: Doree Prays For Meera
episodesList.summary: Doree worries about Meera after she gets hurt trying to stop RN's attack. Later, Sugna overhears the truth about Neelu's death.

episodesList.title: Maan Reunites With Meera
episodesList.summary: Meera regains memory, reunites with Maan and stops Doree from leaving for Patan. She also decides to teach her Patola Banarasi weaving as part of her plan to help Maan.

episodesList.title: Doree and Rn's Face-off
episodesList.summary: RN tries to whip the Thakur family for disobedience. However, Doree arrives just in time and saves them from her wrath.

episodesList.title: Maan Tells Doree The Truth
episodesList.summary: Maan convinces Doree he is her husband with proof. Trusting him, Doree stays in Thakur Haveli to teach RN a lesson.

episodesList.title: Doree Irritates Rn
episodesList.summary: Following the plan, Doree irritates RN and checks on Maan, only to find him unwell. As she cares for him, RN secretly plots to sell Thakur Haveli and flee the country.

episodesList.title: Maan and Doree Reunite
episodesList.summary: As Doree rescues Pushpa, her memory returns, and she rushes to Maan to express her feelings. Meanwhile, Maan learns that RN killed Neelu, proving Ganga's innocence.

episodesList.title: Doree Gets Possessed!
episodesList.summary: The neighbours warn Doree and Maan about Neelu’s ghost. Doree denies it and later, collapses. Strange incidents begin to unfold and it is revealed that she is possessed.

episodesList.title: Doree's Truth Comes to Light
episodesList.summary: Doree was never possessed. She and Maan plotted to expose RN. As Doree nears success, RN discovers the truth and aims to kill her. Maan risks his life to save her.

episodesList.title: Doree is Pregnant
episodesList.summary: RN is arrested and Maan and Doree get married. Months later, Doree announces her pregnancy. Amidst the joy, RN escapes jail but dies, and the couple lives happily.

title: Dalchini
summary: Dalchini (transl. Cinnamon) is an Indian Hindi-language television family drama series that premiered from 6 November  2023 to 13 April 2024 on Dangal. It is produced by Sargun Mehta and Ravi Dubey under Dreamiyata Entertainment Private Limited. The series stars Maira Dharti Mehra and Rohit Choudhary.
plot:
Dalchini follows the story of Falak (Dalchini), a young woman from a rural village who discovers her passion and talent for cooking, despite her lack of formal education. However, her journey is not without challenges, as she must navigate a complicated relationship with her mother-in-law, Rajrani, who is an accomplished chef in her own right. As the two women with vastly different personalities and culinary skills come together as saas bahu, tensions rise and conflicts arise.
Dalchini, a cheerful happy go lucky girl runs her household by cooking for people. She gets an order from the Dhillon Masala factory whose owner is Rajarani Dhillon (Manini Mishra), she calls Dalchini in order to help her cook prasad for a satsang organized by her family. But the prasad was cooked by Dalchini(due to Vimmy's conspiracy to destroy the prasad cooked by Rajrani)and Rajrani fakes that she cooked it (in order to save her family's Pride). Guruji learns about this and asks Dalchini but she fakes that the prasad was cooked by Rajrani. Rajrani hates Dalchini because the prasad cooked by Dalchini was liked by everyone in the satsang even her family members. But everyone who thinks that the Prasad was cooked by Rajrani were appreciating her. Tej an NRI handsome guy returns Monga and meets Dalchini and falls for her but after learning that due to her his mother was insulted in the satsang he started to hate her. Due to some circumstances Tej marries Dalchini while Rajrani decides to make her life hell.
Rajrani uses Dalchini's sister Kala who is obsessed with Tej against Dalchini
