episodesList.title: A Trickster
episodesList.summary: Kapurvati was crying and suddenly Maharani Vinta comes to her and ask the reason behind her sadness. Kadruvati replies to her, don't waste your time in servants' life, Maharani. Hence, Maharani Vinta tells her that you are not just a servant, you are like my sister. Also, what is the thing which is troubling you? If it can be solved by me then I will try to help you. Will Kapurvati tell her problem?

episodesList.title: A Weird Nervousness
episodesList.summary: Garud says; who is it that the impression of being is making me so confused. later, when he saw something in the cloud he says who is this shadow and what is the reason for its presence here? Besides, Kadru arrives and asks Garud what is he doing here? Hence, Garud says, he is feeling a weird nervousness. Will Garud know about Yamraj?

episodesList.title: Plan To Defile
episodesList.summary: Rajmata orders Vinta and Garud to clean the kitchen. Well cleaning the kitchen won't make any sense because I already planned to defile that work of yours. Here, Garud is cleaning the dish. Vinta says to herself, sorry son but your father wants you to become mentally and emotionally strong so that you can take your eyes off me and for that I've to become harsh.

episodesList.title: A Falsify
episodesList.summary: Rajmata is making a plan before Kadru's arrival. Also, she asks her slave to collect all the cow dung and keep it separately. Besides, Garud comes and he was surprised to see cow dung wasn't there. Thereupon, Kadru comes and asks Garud about the cow dung. Hence, Diti says that Garud and his mother removed the cow dung and cheated on you as usual. Kadru gets angry with Garud, why are you doing this with my son?

episodesList.title: Will Kadru Break Her fast?
episodesList.summary: Kadru smells of delicious food and gets happy. Also, she says I can't eat, but at least I can see. Thereupon, her inner soul comes in front of her and tells her that you have not been fasting for half a day and you are being pulled towards food. But you didn't realize how much your sons are yearning for a drop of water. Will Kadru break her fast?

episodesList.title: Kadru Apologises To Arun
episodesList.summary: Kaaliya and Takshak discuss being rude to their brothers, Takshak promises not to indulge in any sin from now onwards. Yamdhoot gives a warning to Garud, as they take away the demon's soul. Kadru feels sorry and apologizes to Arun for treating Vinta in such a manner.

episodesList.title: A Mighty Sage
episodesList.summary: Diti tells Vinta, I thought you must have told Garud about Agastya Maharishi along with wisdom meditation but you didn't. Agastya Maharishi before whom the mountain bows. Thereafter, Garud gets surprised and says this sage is amazing. Hence, Garud asks Diti to tell him about Agastya Maharishi.

episodesList.title: Diti Provokes Kadru
episodesList.summary: Diti instigates Kadru that the maid raised her hand and you did not even punish her. I believe that you do not want to let the fast of your living sons go in vain, so you controlled your anger. But, If you do not remind her of dignity, then she will rule by sitting on your head and you will not be able to do anything. Vinta smiles. Is she planning something?

episodesList.title: A Lost Faith
episodesList.summary: Kadr tells to the lord you know that I've done this fast with all my heart, If I have made any mistake even by mistake, then forgive me. Also, II know that I have lost my faith in you, but Vinta is your supreme devotee, she has also kept a fast for my sons, listen to her prayer to god because If anything happens to my sons, even his son will not live.

episodesList.title: The Purpose Of Birth
episodesList.summary: Garud says, forgive me, mother, your Garud could not fulfill the promise given to you. Hence, Garud feels helpless after giving the bow of Guru Dakshina to Maharishi. Meanwhile, Garud sees his wings are back. Thereafter, Maharishi comes and tells Garud, one who wants to be an example of mother-father devotion, is to be called the supreme devotee of Lord Vishnu, how can I snatch his wings?

episodesList.title: Vinta Is Surprised To See Kadru
episodesList.summary: Seeing Kadru in the kitchen, Vinta asks Maharani you here? Kadru says, the fast is successful when the fasting person makes the food themselves, and anyway, I have more experience in cooking than you. Besides, Garud laughs seeing his brothers the way they were cutting the vegetables. Here, Diti is planning to break Kadru's fast.

episodesList.title: Thousand Of Sages Coming For Food
episodesList.summary: Garud says how is this possible? Vinta asks why are you saying this? Garud says I have seen from my distant vision that there are a thousand sages coming for food. Vinta, Kadru, and everyone get shocked. Vinta says, when I think everything will be good then something bad happens.

episodesList.title: Chanting Before Eating
episodesList.summary: A sage comes and says that even though Vinta and Kadru have kept the fast, you have called me. Therefore, whatever happens here, it will be your responsibility along with these two. Hence, Diti says, yes I'll do I'm going to help them. Besides, the Maharishi tells the other sages. that today, that's why all of us have all come here to enjoy the rituals of Mahan Jivikputrika, that's why all of us will chant Om before taking food. -–

episodesList.title: A Curse
episodesList.summary: Kadru gives a curse to Garud saying, the planetary life and its happiness which is in your lines will be erased forever, and your bird species will perish forever. Hence, Garud feels guilty and goes to god in despair and says, why are you smiling? Are you happy to see my mom's crying Or seeing that my brothers are struggling for every single breath? Will Garud be able to save his brother's life?

episodesList.title: Lord Vishnu Gives Life To Kadru's Sons
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu gives life to Kadru's son. He blesses Vinta and Kadru for their fast and penance. Diti and Kadru poison the nagas against Garud, Diti accuses Garud of the incident. Sheshnag and Lord Vishnu discuss Vinta and Garud's condition and how their nobleness is ignored.

episodesList.title: Aditi Comes To Show Gratitude To Garud
episodesList.summary: Maa Aditi pays a visit and praises Gardu for his deeds. Aditi still believes that Kadru must have made Garud and Vinta her slave. Kadru asks her about the solution of Devas and Asuras. Aditi requests Garud's assistance to reach to her sons and give them the good news. Garud, on the other hand, informs her that he must first obtain permission from Kadru. Is Kadru willing to let this happen?

episodesList.title: Will Vinta Pass In The Test?
episodesList.summary: Garud and Aditi Maa`s sons depart for Vishnu Lok to please Lord Vishnu and discover a method to the Rakshasa problem. Garud is happy to know that Aditi Maa has got a solution to reunite Maa Lakshmi with Lord Vishnu. Meanwhile, Vinta meets a person in a horrible situation however with a totally impolite attitude. What can be Vinta's reaction? Will Vinta be able to pass the test?

episodesList.title: Lord Vishnu Tells About 'Amrit'
episodesList.summary: Devraj Indra talks about the solution to their problems with Lord Vishnu, he tells them about the 'Sanjeevni' which has made the Asurs powerful. Lord Vishnu asks him to make a pact with the Asurs to accompany the devas in the process of 'Samundra Manthan'. He also tells them about the 'Amrit' which is present in the depth of the sea.

episodesList.title: Why Did Lord Shani Get Angry?
episodesList.summary: Kadru's son tells her that it wasn't Garud's fault It was us who said firm words for Lord Shani, and maybe that's why he got angry and looked at us with his curved vision. Thus, Kadru asks them who took you to Lord Shani? Her son tells her that we had strayed from the path. Thereupon, Kaaliya interrupts and says, how innocent you both are! Will Kadru trust her son?

episodesList.title: A Bewilderment
episodesList.summary: Kadru asks Vinta, what happened, where are you lost? Neither your hands are moving nor a word is coming out of your mouth. Vinta thinks if I tell the truth then maybe Didi refuses to keep me in her house, and if I lie, I must be guilty of false speech. What shall I do? Will Vinta tell the truth or not?

episodesList.title: The Story Of Garud's Wings
episodesList.summary: Vinta looks at the feathers of Garud and tells, since his birth, whenever it fell I've kept it. It reminds me of my son, whenever he is away from me I touch and embrace it. It makes me feel that he is close to me, not far from me. Vinta gets emotional while saying the story of Garud's wings.

episodesList.title: How Will Vinta Arrange Non-Vegetarian Food?
episodesList.summary: Vinta brings vegetarian food for the poor Baba but Baba refuses to eat and asks her to give him non-vegetarian food. Thus, Vinta says to eat the vegetarian food for now till then she will arrange non-vegetarian food for you. Just then, as soon as Baba put a morsel in his mouth he threw food out of his mouth. How will Vinta be able to make Baba happy?

episodesList.title: Bali Accepts To Participate In 'Samundra Manthan'
episodesList.summary: Devtas come to gain the support of Maharaj Bali as per Lord Vishnu's wish. Guru 'Shukracharya' advises Mahraj Bali against the proposal, according to him, the devtas will not share the 'Amrit' with the Asuras. He also taunts that Devtas are in need of the 'Amrit' and Asuras do not want 'Amrit' as he can give life to death. .

episodesList.title: Lord Vishnu Is Happy
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu asks Garud to help Asuras and Devas in the 'Samundra Manthan'. Lord Vishnu instructs Narad Muni to accompany Garud and ensure that Guru Shukrachrya does not have the opportunity to act in wrath. Lord Vishnu is also happy as he has received an anklet of Goddess Lakshmi with Garud's help. All of Devta and Danav meet to begin the Manthan, but they encounter a stumbling block. How will they achieve their objectives?

episodesList.title: Asurraj Vs Devraj
episodesList.summary: The Devtas take the blessing of his mother before going ahead to lift up the mountain. Just then, Garud tells to the Devraj you all have great powers you can't give up like this. Devraj says, Is Garud supporting us or ridiculing us? Thus, even the gods could not lift the mountain. Thereupon, Barasingha taunts Devraj, It is very easy to say anything but difficult to achieve your goal. What will Devraj and Asurraj do?

episodesList.title: Will Garud Succeed In Lifting Mandara
episodesList.summary: Takshak and Kaaliya fail in throwing out the diseased man outside Vinta's cottage, Kadru gets angry knowing that her powerful sons are unable to fulfill her wish. The other sons of Kadru try to fulfill their mother's wish but fail. Garud takes the blessings of his elder brothers before lifting the Mandara 'parvat'. Will he succeed and take the mountain near the sea. . Episodes No - 85, 20 June 2022

episodesList.title: Will Garud Be Able To Reach Sheer Sagar?
episodesList.summary: Lord Shri Vishnu says, one who is absorbed in my devotion is never alone. Here, Garud is chanting and trying to lift the mountain and was able to lift that mountain. Besides, Diti thinks and says, this bird has lifted this huge mountain, but he will not be able to reach the Sheer Sagar. Just then, Garud Flew away with the mountain. Diti gets shocked seeing Garud.

episodesList.title: Will Garud Be Able To Reach Sheer Sagar? Part I
episodesList.summary: Lord Shri Vishnu says, one who is absorbed in my devotion is never alone. Here, Garud is chanting and trying to lift the mountain and was able to lift that mountain. Besides, Diti thinks and says, this bird has lifted this huge mountain, but he will not be able to reach the Sheer Sagar. Just then, Garud Flew away with the mountain. Diti gets shocked seeing Garud.

episodesList.title: Will Garud Be Able To Reach Sheer Sagar? Part II
episodesList.summary: Lord Shri Vishnu says, one who is absorbed in my devotion is never alone. Here, Garud is chanting and trying to lift the mountain and was able to lift that mountain. Besides, Diti thinks and says, this bird has lifted this huge mountain, but he will not be able to reach the Sheer Sagar. Just then, Garud Flew away with the mountain. Diti gets shocked seeing Garud

episodesList.title: The Fruit Of Austerities
episodesList.summary: The Devta says that we will need such a string, which is so long that even after tying the churn of this mountain from all sides and we can hold it from both sides and pull it. Then the Asur went on saying that it should have so much power that even after repeated rubbing on the mountain, it shouldn't get weak nor break.

episodesList.title: What Happened To Devraj?
episodesList.summary: Devraj says, why did we send that Garud to do such an important task? Vimaata Kadru can never refuse us.But, will she listen to his slave? Just then, Munivar tells Garud has gone as a messenger, not as a slave. Besides, Asur asks Munivar, will Mata Kadru be able to respect the difference between a slave and a messenger?

episodesList.title: Will Garud Be Able To Lift Vasuki's Tail?
episodesList.summary: Garud asks 'Vasuki' to accompany him to the sea to help them with the process of 'Samundra Manthan'. 'Vasuki' denies help to Garud as Kadru denies him the permission. Garud who had come as a messenger to Kadru was being treated like a slave. He also remembers the humiliation he will have to face if he doesn't bring 'Vasuki'. He threatens 'Vasuki' and tries to use power to take him for 'Samundra Manthan'. Will he succeed in lifting Vasuki's tail with all the ego inside him?

episodesList.title: Garud Apologizes For His Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Garud is made captive by Vasuki. Devas and Asur catch Vasuki making his grip around Garud. Garud reminisces Vinta's teachings and gets enlightened. He apologizes to his mother for his ego and remorse for his behavior. He also apologizes to Vasuki for being egoistic. Guru Braspati asks Bali to help Vasuki to loosen his grip, Aditi asks Kadru to permit Vasuki to accompany them to the ceremony of Samundara Manthan.  . Episodes No - 93, 29 June 2022

episodesList.title: Will Garud Be Able To Solve The Puzzle?
episodesList.summary: Vasuki is thankful to Lord Shiva for agreeing to take him, Lord Shiva takes Vasuki to the sea himself. Garud arrives at 'Vaikunt' to apologize to Lord Vishnu for his arrogance and ego. Maharaj Bali and Lord Indra get into a tussle, about who will be at Vasuki's mouth and who will be at his tail's side.  Lord Vishnu gives Garud another chance and asks him to solve teh tussle between the devas and the asuras. .

episodesList.title: Diti Wants To Go Against Lord Vishnu's Will
episodesList.summary: Diti warns Bali and asks him to obey her command. She tells him if he disobeys her she will be heartbroken. Garud interferes and suggests a mid-way. He asks the lords not to be angry with Diti and let Assur take what they want in order to progress with the Sagar Manthan. Watch the full episode to know more

episodesList.title: A Terrible Disaster
episodesList.summary: Suddenly a disaster struck and everyone's skin started burning with its bullet. Garud got scared and started thinking what kind of crisis is this? Who can be the father of this destruction? please help us, lord. Everyone including Lord Vishnu was astonished to see a terrible crisis emanating from the mountain. How and who will stop this disaster?

episodesList.title: Lord Shani's Last Hope
episodesList.summary: Lord Shani says that the planets are also being destroyed by the hustle and bustle. If this disaster will not be stopped by Lord Vishnu then everything will end. Besides, Garud asks the god, lord there must be some way to be escaped from this poison. Just then, Vishnu Ji appeared and says, there is one solution to get rid of this disaster. What is that?

episodesList.title: Lord Shiv's Interrogation
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva asks Maa Parvati, will you disappoint your devotees? They are all our own children. Also, asks, will you afford to see them in pain? Will you be able to see them giving their lives in terrible pain? Hence, Mata Parvati agreed with Lord Shiv and says you are right, Lord, we cannot allow such a tragedy to have happened to our children.

episodesList.title: Alakshmi's Arrival
episodesList.summary: These signs cannot be a gift for the arrival of Goddess Lakshmi, says Garud. Just then, someone arrived in a terrifying form. She was Alakshmi Maa, the elder sister of Lakshmi Maa. But both are opposite in quality and nature. If Maa Lakshmi is the mother of happiness and prosperity then, Alakshmi is a symbol of sorrow and poverty.

episodesList.title: A Blessing
episodesList.summary: You had come in the sea and had also met Lakshmi, didn't you? Asked Alakshmi Maa from Garud. So, you'll have to tell me Lakshmi is more beautiful or I? Garud replied, Maa, Lakshmi maa looks good when she comes and you look good when you go. Alaksmi maa laughed and says, I liked your answer. May your sorrow and poverty go away soon.

episodesList.title: The Holy Cow 'Kamdhenu'
episodesList.summary: Garud gets to know about the Gods who live in the holy cow 'Kamdhenu'. Maa Lakhsmi is late to choose her place, Goddess Lakshmi is given a place at the back of the cow, this makes the excretion of the cow useful for humans. A new argument arises between the Devas and the Asurs, they fight over who will get the holy cow 'Kamdhenu'.

episodesList.title: Joy Of Life
episodesList.summary: Since the arrival of Kamdhenu, their enthusiasm has increased, even more, says Garud. Seeing them, it seems as if they have forgotten everything. Lord Vishnu says this is the joy of life, as soon as happiness comes the mind of a person becomes fickle and then he forgets all his sorrows.

episodesList.title: Who Will Make The Initial Effort?
episodesList.summary: Diti tells Bali to obey her, and let Indra make the first effort. Besides, Kadru asks her son to clean the kitchen. Her son can't understand what is her mother up to and why is she doing this. Thereafter, she tells, although I convinced Vinta but the truth is that your father had greeted him, which means he is not an ordinary man.

episodesList.title: Where Has Devraj Indra Gone?
episodesList.summary: Where did Devraj Indra disappear without deciding who would get this gem that will come out of the sea? When the mistake of the past suddenly comes in front of you and there is no other way but to see it, then it becomes difficult to face it. This is the same obstinate who along with Devraj Indra insulted Maharishi Durvasa.

episodesList.title: Gift To The Lord Of Sea
episodesList.summary: As the Samudra Manthan continues, Kaustubh mani comes out of the sea. Lord Visnu suggests that the Mani should be gifted to the Lords of the sea. The Devtas and Asuras claim Kalpavriksha while the Manthan goes on. It emerges from the water, and Vrikhsa Raj consents to grant one wish to each party before deciding who he wants to stay with. What will Indra Dev and the Asuras demand?

episodesList.title: Diti's Order
episodesList.summary: These Apsaras are hidden within the contemplation, it's the symbol of desire Garud, so unless that desire is controlled, then this dispute will not be resolved nor will Goddess Lakshmi appear, says Shree Vishnu. Then Garud says, I've to do something. Besides, Garud's brother says, to all of them you are just a slave, why would these people listen to you?

episodesList.title: The Wait Is Over
episodesList.summary: Lord, I could not understand why Mata Lakshmi appeared in the form of an infant, Garud asks from Vishnu. Because this rule has also been made by us Garud. You already know Garud that the soul is immortal, neither it is born nor it dies. Hence, when the soul assumes a new body, then its new life begins from childhood itself. That's why Mata Lakshmi started her journey in the form of the daughter of Samudra Dev, that too in an infant form.

episodesList.title: Devotion
episodesList.summary: When Maa Lakshmi appeared Garud comes to Maa Lakshmi and sings a hymn to her, meanwhile, Shree Vishnu recalls the old memory of his and Maa Lakshmi. Then, Garud says that everyone has given you something but what should I give you Maa, I am a simple slave. Goddess Lakshmi is so pleased with your devotion that she does not want anything else, Garud, Says Shree Vishnu.

episodesList.title: No Flaws, No Demerits
episodesList.summary: Lord, how can you have any demerits in you, asks Garud? You are seeing from the point of view of a devotee, Garud. A woman's eye can see what no one else can and when she has to choose her life partner, then the question of accepting anything less than sarcheer does not arise.

episodesList.title: Bestowed With All The Great Qualities
episodesList.summary: There are still people in this world whose faces are still sad, Maa. I am aware of that son, but my eyes do not fall on anyone so easily. There are many such people in this world who are not liked by me, hence, you have asked then let me make it clear for you. I never use to go to a place where teachers, parents, and elders are being insulted.

episodesList.title: Lord Vishnu And Goddess Lakshmi's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Everyone starts making arrangements for Lord Vishnu and Maa Lakshmi's wedding. Narad Muni goes to invite Ganesh Ji and his family and witnesses Ganesh Ji's divine infinite form. Meanwhile, the Asuras wait for an official invitation.

episodesList.title: Lord Shiva Arrives For The Wedding PI
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni pays a visit to Vinta and speaks to her about Garud's impressive feats during the Manthan. Meanwhile, Kadru takes this opportunity to try and receive his blessings.

episodesList.title: Lord Shiva Arrives For The Wedding PII
episodesList.summary: All the Devtas, including Mahadev and Maa Parvati, are impressed with Garud's work to organise Lord Vishnu and Maa Lakshmi's wedding. Will the Vivaah go hassle-free?

episodesList.title: Maa Lakshmi Awaits For Vinta
episodesList.summary: Garud rebels against Vinta's wishes and asks her to attend Lord Vishnu and Lakshmi Maa's wedding ceremony. Garud departs for Vaikunth with Kadru Maa. How will Vinta reach the wedding ceremony on time?

episodesList.title: Uninvited Guest
episodesList.summary: Kadru is shocked to see Vinta reach the wedding destination on foot. Meanwhile, Diti Maa creates a scene and demands the reason behind not being invited.

episodesList.title: Will Diti Get the Curse Of Maa Parvati?
episodesList.summary: The Asuras decide to go behind the Devtas' backs and steal the Amrit while they are busy with the Vivaah. Will their evil plan be successful?

episodesList.title: Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The Devtas surround Lord Vishnu and make arrangements to start the 'Haldi Ceremony'. Meanwhile, the Asura's polish their plans to go behind everyone's back and steal the Amrit.

episodesList.title: Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Everyone is in a festive mood as Maa Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu's wedding preparations continue. Meanwhile, the Asura's wait for the right moment to steal the Amrit.

episodesList.title: Desperation
episodesList.summary: Kadru and Diti Maa fight about who will first put the Haldi on Lakshmi Maa, while Garud takes this opportunity to take his mother closer to her. Meanwhile, Ganesh Ji is still running late for the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Marriage Celebrations
episodesList.summary: The Asuras decide to wait till the wedding ceremony begins to steal the 'amrit'. Garud helps Lord Vishnu's family to prepare for departure as Vinta helps Lakshmi Maa's family to prepare for Lord Vishnu's arrival.

episodesList.title: A Feeling
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu sneaks out to meet Lakshmi Maa in secrecy. After he returns, all Devtas help Lord Vishnu to prepare for his wedding.

episodesList.title: Lord Vishnu's Baraat
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu soon realises that he forgot the most important ritual that needs to be performed before starting any task. Kadru and Diti Maa get jealous when Vinta receives attention at the wedding.

episodesList.title: The Wait Is Finally Over
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu's 'baraat' reaches Lakshmi Maa's gates. The Asuras round up to resume the 'Manthan' and take all the 'Amrit' for themselves.

episodesList.title: A Grand Welcome
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi Maa's family receives Lord Vishnu's 'baraat' at their doorstep. Vinta and Arun get emotional when they meet each other after a long time.

episodesList.title: Shubh Vivaah
episodesList.summary: The ceremony for Maa Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu's marriage begins. Meanwhile, the Asuras are worried about Lord Vishnu's next avatar.

episodesList.title: The Divine Wedding
episodesList.summary: After Lord Vishnu and Lakshmi Maa complete their 'phere', Lakshmi Maa's father proudly completes the 'Kanyadaan' ritual. Meanwhile, Kadru finds herself questioning her morals yet again.

episodesList.title: A Blessing From Maa Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Vinta gets too stunned to speak when Lakshmi Maa asks her to come to Vaikunth with her. Lakshmi Maa is welcomed to Vaikunth with open arms by all the members of Lord Vishnu's family.

episodesList.title: Rasoi Ritual
episodesList.summary: Vinta feels extremely blessed when the years of devotion bring her the joy that she didn't even dream of. Lord Vishnu tells Garud and Sesha about a weapon that can control even the strongest Asuras and Devtas.

episodesList.title: Devotion Of Vinta
episodesList.summary: All Devtas and Asuras resume the 'Manthan' and spawn various powerful objects. Soon, Amrit appears which causes friction between both parties. Who will get the 'Amrit'?

episodesList.title: Maa Lalita Appearance
episodesList.summary: The Devtas try to retrieve the 'Amrit' that the Asuras had snatched away for themselves. Lord Vishnu asks Mata Lalita for a blessing to help settle the dispute between the Devtas and Asuras.

episodesList.title: Mohini Tries To Seduce The Devas And Asuras
episodesList.summary: The Devtas and the Asuras get smitten by Devi Mohini and try to impress her to win her favour.

episodesList.title: Devi Parvati Appreciates Lord Vishnu
episodesList.summary: All the Devtas and Asuras get captivated by Devi Mohini's beauty. She tells everyone that whoever will answer her questions will be deemed worthy of taking the Amrit.

episodesList.title: Lord Vishnu Cuts Raahus's Head
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu decides to intervene and punish the Asuras who have been deceiving the Devtas for a long time. Garud requests Lord Vishnu's permission to join the Devtas in their fight to protect the 'Amrit'.

episodesList.title: The Four Cities Of Bharatkhand
episodesList.summary: Garud gets the responsibility of protecting the Amrit and taking it to 'Swarg Lok'. Meanwhile, the Devtas fight the Asuras and keep them distracted.

episodesList.title: Maa Lakshmi's Ray Of Hope
episodesList.summary: The Devtas are delighted to secure the Amrit for themselves and defeat the Asuras. They also get impressed with Garud for not even considering drinking the Amrit when he had it in his hands. Meanwhile, the Asuras plot revenge.

episodesList.title: Dispute For Amrit
episodesList.summary: Kadru and her sons demand a justification from Garud for not giving them the Amrit. They get furious at what they believe is injustice and decide to fight the Devtas. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Power Of Kundalini
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu's avatar meets Garud and starts his training to make him capable of higher feats. Meanwhile, Kadru feels defeated as she sees her sons in pain.

episodesList.title: Praise Of Meditation
episodesList.summary: Garud's meditation impresses the Gods and they help him awaken all his Chakras.

episodesList.title: Kadru Wants Amrit
episodesList.summary: Kadru, along with Kaliya and her other sons, confront Vinta and Garud about the Amrit. The argument leads to a fight between Garud and Kadru's sons. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu observes everything that is happening.

episodesList.title: Vinta Stands Against Garud
episodesList.summary: Kadru's actions result in an argument between Vinta and Garud about the 'Amrit'. Can they find a middle ground?

episodesList.title: The Story of Ganesh
episodesList.summary: Vinta prays to Lord Vishnu while Garud is away in search of the 'Amrit'. She puts forth her wish in front of Lord Vishnu to protect Garud. Maharishi Kashyap offers food to Garud but he declines.

episodesList.title: Garud's Mistake
episodesList.summary: Garud is worried the sages will punish him for his mistake and he will fail in his mission to free his mother. However, Laxmi Maa has other plans for him.

episodesList.title: Point Of No Return
episodesList.summary: Garud takes on the Devtas to accomplish his mission. Will he be successful?

episodesList.title: Honoring the power of motherhood
episodesList.summary: Garud trains for his fight against Indra. Will he be successful in his quest?

episodesList.title: Mental strength
episodesList.summary: Garud shows tremendous mental strength as he gets up on his feet after being pinned down by Indra. Will Garud find the strength to continue the fight?

episodesList.title: Garud Brought Amrit
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu is angry at Garud for fighting the Devtas and trying to obtain the Amrit without his approval. How will Garud react to this?

episodesList.title: Blessings For Garud
episodesList.summary: Garud's refusal of the Amrit, impresses Lord Vishnu and the other gods. However, Indra launches one last attack on him. Will he be able to bring the Amrit to his mother?

episodesList.title: Liberation of Slavery
episodesList.summary: Garud offers the Amrit to Kadru in return for his mother's freedom. Will Kadru keep her word?

episodesList.title: Garud's Plan
episodesList.summary: Garud delays giving the Amrit to Kadru and her sons and Indra takes this opportunity to come and take the Amrit away from them. How will Kadru react?

episodesList.title: Taste Of Freedom
episodesList.summary: As Vinta gets released from her forced labour, Lord Vishnu punishes Kadru and her sons for their actions.

episodesList.title: Shree Ganesh's Birthday
episodesList.summary: It's the time of Ganesh Chaturthi and Ganesh Ji is very excited as he gets to eat special dishes made just for him. He is eagerly waiting for them to be ready as he knows that his mother is preparing them with extra love. He even sends his friend, Mushak Ji to investigate what types of dishes are being made but is unsuccessful in knowing them. Vinta is trying her hardest to prepare an idol of Ganesh but keeps on failing repeatedly. On the other hand, Kadru is at a war with herself after the words of Lord Vishnu.

episodesList.title: God's will!
episodesList.summary: Kadru apologises to Vinta for how she has treated her over the years. Vinta brings the Ganesh idol to pray on the auspicious occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi. Garud is eager to know about the birth of Lord Ganesha,  everyone else gathers to hear tales about Lord Ganesh. Garud learns about Ganesha's birth and how 'mooshak' became his vehicle.

episodesList.title: The story of Gajasur
episodesList.summary: Garud learns about Ganesha's birth and how 'mooshak' became his vehicle. Everyone keenly listens to Ganesh Ji's birth story and how Mahadev had to deal with Gajasur, one of his biggest devotees.

episodesList.title: Gajasur's Demand
episodesList.summary: Everyone keenly listens to Ganesh Ji's birth story and how Mahadev had to deal with Gajasur, one of his biggest devotees. Garud gets worried thinking of Parvati who went to meet Shiva on Kailasa. Gajasur's 'tapasya' pays off and Mahadev visits him, but his demand shocks Mahadev. What did he ask for?

episodesList.title: Lord Ganesha's Birth
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati feels neglected as Mahadev didn't bother to hear her desire but instead went to meet Gajasur. Maa Parvati creates a child with her divine powers while waiting for Lord Shiv. Lord Ganesha plays with her which makes her happy. Goddess Lakshmi and Saraswati are happy to see their friend blessed with a  child.

episodesList.title: The auspicious occasion of birth!
episodesList.summary: Goddess Lakshmi and Saraswati are happy to see their friend blessed with a child. Mata Parvati invites all the Goddesses on the occasion of her son's birthday. Meanwhile, Lord Shiva's dilemma with Gajasur and his brother continues.

episodesList.title: The trap of illusion.
episodesList.summary: Vishnu Ji is narrating the story of Shiv Ji and Mata Sati's meeting. How Mata Sati had to overcome so many obstacles to meet her husband. Vishu Ji is telling the story to Gajasur who is engrossed in the story. Not only him, but everyone is listening to the story with rapt attention. There is an ulterior motive that Lord Vishnu is using to tell this story and he is happy. But Lord Vishnu is unaware that Shani Dev is coming near Kailash. Mata Parvati and Ganesh are spending some alone time together, what will happen next when Shani Dev meets the duo?

episodesList.title: Punishing 'Gajasur'
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu narrates the story of Lord Ganesha, Gajasur's ego gets better of him as he challenges the Gods. He crosses the line and traps Lord Shiv. He asks for a boon that neither the lords nor the man can be the reason for his defeat. Nandi who is an animal fights with Gajasur and defeats him. Gajasur asks for Lord Shiva's mercy and asks for forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Mahadev meets Ganesh Ji.
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiv is on his way to Kailash to meet his dear wife Maa Parvati. Will Ganesh allow him to meet Goddess Parvati?

episodesList.title: Brahma Vishnu Mahesh
episodesList.summary: Garud and his family get to know about the importance of Shivratri and the history behind it. Brahma lies about seeing the head of the pillar and calls the Ketki flower as proof. Vishnu frankly admits that he could not see the end of the pillar. Brahma tells lies to maintain his supremacy, but he will not be worshipped and Vishnu will be worshipped everywhere as Vishnu renounces his ego. At the same time, the Ketki flower also gets cursed. To destroy the ego of Brahma, we will take an avatar, and that avatar will be called Kalabhairav Mahadev says so.

episodesList.title: Only great devotion to ganesh!
episodesList.summary: Ganeshji's story takes a different turn. Nandi runs over him. From this incident, Narada realises that his illusion is about to turn into reality. Mata Laxmi predicts unusual power in Ganesha. But she says that the child is unaware of the consequences of this. Nandi and Shringi go together to attack Ganesha. Vishnu claims that Ganesha insulted Mahadev by blocking his path without listening to him, and that while Shringi and Nandi will bear their own insults, they will never bear the insult of their adoring god Mahadev.

episodesList.title: The determination of Ganesh!
episodesList.summary: After defeating the mighty Nandi, Ganesha makes the powerful Vasuki his next target. Ganesha defeats Vasuki easily and sends him back to Mahadev. lord Vishnu plans to meet Ganesh and make him understand his relationship with Mahadev. Indra with other 'devtas' reaches Kailash to make him understand, but is greeted with challenges from Ganesha.

episodesList.title: A promise is a promise!
episodesList.summary: Even after Lord Vishnu and Lord Brahma are standing in front of Ganesh he is stubborn and not ready to move from the front of the gate. Everyone is scared as they watch on but Ganesh is standing tall in front of them. They even tell him to at least pay some respects to the creators of mankind and the universe but Ganesha declares them his enemies and even attacks them with a stick especially provided by his mother. Lord Vishnu is not ready to retaliate and stands still. What will happen next? Will Lord Vishnu lose his cool and attack Ganesh in return?

episodesList.title: The enragement of Shiva!
episodesList.summary: Mahadev comes out of Samadhi. He learns of Brahma and Vishnu's humiliation by Ganesha and apologises to them for being insulted in Kailasa. Maa Lakshmi says that Mahadev can never tolerate insults from his devotees. Shankarji walks on Ganeshaji in the form of Rudra. Mahadev throws trishul at Ganesha in anger. What will happen to Ganesha? It will be interesting to see what happens next.

episodesList.title: The will of Devi Parvati!
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva beheads Ganesh after being enraged by his actions. All the gods are worried about how goddess Parvati will react when she finds out about this. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Signs off inauspicious
episodesList.summary: Goddess Parvati finds out that Lord Shiva was the one who ended Ganesh's life. Will Lord Shiva be able to handle this situation before things get out of hand?

episodesList.title: Maa Adi Shakti's revenge!
episodesList.summary: Goddess Parvati takes on the form of Adi Shakti and threatens to destroy the universe. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The differents forms of Maa Parvati!
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati loses control of herself and summons all her divine forms. How will the Devtas deal with her anger?

episodesList.title: Shiv and Shakti
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva manages to reason with Goddess Parvati and stops her from destroying the universe. However, she asks Lord Shiva to revive Ganesh in return. Will Lord Shiva accept her demand?

episodesList.title: The birth of Gajanan
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva sends the Devtas in search of a new head for Ganesh that will help revive him. Will they succeed in this mission?

episodesList.title: The new look of Ganesh
episodesList.summary: Ganesh gets brought back to life with the head of an elephant. However, goddess Parvati finds it difficult to accept Ganesh in his new form. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The story behind the birth of Gadur
episodesList.summary: Lord Ganesh appears before Garud and delivers a special message on Lord Vishnu's behalf. What will this message be?

episodesList.title: Humility of the Lord
episodesList.summary: Garud is in awe of Lord Vishnu living selflessly in his devotee's house. How will this learning experience be for Garud?

episodesList.title: Navratri's story
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi offer their prayers to Maa Lalita. Later, Lord Vishnu tells Garud the story behind the festival of Navratri.

episodesList.title: Sati's birth
episodesList.summary: Maa Adi Shakti takes birth as Prajapati Daksh's daughter, Sati. Even though Prajapati Daksh doesn't respect Lord Shiva, Sati has always been his loyal devotee since childhood. But how will Sati's devotion impact her relationship?

episodesList.title: Sati's devotion
episodesList.summary: Sati's devotion toward Lord Shiva grows strong by the day. However, Daksh finds out about Sati's devotion and he decides to remove the Shiv Linga from her room.

episodesList.title: Dharm gathering
episodesList.summary: Daksh disrespects Lord Shiva during the Dharam Sabha and curses him and his followers. How will Lord Shiva respond to him?

episodesList.title: Sati's Swayamvar
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva answers Sati's prayers and agrees to marry her. But will Sati's father, Prajapati Daksh, accept their marriage?

episodesList.title: The power of Sati's love
episodesList.summary: Sati declares her love for Lord Shiva in front of everyone at the Swayamvar. Will Lord Shiva keep his promise to Sati and marry her?

episodesList.title: The great offering ceremony of Prajapati Daksha
episodesList.summary: Sati takes her first steps at Kailash Parvat. Meanwhile, Daksh decides to get back at Lord Shiva for taking his daughter away from him.

episodesList.title: The insult of Sati
episodesList.summary: Sati arrives at the Yagya without being invited by Daksh. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Sacrifice of Satie
episodesList.summary: After Daksh insults Sati and disrespects Lord Shiva, Sati decides to self-immolate. What will happen when Lord Shiva finds out about her sacrifice?

episodesList.title: The arrogance of Prajapati Daksha
episodesList.summary: Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu warn Daksh about his impending doom. Meanwhile, Nandi finds out about what happened to Sati and he decides to confront Daksh himself.

episodesList.title: The fierce form of Baghvan Shiva
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva is seething with anger when he learns about what happened to Sati. He sends his two avatars, Veerabhadra and Bhadrakali, to avenge Maa Sati and punish Daksh.

episodesList.title: The rage of  Veerabhadra
episodesList.summary: Veerabhadra goes on a rampage after slaying Daksh. Who will be able to stop him now?

episodesList.title: Tandav dance
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva gets enraged when he sees Sati's condition. What will happen once Lord Shiva begins his Tandav?

episodesList.title: Boon of Tarakasura
episodesList.summary: Brahma Dev answers Tarakasur's prayers and blesses him with immortality. Tarkasur goes on a rampage and wreaks havoc on Earth. Who will be able to stop him?

episodesList.title: Maa Shailputri's story
episodesList.summary: Garud finds out the real reason why Lord Vishnu came to Earth. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu and Goddess Parvati begin narrating the story of Maa Shailputri.

episodesList.title: Mitrata's test
episodesList.summary: Shailputri selflessly serves and tends to Lord Shiva in the cave, even though Lord Shiva is unable to recognize her. Meanwhile, the Devtas decide to seek Kama Dev's help to hasten Lord Shiva and Shailputri's reunion.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's third eye.
episodesList.summary: Lord Indra's plan to ask Kama Dev to shoot his 'Kama baan' backfires on him as Mahadev gets furious and opens his third eye. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Rati Begs For Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Rati, Kama Dev's wife, begs Mata Adi Shakti to bring her husband to life. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu tries to explain to Mahadev that his reunion with Maa Parvati should happen as soon as possible before Tarakasur destroys the entire universe.

episodesList.title: Parvati's test.
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva decides to test Parvati before agreeing to marry her. Will Parvati pass the test?

episodesList.title: The result of Penance
episodesList.summary: Tarakasur sends his Asuras to wreak havoc on Earth and attack those who are not worshipping him. Meanwhile, Parvati finds a young boy who is in danger, and she decides to risk her life in order to save him.

episodesList.title: The second test of Parvatie
episodesList.summary: Parvati successfully passes Lord Shiva's first test. But is she ready to face the tough challenges that lie ahead?

episodesList.title: The marriage of Shiva and Parvati.
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva finally reveals himself in front of Parvati and asks for her hand in marriage. Will Parvati accept the proposal?

episodesList.title: Kameshwar apparance
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva arrives at Parvati's doorstep with the Baarat. However, Parvati's mother gets terrified of Lord Shiva's appearance and denounces the marriage. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Devi Chandraghanta's Story.
episodesList.summary: After seeing Lord Shiva's Kameshwar Roop, Parvati's parents happily give their daughter away for marriage. Meanwhile, Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi begin narrating the story of Devi Chandraghanta.

episodesList.title: The glory of a home
episodesList.summary: Parvati arrives at Kailash along with Lord Shiva and his devotees. Meanwhile, Tarkasur sends his Asuras to slay Parvati.

episodesList.title: Maa Kushmanda's story
episodesList.summary: The state of Kailash significantly improves once Parvati starts to live there. Meanwhile, Shastri's sister mocks him and his wife about their son leaving them.

episodesList.title: Indra Dev's request
episodesList.summary: Lord Vishnu and Maa Lakshmi in disguise tell the tale of the birth of Lord Karthikeya to Garud. The Devtas are elated after the reunion of Maa Parvati and Mahadev. Indra dev imagines the consequences of the birth of Mahadev and Parvati's child. The devatas request Mahadev that the child they want should only have 'ansh' of Mahadev and not of Maa Parvati. Mahadev grants the wish to the devatas but Maa Parvati curses the Devatas about the same.

episodesList.title: Kartikeya's birth
episodesList.summary: Maa Lakshmi continues the tale of the birth of Lord Karthikeya to Garud. Mahadev grants the wish to the devatas that the child they want should only have 'ansh' of Mahadev and not of Maa Parvati. Mahadev's power gives birth to divine energy, the 'ansh' contains so much power and energy that neither of the 'devatas' is able to control and bear it. Maa Dharti and Maa Ganga also fail to bear the power of Mahadev's 'ansh'.

episodesList.title: Kartikeya's ability's
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati is worried for her son, Katikeya. She is fearing for his life. Mahadev reassures her but she can not shed her fears. The asuras are on the other hand, planning and scheming against Kartikeya. All of the gods are worried as well. Kartikeya however is winning and Mahadev and the rest of the gods are now relieved. Parvati Maa sees another looming danger over her son. How will Kartikeya come out of this problem?

episodesList.title: Happiness all over Kailash.
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati is worried for her son, Kartikeya. She is fearing for his life. Mahadev reassures her but she can not shed her fears. The asuras are on the other hand, planning and scheming against Kartikeya. The Lord wins the war and comes back to the Kailash as the 'devatas' and 'ghanas' celebrate the return of their Lord. Later, the 'devatas' offer their weapons to the son of Mahadev as gratitude for freeing them from the atrocities of Tarkasur.

episodesList.title: Kartikeya's education
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati starts the hard training of her son Kartikeya and everyone is shocked to see her in this avatar. They never imagined seeing a mother behaving in such a harsh manner with her child, but they are unaware of the real reason behind this. Maa Parvati and Kartikeya have a battle of wits when Lord Mahadev assists Kartikeya which upsets Maa Parvati as she believes that if they let their love for him overpower the purpose of the training it will be of no use.

episodesList.title: Asuron's proposition
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati has prepared her son Kartikeya for the war with the mighty Tarkasur. Kartikeya comes to heaven with the army of devatas as the 'Senapati' to face the demon. Tarkasur sends his son Tarakaksha to meet Kartikeya on the battlefield. Tarakaksha gives a proposal that the demons have no idea of getting involved in a war as they want peace with the devatas. Lord Indra attacks the demon army as the army of Tarkasur runs back to heaven to initiate their plan. The demons catch all the devatas and the army in their 'maaya' as they enter heaven, how will Kartikeya manage to save his army?

episodesList.title: Tarkasur trap!
episodesList.summary: As the "Senapati," Kartikeya travels to heaven with an army of devas to battle the demon. As the devatas and the soldiers enter heaven, the demons trap them all in their "Maaya." Kartikeya thinks back to her mother Parvati, who is known as "Yogmaaya" and is the mother of all "Maaya." Kartikeya is helped by Maa Parvati, who explains the essence of "Maaya" to her. Kartikeya confronts the second son of Tarkasur after liberating all the devatas from the "Maayajaal." How will Kartikeya be able to triumph in battle?

episodesList.title: The secret off the Charan Kamal
episodesList.summary: Kartikeya was forced to make a hard choice between his mother and the world. Kartikeya learns the truth about Charan Kamal and how Tarkasur's life is connected to it. The wife of Tarkasur is warned by Lord Indra to persuade her husband to accept his defeat or else he will be slain by the powerful Kartikeya. The Lord kills Tarkasur on the battlefield after destroying Charan Kamal's flower.

episodesList.title: Maa Katyayani's Story
episodesList.summary: Mahishasur swears to exterminate the devatas for destroying his family. He recalls his parents' instructions to him to get revenge on Lord Indra for their passing. In order to obtain justice from the devatas and aid Mahishasur in the conquest of the world, Guru Shukracharya decides to do so. Mahishasur is instructed by Guru Shukracharya to pray to Lord Brahma in order to gain more power. What will the gods, including Lord Indra, do?

episodesList.title: The right of existence of woman
episodesList.summary: Mahishasur enters a profound penance as Guru Shukracharya instructs him to pray to Lord Brahma in order to earn more power. He receives the blessing of immortality from Lord Brahma, with no man or creature on earth or in heaven ever being the cause of his demise. The mother of all, Maa Parvati, believes that Mahishasur will bring disaster to the earth and that she should take action as soon as possible to destroy him.

episodesList.title: Signs of trouble
episodesList.summary: The "devatas" travel to Kailash to meet Lord Shiva and request his assistance because Mahishasur has begun carrying out his atrocities since receiving the boon. Mahishasur brings destruction to the planet, but Maa Parvati has already made measures to eliminate him as quickly as possible. She leaves Kailash in order to engage in penance in order to awaken her "Shakti" since she is so furious at how he has been treating and taking advantage of women. Mahishasur discovers that the devatas are plotting to destroy him, and he intends to wage battle against them.

episodesList.title: Mata Parvaati's New Incarmation
episodesList.summary: Vishnu has reached the battleground and the Gods have praised that the lord will save them. When Lord Vishnu attacks Mahishasur, and he falls down to the ground everyone believes that the terror of the demons is already over. But Mahishasur again wakes up and claims that he won't be put down at any cost. Mahishaur then challenges Vishnu. Lord Vishnu attacks and the fight continues. Mata Parvati is in meditation and everyone is waiting for her new avatar as she will be the one who finished Mahishasur. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Sansaar Ki Sewa
episodesList.summary: The 'Tridev' and other devatas visit Maa Katyayani's home to inform her of her destiny. They also inform the girl's father that the little girl's child is Maa Katyayani herself who has incarnated to kill the demon. Maa Parvati comes as an earthly incarnation to put an end to the atrocities committed by the powerful demon Mahishahsur. The Lords provide Maa Katyayani with their aid and weapons; Lord Vishnu gives Mata his Sudarshan Chakra, while Lord Brahma offers her a ferocious lion to mount. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: The arrogance of Mahishasur
episodesList.summary: Mata Katyayani is combing her hair when the army of asur comes to her. They proceed to move toward her when Mata Katyayani's lion defends her. The asurs are scared and Mata Katyayani asks them to go away and tell their leader to back off. The army of asurs agrees and asks her to forgive them. The asurs also ask her to request her lion to not harm them and Mata Katyayani agrees. Watch the full episode to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: The army of Maa Katyayani
episodesList.summary: Mahishasur summons Maa Katyayani's army to the battleground with his army. Mahishasur ridicules and bullies Maa Katyayani's troops by upholding patriarchal social norms; he views women as helpless and only suitable for domestic duties. As they defeat the army of demons, the army of Mahishasur encounters the wrath of Maa Katyayani. What is the demon king's likely outcome?

episodesList.title: Mahishasur death
episodesList.summary: As the army of maa Katyayani defeats the army of demons, Mahishasur encounters the wrath of Maa Katyayani. He thinks himself to be immortal by the boon of Lord Brahma but the clause of women was never added to the boon. She makes him understand the value of women in every person's life and restores the order of the world by ending his atrocities. All the devatas wish luck and greet Maa Katyayani for helping them.

episodesList.title: Maa Mahagauri's story
episodesList.summary: As she becomes preoccupied with the every day home chores after returning to Kailash, Maa Parvati begins to lose sight of her life's purpose. When Mahadev sees Maa Parvati, he becomes anxious and considers several strategies to remind her of the holy purpose. Lord Vishnu and Maa Lakshmi are given 'darshan' by Shakti. She assures them that because the couple has always been faithful to God, they will receive what they desire.

episodesList.title: Parvati's New incarnation
episodesList.summary: Garud proceeds to hear the story of Devi Parvati as a lady makes fun of Devi Parvati for meditating instead of just demanding it from the universe. Ma Lakshmi gets a bit angry at her but Vishnu proceeds t tell the tale. Ma Parvati goes to meditate in the forest where she meets a lion. The lion tries to attack her but gets spellbound by her aura. Later, Lord Brahma comes to see Ma Parvati and fulfills her wish.

episodesList.title: The start of the story of Maa Sidhidharti
episodesList.summary: The couples listen as Maa Laksmi tells them the tale of Maa Siddhiratri. Since girls are incarnations of the Shakti, Lord Vishnu promises that they will eat after feeding and taking care of the girls. As the demons are now compelled to live the "Patal Lok," the devatas get egotistical about their power. Maa Parvati intends to impart lessons because she is concerned that their egos may upset the harmony of the natural world.

episodesList.title: The worship of pure celestial girl.
episodesList.summary: Maa Parvati intends to impart lessons because she is concerned that the egos of the devatas may upset the harmony of the natural world. She challenges the devatas to move a small leaf from its place, the devatas use their energy to shift the leaf from its place but their efforts are all in vain. The devatas realize the power of the lady and ask her to give them ' darshan' in her original form. Maa Sidhidharti occurs in front of them and blesses them, the Tridev also gives 'darshan' to the devatas and tells them that Shakti is the only one behind the energy of the universe.

episodesList.title: The return of the son.
episodesList.summary: Maa Lakshmi is serving Lord Vishnu when a young saint comes to her. Upon asking about her identity she reminds him about his parents who are growing old. Maa Lakshmi debates with him that how can he attain salvation when he is not taking care of his old parents? The young saint realizes his mistake and goes back to his parents. On the other hand, there is no sight of little girls for the puja. Will Maa Lakshmi help her to break her fast?

episodesList.title: Prabhu Narayan's plot
episodesList.summary: With Maa Shakti's blessings, Shastri Ji and his family are relieved to have their son back. However, Shatri's sister suffers a paralytic attack as a result of her terrible perspective on her brother's life. She begs Shakti for forgiveness for her sinful actions and expresses regret to Maa Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu. After granting Shastri Ji his blessing, Lord Vishnu and Maa Lakshmi return to Vaikunth. Garud is anxious to give a ride to Lord Vishnu into the world, as her mother had always intended for him to do it.

episodesList.title: The curse of Jay and Vijay
episodesList.summary: Jaya and Vijaya have been cursed by the Brahmacharis, they plead with the Lord Vishnu for leniency. When Lord Vishnu asks the Brahmacharis to provide them peace, he gives Jaya and Vijaya a decision. Before returning to Vaikuntha, he tells them that they might either become his friends for the following six years or his foes for the following three. Jaya and Vijaya decide on a period of three years, Maa Lakshmi further tells the story of how the two Lord's servants transform into various demons over the yugas.

episodesList.title: Varaha incarnation's story
episodesList.summary: Jay and Vijay decide for three years to become the enemy of Narayan and come to Vaikuntha, Maa Lakshmi further tells the story of how the two Lord's servants transform into various demons over the yugas. She describes how Hiranyaksha was wreaking havoc on the earth. The Varaha avatar of Lord Vishnu smells and finds the earth beneath the ocean, and he rescues Bhumedevi from the cosmic waves of the ocean.

episodesList.title: Hiranyakashipu's penance
episodesList.summary: When two apsaras fail to break the meditation, Dev Raj Indra decides to use force. He calls for Agni Dev, Vayu Dev, and Jal Dev to use their powers so that they can break the meditation of the devotee who is chanting lord Brahma Dev's name. Each of the God tries their best and use their powers but some unforeseen powers protect the devotee. Garud is saddened to hear that Indra Dev will cause harm to someone innocent. He cannot believe that such kind of behavior is being depicted by them.

episodesList.title: The birth of Prahlad, Hiranyakashipu's son.
episodesList.summary: Brahma Ji is pleased with Hiranyakashipu's devotion towards himself and decides to give him his blessings. But Hiranyakashipu asks for immorality which is not possible. Then Hiranyakashipu uses his wit and decides to twist his boon which makes him very difficult to demolish. Brahma Ji decides to give it to him.

episodesList.title: Prahlad's devotion
episodesList.summary: Hiranyakashipu's devotion towards Brahma Ji wins him a boon that is impossible to break. Hiranyakashipu gets worried as his wife tells him about the odd behavior of their son Prahlad. Hiranyakashipu plans to send Prahlad to Gurukul to help him become an able ruler, he calls the 'Guruputras' and orders them to assist his son. The 'Guruputras' find out about the devotion of Prahlad, how will they react to it?

episodesList.title: Prahlad's education.
episodesList.summary: The "Guruputras" learn about Prahlad's dedication to Lord Vishnu, and Prahlad leads other Gurukul students down the same devotional path. Hiranyakashipu instructs his soldiers to contact Prahlad and the Guru Putra to find out what knowledge and abilities his son has acquired over time. He longs to see his darling son and misses him as well. Watch the episode to know more

episodesList.title: Prahlad's education
episodesList.summary: Hiranyakashipu orders his soldiers to jail his son Prahlad as he has become a devotee of Lord Vishnu. Prahlad calls for Lord Vishnu as the soldiers try to beat him, Lord Vishnu comes to his rescue and frees him and other devotees from jail. Hiranyakashipu is shocked to hear about the situation at the jail, Prahlad confronts his father and tells him of being innocent.

episodesList.title: Prahlad receives aid and blessings.
episodesList.summary: Hiranyakashipu is ready to sacrifice his son as he is adamant about not following his father's orders and leaving the devotion of Narayan. Hiranyakashipu orders his soldiers to get his son Prahlad crushed under the feet of an elephant. Prahlad prays to Lord Vishnu to help him, Lord Vishnu controls the elephant and saves his biggest 'Bhakt'.

episodesList.title: The story of Holika burning
episodesList.summary: Hiranyakashipu goes to meet his sister "Holika". Holika comes out of a pyre and asks her brother about his reason of visit. Hiranyakashipu tells her about the person she has to kill and she wonders who he couldn't defeat? When the king answers that it is his son that she is to kill, Holika demands an explanation. In the end, Holika agrees to kill Prahlad who still doesn't abide by his father's rules and is ready to sit on a pyre with Holika.

episodesList.title: The story of Narasimha incarnation.
episodesList.summary: Hiranyakashipu is frustrated because he has tried everything to teach Prahlad a lesson, but he is unable to do so because Prahlad continues to pray and has a tremendous devotion to Narayan. Hiranyakashipu has a disagreement with Prahlad concerning the presence of Lord Vishnu and makes preparations to kill Prahlad himself. Prahlad claims that when he was still in his mother's womb, Narad Muni saved his mother from being abducted by Lord Indra. He claims to have gained devotional training in Narad Muni's ashram. The Narsimha avatar of Narayan comes via the pillar as Hiranyakashipu prepares to slay Prahlad.

episodesList.title: Lord Shree Narayan's transport.
episodesList.summary: As Maa completes the story of Narasimha's avatar(incarnation), Garud is moved and is feeling motivated by such devotion. He pleads with Maa to tell more stories of Lord Visnu and his various avatars as he wants to know more about him. Maa one by one narrates the story of different avatars of Lord Vishnu and how he was with his devotees throughout. Next, we see Lord Ganesh narrating the story of Garud and his significance in the world. Garud is feeling anxious as he wants to become Lord Vishnu's ride and is waiting eagerly for it. But it seems someone is calling for help! Who is it?

plotHtml: The story begins with Garud coming to meet his mother, Vinataa. They share a very good bond and have a great love for each other. Garud hates his Naag (Snake) Brothers and his maternal aunt Queen Kadru who ill-treats his mother Vinata. He always tries to know how his mother became Kadru's slave. Vinata gets scared because of the snakes, especially Kaaliya, and Garud comes to save her and shows his ultimate power to the Snakes and Kadru. However, Vinata cools Garud. Vinata then teaches Garud how to stay calm and several important life lessons. Garud asks his mother how to reach Vaikunth, and she tells him. He goes there on the pretext of freeing his mother from slavery and knowing what actually happened. After a series of incidents, he encounters Shesh Naag, who tells him about Vinata and Kadru's past but doesn't know how Vinata became Kadru's slave. He tells him to meet Aditi Maa, the God's mother, to know what really happened. He goes there. He fights the Asura Army who came to kill Aditi Maa and succeeds. To save her children, Diti Maa promises to tell how Vinata became Kadru's slave. Garud goes back and asks Kadru if what she had done was right or not. Her children get angry, and a fight is started between Garud and the Snakes. As a punishment, Garud is made Kadru and her children's slaves. However, Rahu arrives and asks for Garud. Kadru denies to which Rahu retaliates by insulting Kadru. After seeing that Rahu is insulting their mother Takshaka, Kaaliya, and their brothers fight alongside Garud against Rahu and his army. Seeing this, Kadru orders Garud to take her to Maharaj Bali and tells her sons to take care of Garud's mother, Vinata. Rahu notices that Garud along with Kadru is flying away. He then divides himself into two, and one goes behind Garud to see where he is going. They meet Maharaj Bali and convince him to stop the war. The fight is stopped with Kadru praising her sons and Garud wondering why Kadru protected him. Garud is then given a task by Kadru: Get the Suryaphool. Garud, accompanied by his Brothers, accidentally reached Shani Loka, where he is tested and passed. Shani Dev gets angry at the Naag Brothers and they all fall down. Garud doesn't recognise any of the Naag Brothers falling down and gets the Suryaphool. Kadru gets angry and curses Garud. Vinata and Garud pray to Vishnu to prove Garud innocent. Vishnu awakes from his meditation and tells Garud that he will face a lot of trouble and that he will be a part of something big in his life. Lord Vishnu then tells Goddess Aditi, who is meditating, that good times will come again for the deities. Goddess Aditi comes to find Garuda who helped her, and with Kadru's approval, she goes with Garuda to find her children. Lord Vishnu tells about Samudra Manthana and Garuda lifting the Mandaraachal mountain and placing it in the ocean of milk. Here, Garuda gets his stepbrother, Vasuki Naag, to be the rope for Sagara Manthan. Gods and Asuras jointly perform these tasks and share the ratnas that descend there. During these events, a surprising event occurs in Vinata's household. Vinata went to the forest one day to collect firewood and met an old Baba who took him to her house and took care of him by giving him food. Later he proves to be sage Dattatreya and he blesses Vinata. At that time, signs of Lakshmi's arrival appear through Sagara Manthan. The arrival of Goddess Lakshmi takes place through the ocean, followed by the marriage of Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi. Aditi, Diti, Kadru and Vinata also participate in this. Vinata won everyone's favour there. Garuda's devotion is also praised by Lakshmi Narayan. The marriage ends and the Sagara manthana begins again where Amrita emerges. The Asuras, by trickery, steal the Amrit and the Devata's follow them. Vishnu takes the form of Mohini to trick the Asuras. Goddess Mohini gives Amrita to gods. Indra's son Jayanta keeps the Amrita in a safe place. Later Garuda returns to his mother. Under the guidance of Lord Vishnu, Garuda learns from Nar and Narayan. For this, the blessings of Ganesha and Goddess Saraswati are received and Garud gets a new task. Then Kadru says that if Amrita kalasha is placed before her, Vinata and Garuda will be freed from slavery. Garuda goes to Indra Lok and defeats Indra and brings the nectar. On the way, Vishnu is ready to punish Garud but Lakshmi stops him. He then tells Indra to take the Amrit after Garud and Vinata received freedom. They both received freedom. Vishnu tells Kadru that all her sons will be food for birds like Garud in the future. Everyone decides to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi and Nar Narayan decides to tell the story of Lord Ganesh. Ganesh sends Mushak to see what his mother is preparing for him. Mushak gets caught by Kartikeya. All the Gods and Goddesses arrive and wish Ganesh. Kadru arrives and asks forgiveness from Vinata and Garud, being totally reformed. Nar Narayan tells the story of Ganesh from where His mother wanted a son like Vishnu's avatar, Krishna. Vishnu arrives and blesses her. But, Mahadev goes to bless 2 Demons, thus missing the chance of seeing his son. Very soon, Parvati gives birth to a son. She tells him to not let anyone come in until the time she finishes her meditation. However, when Mahadev returns and Ganesh stops him and he gets angry and cuts Ganesh's head. All of them realise who Ganesh is. Parvati realises what had happened and swears to destroy everything but Mahadev gives life to Ganesh with an elephant head. Parvati at first refuses to accept him but later accepts him. Ganesh arrives at the end of the story and gives Garud the good news that he is going to be Vishnu's vahak. Garud gets extremely happy and goes to Vaikunth. Vishnu tells Garud to lift his finger but he falls down and as a result, he loses his powers and to regain his powers and become Vishnu's Vahaan, they take a human form to complete a mission. They go to help Shastri and her husband to find their missing son by narrating the tale of Maa Parvati and all of her nine avatar's. With each passing day, both Garud and Shastri get the blessings. Their greedy sister tries to take control of the house. At the 10th day, their son returns and the greedy sister realises her mistakes. Vishnu, Lakshmi and Garud return to Vaikunth. Maa Lakshmi tells the story of 'Bhaktha Pralhad' and Narasimha Avatar of Vishnu. Later Gajendra calls for help and Garud finally gets to be Vishnu's Vahaan. They help Gajendra and the Devta's hail the name of Vishnu and Garud.

title: Dancing Champion
summary: Dancing Champion is a Kannada dance reality show aired on  Colors Kannada and streamed on Voot. It features celebrities as contestants who are paired with professional dancers competing for a cash prize and the title Dancing Champion. The judges of the show are Mayuri Upadhya, Vijay Raghavendra and Meghana Raj. The show is hosted by Akul Balaji. The show premiered on 8 January 2022.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The show is a competition where a 14 celebrities are paired with exceptionally talented common people, handpicked from all across Karnataka. Well-known faces & fresh ones pair-up for a phenomenal dance-off. Contestants dance to a different tune, different theme and different styles every week and scores are given by the judges. Each week one couple is eliminated based on their scores with only one pair having the chance to be finally crowned, Dancing Champion. The show is produced by actor Srujan Lokesh under his banner Lokesh Productions.

title: Decoupled
summary: Decoupled is an Indian English-language comedy television series created and written by Manu Joseph for Netflix and directed by Hardik Mehta. The series stars R. Madhavan and Surveen Chawla in the lead roles.
plot: A misanthropic writer and his startup-founder wife juggle their impending divorce with the absurdities and annoyances of life in their affluent world.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The series opened to mixed review from critics, though the performances of the lead pair received praise. The show's creator, Manu Joseph, subsequently noted that 'liberal media' outlets targeted the show.
Within three days of release, the series became the leading Indian series on the platform of the week.

title: Dhadkan Zindaggi Kii
summary: Dhadkan Zindaggi Kii (transl. HeartBeat Of Life) is an Indian medical drama television series that stars Additi Gupta, Rohit Purohit, Vidyut Xavier as the main protagonists with Alma Hussein, Nishant Singh, Raghav Dhirr, Kaushik Chakravorty and Ashwin Mushran as the supporting cast. The show aired from 6 December 2021 to 4 March 2022 on Sony Entertainment Television and was produced by Nilanjana Purkayasstha under Invictus T Mediaworks.
plot:
Dr. Deepika Sinha, a beacon of dedication and passion for medicine, has gracefully assumed the role of Chief Resident at F.M.S Hospital. Her unwavering commitment to her profession has led her to leave behind the comforts of family and love. Tasked with guiding a team of junior residents – the spirited Abhay, vivacious Sia, scholarly Piroz, and ambitious Wasim – Dr. Sinha's journey unfolds amidst a tapestry of dreams, challenges, and unexpected connections.
Abhay, nursing a complex resentment towards his father, aspires to become a Cardiothoracic surgeon. Sia, a lively heiress, dreams of becoming a plastic surgeon. Piroz, a medical prodigy yearning for companionship, has yet to decide on his specialization. Wasim, hailing from humble origins, seeks to dispel judgments quickly formed and dreams of establishing a clinic in his slum.
Amid the collaborative efforts of this diverse team, Dr. Sinha forges deep connections, especially with Abhay, who finds himself captivated by her. As the hospital establishes an Emergency department, Dr. Sinha is confronted with her past when her ex-fiancé, Dr. Vikrant Saxena, assumes the role of ER head. A tumultuous affair ensues, causing ripples of discomfort, especially for Aditi, Vikrant's wife.
Despite the emotional turmoil, Deepika navigates through the complexities of her personal and professional life. Aditi's tragic demise becomes a turning point, with Vikrant blaming Deepika and suffering from PTSD. A new friendship blossoms between Deepika and Nikhil Sardesai, a patient who aids in restoring her lost confidence. The duo's camaraderie evolves, leading Deepika to become the new ER head.
As relationships intertwine and evolve, Deepika decides to take a chance on love with Nikhil, juggling the delicate balance between work and personal life. Vikrant, burdened by guilt, eventually leaves his medical career. Abhay and Wasim embark on new paths, while Piroz finds love in Isha, a fellow resident. Sia discovers solace in Dr. Sameer Roy after failed relationships.
With the arrival of new residents and the recovery of Vikrant, the story unfolds with resilience and determination. Deepika, overcoming hurdles, efficiently manages the ER. Letting go of her past, she embraces a fresh start, culminating in a joyous union with Nikhil. Their marriage becomes a celebration of resilience, inspiring those around them to pursue and achieve their dreams. The show concludes with a jubilant dance, symbolizing triumph over challenges and the enduring spirit of pursuing one's aspirations.
reception: Dhadkan Zindaggi Kii received generally positive reviews from critics. Srividya Rajesh of IWM Buzz gave the show 4 out of 5 stars, praising the characters' backstories and the depiction of female doctors in a medical setting, though she questioned the hour-long duration of each episode. In a review of the first episode for Pinkvilla, Rasika Deshpande similarly felt that the show's strength was its focus on women's empowerment and applauded the performances of Gupta and Xavier. Telly Express described the show as a "natural and smooth drama" and gave it 4.3 out of 5 stars.

articleSections.text: Additi Gupta as Dr. Deepika Sinha Sardesai: Senior surgeon; former chief resident and new ER head; Vikrant's ex-fianceé and love interest; Abhay's close friend and Nikhil's wife. * Rohit Purohit as Dr. Vikrant Saxena: Senior surgeon and former ER head; Deepika's ex fiancé and love interest; Aditi's widower; Suman's brother *Vidyut Xavier as Dr. Abhay Sathe: Surgeon and junior resident; Sia's ex-boyfriend; Deepika's unrequited lover.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Dhadkan is a spin-off of the 2002 series of the same name. The series was initially planned with 65 episodes, but later was extended by ten more episodes, for a total of 75 episodes till 4 March.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Additi Gupta, Rohit Purohit and Vidyut Xavier were cast as the leads. In May 2021, Ashwin Mushran and Kaushik Chakravorty were confirmed to be cast in main roles. Later that month, Alma Hussein, Raghav Dhirr and Nishant Singh joined the cast.
During the latter part of the show, Meghna Kukreja, Sid Makkar and Krishna Shetty joined the show in pivotal roles.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
Principal photography commenced in June 2021 with the lead actors in Mumbai.
Lead actors Additi Gupta and Rohit Purohit announced the wrap up of "Dhadkan Zindaggi Kii" in Mumbai through an Instagram post on 1 February 2022.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Dhadkan Zindaggi Kii was a long-awaited project on Sony Entertainment Television. The first promo of the show was unveiled on 11 November 2021, featuring the protagonists and revealing its release date. It started telecasting from 6 December 2021 at the 10:00 PM time-slot by replacing Kaun Banega Crorepati Season 13.
