episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: While traveling to Ujjain with her friends, Jhanvi is startled by a beautiful girl who asks her for her book titled 'How to recognize a witch'. A rational girl by heart, Jhanvi is surprised at having a nightmare about falling into a pit full of lizards. Later, Jhanvi is shocked to learn her identity as Kundani Roy. Akarsh Chaudhry, the owner of Hotel Fort Ujjain, is stunned to see Jhanvi. The same night, Shryance is kidnapped by a witch. Elsewhere, Jhanvi is unaware of a lizard following her.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi tells Shreyansh’s mother he was carried away by a witch. Nobody believes her. Prithvi, her cousin thinks she is hallucinating due to drug abuse. Vijayesh, her uncle says they were visited by a witch and he believes Jhanvi’s story. Veer on his way to the station is attacked by lizards. Veer returns with Shreyansh and says he found him in a well. He has a tattooed moving lizard on his back. Jhanvi sees Veer’s corpse in the jungle.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: After seeing Veer convert into a witch, Jhanvi falls off the cliff and hangs on the tree. The witch sees the lizards and disappears, while Akarsh rescues Jhanvi. Later, Jhanvi finds a barely alive Veer in the jungle. Prithvi blames Veer for the happenings at their house. Vikram, Jhanvi’s cousin, takes them to his hotel to see Kundini Roy’s shooting who is a complete lookalike of Jhanvi. Akarsh introduces Chandrika, the girl from the train, as his restoration expert.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi realizes that she gets goosebumps every time Chandrika appears near her. Shreyansh tries to attack Jhanvi but is soon captured by Akarsh. Chandrika tells Jhanvi that the portrait of the beautiful woman belongs to Chandravati Devi, the queen of the palace, who was also a witch. Jhanvi and Vijayesh bring Shreyansh home to find out the truth about Chandrika. When a neighbor calls Jhanvi a witch’s sister, she gets confused by all the stories surrounding her family.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Arriving at Akarsh’s hotel for lunch, Jhanvi sets out to ascertain Chandrika’s status as a witch by implementing Vijayesh’s plan. She is unsuccessful in doing so because Kundani gets injured at the same time by a falling chandelier. Jhanvi’s curiosity is piqued by the book, 'Daayan ki Pehchaan', which Kundani was pointing at, but it gets destroyed. Upon being plagued by the dream featuring the witch and the children, Jhanvi wishes to continue staying in Ujjain to unravel the mystery behind it.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: The events of the bus prompt Jhanvi to stay back in Ujjain and accept Kundani’s part in the film. During the shoot, Chandrika’s arrival fears Jhanvi. This fear is further fuelled when Jhanvi gets trapped in a ring of fire and spots the painting as well as the boy from the dream in front of her. Later, Jhanvi confronts the boy, Babloo, and lures his orphanage’s caretaker to let him stay with her. The details of Babloo’s dream give Jhanvi the hope of solving the mystery surrounding the witch soon.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: When Jhanvi is at the shoot, Shreyansh confronts Babloo and accuses Jhanvi of being the witch. Babloo defies Shreyansh, but his ominous warnings plague him. During the night, Babloo sees the witch in the house. In a rush to get away, Babloo bangs into Jananta. While the Morya family is at the hospital, alone Babloo is lured away by the witch. Later, the police arrest Jhanvi for keeping Babloo in the house against his will. On the way from jail in Akarsh’s car, some strange events take place.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Mysterious events trouble Jhanvi on the way home. The events surrounding Jhanvi, prompt Narendra to hold a prayer in the house. Preparations for Harsh and Jananta’s anniversary party also begin. Spurred upon finding the black puppet used to control someone, Vijayesh and Jhanvi plan to find the person in the house aiding the witch. To bring the plan to fruition and find the witch’s identity as well, Shreyansh’s presence is necessary. Jhanvi pleads with Suman to attend the party with Shreyansh.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Upon reaching the hospital, the Moryas and Akarsh are informed about Jhanvi’s death and also about it possibly being a murder. Ecstatic at Jhanvi no longer being a hindrance in her plans, Nandini sees Jhanvi’s ghost and gets scared. In reality, it was Kundani who had died, and Jhanvi and Veer had conspired to fake Jhanvi’s death to get Nandini’s true identity and motives in light. Veer and Jhanvi try to scare Nandini into confession before she gets married to Akarsh on the night of the full moon.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Shocking everyone, Jhanvi gets married to Akarsh. Nandini tells everybody about Jhanvi faking her death. Angered upon being cheated, Akarsh leaves, and Narendra breaks all ties with Jhanvi. While Menaka, Akarsh’s mother, is welcoming her into the house, Jhanvi leaves to confront the witch with the magical ‘Mangal Sutra. Some confounding events later, Jhanvi wakes up in Akarsh’s room with her ‘mangal sutra missing. With the help of a guard, she finds it but faints due to a sudden headache.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Through Vijayesh, Jhanvi realises that the witch is injured, but will try to replenish her powers soon. Veer, who evades arrest due to Akarsh’s help, advises Jhanvi to confess the truth about the witch to Akarsh. Veer and Jhanvi come across the girl from her dream, Rimpy, and realize that she is Jhanvi’s dead sister, Maanvi’s daughter. Dipank, Maanvi’s husband, reveals some truths about her life which shock Jhanvi. With Dipank’s help, Jhanvi goes to a cave to confront and kill the witch.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi calls Akarsh to apologize for the past events. Moved by her words, Akarsh arrives at the Moryas' and takes Jhanvi back before a ‘puja’ held for her could complete. When Nandini is found dead, Jhanvi thinks she may have killed her under the witch’s influence. She confesses to the police and gets arrested. Incarcerated in a mental facility, Jhanvi’s fellow inmate, Mai, rescues her from the witch’s control and suggests a solution. She also tells Jhanvi about the ‘mangal sutra’ being fake.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Taking help from ‘Paatalini’, guardian of the underworld, Jhanvi frees herself from the witch’s control. Realising that Akarsh took the blame of killing Nandini upon himself, she vows to get him out of jail soon. The witch asks Jhanvi for a boy, Amrit, who is Mai’s grandson and guarded from her, in return for an alive Nandini. However, Jhanvi figures out a way to deal with her without jeopardizing Amrit. Before Akarsh could be released, news of him being in the hospital shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: A worried Jhanvi is told by Mai’s spirit about a red stone in the palace, which when touched to Amrit’s talisman could save Akarsh. Veer, who hears Nandini plotting to kill Jhanvi, is rendered unconscious by Chandrika before he could warn Jhanvi about it. Getting a hold of Amrit, Jhanvi takes him to the stone. However, when his talisman touches the stone, it gets absorbed. Though Akarsh gets better, Jhanvi realizes how she was fooled by the witch, who now has gained control over Amrit.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Some events make Jhanvi suspicious of Akarsh’s Mama Ji and Mami, uncle and aunt. Before she could investigate further, Vijayesh, upon a tantric’s suggestion, throws Jhanvi in a well infested with snakes to kill the witch. Meanwhile, a disturbed Veer confronts Akarsh with Nandini’s evil intentions towards Jhanvi, but Chandrika’s intervention saves Nandini. Jhanvi goes to meet the tantric to know the reason for Vijayesh’s actions, but the witch kills him before he could reveal anything.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi organizes a party to celebrate the hotel’s first anniversary. The witch is seen taking hold of Amrit. Chandrika tries to kill Jhanvi but fails due to Veer. She and Nandini have the real ‘mangal sutra. They also discuss using Veer to kill Jhanvi to fulfill their suspicious motives. While searching for Amrit, Jhanvi comes across the witch in a secret tunnel. Veer and Prachi, who are looking for her, find her in an injured state. The witch tries to obstruct Jhanvi’s medical care but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Upon gaining consciousness, Jhanvi accuses Menaka to be the witch, but Akarsh dismisses her claims. To prove her point, Jhanvi takes Akarsh to inspect the secret tunnel but is shocked to see that it has disappeared. At night, Jhanvi tells Veer about the tunnel and her suspicion about Menaka. Menaka, who is spying on them, hears Jhanvi instruct Veer to keep an eye on her. Chandrika and Nandini plot to separate Akarsh and Jhanvi. During the ‘puja’ held for Menaka, some negative events take place.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: Though Jhanvi is unsuccessful in finding Amrit, she finds a mysterious key. When the Morya house catches fire, Akarsh helps Jhanvi escape. He and Menaka insist the Moryas stay at the palace. Chandrika cleverly invites Kundani Roy’s husband, Viraj, to separate the couple, though he seems unaware of her conspiracy. Jhanvi tells Veer to keep an eye on the crow they trapped, as it may lead them to Amrit. While procuring a magical flower, which could give the witch a life force, Amrit escapes.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: The witch catches Amrit and obtains the life-giving flower. Further, she tries to stop Jhanvi and Veer from using her crow to reach her. With Vijayesh’s help, Jhanvi gets some clues to the room where the witch is holding Amrit captive. Jhanvi once again blames Menaka for being the witch. Worried about Jhanvi’s paranoia, Akarsh consults a doctor. Meanwhile, Viraj brings the police to the palace and claims Jhanvi to be Kundani. He demands that Jhanvi undergo a DNA test to prove her identity.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Menaka frantically searches for the mysterious key. Veer lures Menaka with a fake key to figure out the location of the hidden door. Following Menaka, Jhanvi finds the door, only to be locked in by the witch. Viraj saves Jhanvi following which her DNA sample is taken. During the ‘puja’ leading to ‘Mahashivratri’, Vijayesh gives Jhanvi a ‘rudraksha’. Jhanvi and Veer sneak into the storeroom and find the witch waiting for them. The witch attacks them and takes back the key to the room.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: While celebrations for ‘Mahashivratri’ begin, Chandrika and Nandini continue with their efforts to separate Jhanvi and Akarsh. To know the location of the hidden door, Veer and Jhanvi scour the palace’s library for any clues. Along with the door’s location, they learn about an ancestor of Akarsh being married to the witch more than 500 years ago. Cleverly, Jhanvi and Veer gain back the key of the room and find the corpse of the same ancestor inside. They finally learn about the witch’s motives.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi learns the witch’s motive to sacrifice the children’s lives to bring Akarsh’s ancestor back to life. To stop her, she confides the events to everyone and takes them to the room, but finds the corpse replaced with Mama Ji’s dead body. Before Menaka could reveal the witch’s identity to Jhanvi, she dies. Proving Jhanvi to be Kundani, Viraj takes her away. To blindside Jhanvi, the witch changes the sacrificial ritual’s date. Veer and Vijayesh discover the witch’s plan and inform Jhanvi.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Menaka’s, Jhanvi’s and Mama Ji’s funerals are organised by Akarsh and the Moryas. Acting to be Kundani, Jhanvi gains Viraj’s trust to escape his scrutiny. She convinces him to take her back to the palace. Suspicious that either Akarsh or Asha could be a witch, Jhanvi vows to discover the truth. Jhanvi, Veer, and Vijayesh reach the witch’s secret cave guided by the clues left by Menaka. Armed with magical ashes, Jhanvi goes to distract the witch, giving Veer and Vijayesh a chance to save Amrit.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi saves Amrit from the witch and makes a futile attempt to set fire to the corpse. She reunites Amrit with his mother. Back at the palace, Jhanvi becomes convinced that Asha couldn’t be the witch. Her suspicion of Akarsh strengthens. After drugging Viraj, Jhanvi goes to save Janata’s new-born baby girl from becoming the witch’s prey. Vijayesh takes protective measures for Janata and her baby. The witch targets Prithvi and Vishakha. Jhanvi resolves to find if Akarsh is the witch or not.

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: During ‘Holi’ celebrations, Akarsh and Jhanvi apply colour to each other. A jealous Viraj tries to stake his claim on Jhanvi, but Akarsh thrashes him and throws him away. This display of strength convinces Veer and Vijayesh that Akarsh could be the witch. Meanwhile, the witch asks her superior’s help in making the king alive once again. She is suggested to look for a girl with some specific qualities to complete the ritual. Jhanvi learns about the witch’s search and vows to stop her.

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Prithvi strangles Jhanvi but Veer and Vijayesh arrive and save her. In an attempt to find out if Akarsh's truth, Veer and Vijayesh beat him up. But, afterward, Jhanvi is confident that Akarsh is not a witch and asks Veer to stay away from him. Later, an incident leaves the 'Trishul' mark on Rimpy's forehead. Prithvi and Vishakha try to capture Rimpy and deliver her to the witch to help her complete the ritual. Jhanvi, along with Veer and Vijayesh, tries to save Rimpy from the witch.

episodesList.title: Episode 32
episodesList.summary: Veer and Vijayesh guard Rimpy in the temple, so Prithvi devises a plan to get Rimpy out of the temple but fails. Later, Jhanvi and Veer decide to follow Prithvi and Vishakha, so that they can find the location of the king's dead body. Jhanvi and Veer are successful in moving the King's dead body out of its hidden location. Elsewhere, Akarsh comes inside the temple and abducts Rimpy. Later, the family desperately searches for Rimpy. Is Veer's suspicion about Akarsh being the witch correct?

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: Everyone searches for Rimpy but in vain. Later, Akarsh overhears the family talking about performing the funeral rites of the King and devises a plan to get King's dead body back.

episodesList.title: Episode 35
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi refuses to believe in Akarsh’s defense of the witch. The witch’s brother and Akarsh fail to prevent Jhanvi from immersing the king’s ashes in a holy river.

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi and Veer learn that Saptarupa – the one who knows about the ‘mani’, is caged in the red stone. On Prithvi’s insistence, Vijayesh tries to find a way to defeat Akarsh.

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: Akarsh gifts the red stone to Jhanvi on her birthday. Vijayesh conjures a dagger that can kill Akarsh. Jhanvi frees Saptarupa from the stone. Prithvi stabs Akarsh with the dagger.

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi tends to an injured Akarsh. The witch kills Jananta to force Jhanvi into revealing the ‘mani’s’ location. With Akarsh’s help, Jhanvi summons Saptarupa to find the ‘mani’.

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: the witch and her brother Kalnayani abduct Saptarupa and take her to 'Daayanlok'. Risking her life, Jhanvi arrives to rescue Saptrupa and discovers that she is about to kill Akarsh.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: Saptarupa promises to reveal the ‘mani’s’ location to Jhanvi in return of Akarsh. Kalnayani conspires to get Akarsh killed to become the sole heir to ‘Daayanlok’. Everyone is shocked when another supernatural force kills a man in the palace.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: Saptarupa saves a dying Akarsh. Later, Jhanvi, Veer, and Saptarupa go to the jungle to retrieve the 'mani'. Kalnayani and the witch follow Jhanvi. Elsewhere, Akarsh performs 'Kal Drishti Vidhi' to find out who is responsible for the recent deaths.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi successfully obtains the ‘mani’. Akarsh kills Kalnayani when he threatens Jhanvi’s life. Jhanvi goes back on her promise to Saptarupa. Saptarupa joins hands with the witch to take revenge from Jhanvi.

episodesList.title: Episode 46
episodesList.summary: The witch gets her hands on the ‘mani’ but is unable to activate its powers. Akarsh falls under Saptarupa’s enchantment and decides to marry her. Paatalini urges Jhanvi to stop the witch from attaining the ‘mani’s’ powers.

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: Pataalini gives a magical golden flower’s petals to Jhanvi to break Akarsh’s hypnotic state. Pataalini and the tantric attempt to foil the witch’s ritual to activate the ‘mani’s’ powers. Jhanvi faints when Akarsh’s and Saptarupa’s marriage concludes.

episodesList.title: Chandrika stabs Jhanvi to avenge Nandini’s death
episodesList.summary: To complete the ritual, the witch decides to kill Jhanvi to offer her as a sacrifice. Jhanvi decides to visit ‘Daayanlok’ to capture the witch’s powers in a magical mirror. Chandrika stabs Jhanvi to avenge Nandini’s death.

episodesList.title: The real face of the witch is revealed
episodesList.summary: Akarsh heals Jhanvi with his powers. Jhanvi finds the door to ‘Daayanlok’ and discovers that Asha is the witch. Veer gets into trouble with Prachi. Jhanvi fails to capture Asha and her powers in the magical mirror. Asha punishes Pataalini for helping Jhanvi.

episodesList.title: Jhanvi and Vijayesh trap Asha in the magical mirror
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi and Vijayesh trap Asha and her powers in the magical mirror. In distress, Asha calls for Saptarupa to save her before Vijayesh and Jhanvi could set the mirror ablaze in a temple.

episodesList.title: Asha traps Jhanvi and brings her to ‘Daayanlok’
episodesList.summary: Saptarupa frees Asha from the magical mirror. Asha traps Jhanvi and gets her to ‘Daayanlok’ to complete the ritual of immortality. After slashing Jhanvi’s feet with a sword, Asha reveals her plan to sacrifice all five senses of Jhanvi to become immortal.

episodesList.title: Asha becomes immortal
episodesList.summary: Asha captures Jhanvi’s senses and becomes immortal. Akarsh brings Jhanvi’s body back to the palace from ‘Daayanlok’. For Jhanvi’s sake, the Morya’s convince Akarsh to perform her last rights. As soon as he lights Jhanvi’s funeral pyre, Akarsh regains his memory.

episodesList.title: Vijayesh’s plan to resurrect Jhanvi
episodesList.summary: Asha banishes Akarsh from ‘Daayanlok’ as he attempts to kill her to avenge Jhanvi’s death. Vijayesh suggests using Jhanvi’s ashes to resurrect her, but Saptarupa takes them away. Prachi is able to get Jhanvi’s ashes back when Akarsh tricks Saptarupa.

episodesList.title: Akarsh performs the ritual to resurrect Jhanvi
episodesList.summary: By diverting Vaitalini’s attention, Akarsh gets the stones in which Jhanvi’s senses were captured. He then begins the ritual to resurrect Jhanvi in ‘Pataallok’. A weak Pataalini is aided by Saptarupa and Asha to save Akarsh when Vaitalini attempts to kill him.

episodesList.title: Saptarupa manipulates Harsh
episodesList.summary: Akarsh takes Jhanvi and disappears from the fight of the witches. Asha promises Akarsh that she will spare Jhanvi’s life if she doesn’t come in her way. Saptarupa manipulates Harsh to fulfil her motives.

episodesList.title: Akarsh finds a way to send Saptarupa back to her world
episodesList.summary: Jhanvi and her family begin with the preparations for Veer and Prachi's wedding. Akarsh finds a way to send Saptarupa back to her world. Veer is stunned by Prachi's strange behaviour. Asha is surprised on seeing Harsh calling out to her.

episodesList.title: Saptarupa evades being captured by Akarsh
episodesList.summary: Before Akarsh could capture another form of Saptarupa using the device, she fakes being ill. Saptarupa and Jhanvi both set out to acquire the papers which have the instructions of the device’s creation and usage. Harsh steals the papers and gives them to Saptarupa.

episodesList.title: Jhanvi is pregnant
episodesList.summary: Saptarupa frees her captured forms from the device. Veer and Prachi get married. A doctor confirms Jhanvi’s pregnancy but Saptarupa falsely claims that it is her and Akarsh’s baby. Akarsh assures Jhanvi that the baby is theirs.

episodesList.title: Harsh falls deeper into Asha’s trap
episodesList.summary: Harsh falls deeper into Asha’s trap and locks Prachi in a trunk, for which Prachi blames Veer. Saptarupa continues to lay her claim upon Jhanvi’s child. A ritual performed by Vijayesh convinces the Moryas of Saptarupa’s theory and they ask Jhanvi to abort her child.

episodesList.title: The Moryas plan to abort Jhanvi’s child without her knowledge
episodesList.summary: A doctor agrees to the Moryas’ request to abort Jhanvi’s child on a condition. Vijayesh takes Akarsh away under false pretences so that the others could take Jhanvi to the hospital. Asha plans to add Harsh and Veer to her ranks.

episodesList.title: Akarsh sends Saptarupa back to her world
episodesList.summary: Akarsh stops Jhanvi’s abortion procedure and proves that Jhanvi is the child's mother, not Saptarupa. Asha threatens to kill Saptarupa is she fails to kill Jhanvi’s child. Akarsh sends Saptarupa to her world but faces off against Asha to save Jhanvi and his child.

episodesList.title: Jhanvi and Akarsh face a new threat
episodesList.summary: In between the fight, the ‘mani’ breaks and releases a demon who punishes Asha, Akarsh and Jhanvi for destroying his habitat. The next morning, Jhanvi and Akarsh receive some shocking news about their unborn child.

episodesList.title: The demon puts forth a condition
episodesList.summary: The demon confesses to severing the baby in Jhanvi’s womb. He agrees to grant Asha’s and Jhanvi’s wishes if they get him the pieces of the broken ‘mani’. Jhanvi requests a reluctant Akarsh to accede to the demon’s condition. Vaitaalini plots against Asha.

episodesList.title: Akarsh and Jhanvi enter ‘Pishacha Lok’
episodesList.summary: Akarsh decides to find the ‘mani’ back through the device he had created. Due to her family being at Asha’s mercy, Jhanvi and Akarsh enter ‘Pishacha Lok’ to find the first piece of the ‘mani’. Vaitaalini attacks Jhanvi’s family, for which Vijayesh blames Asha.

episodesList.title: Jhanvi and Akarsh in ‘Anaam Lok’
episodesList.summary: Akarsh and Jhanvi enter ‘Anaam Lok’ to get the second piece of the ‘mani’. Saptarupa informs them that she has given the ‘mani’ to a princess and has tied her soul to it. Asha learns about the demon’s past and plans to use the knowledge against him.

episodesList.title: Jhanvi vanquishes Asha
episodesList.summary: Saptarupa kills the princess and puts the blame on Akarsh. Jhanvi cleverly defeats Saptarupa and returns from ‘Anaam Lok’ with Akarsh and the ‘mani’s’ second piece. The demon lifts his curse from Jhanvi’s baby, following which Jhanvi vanquishes Asha.

plotHtml:
The series revolves around two people who are madly in love with each other and how their lives change when a daayan enters their lives and creates havoc. The young Janvi Maurya, a well-educated and family-oriented girl from Ujjain, stumbles upon a dangerous ploy by an evil force as many unusual and mysterious happenings occur in her hometown. With her life on the line, she must unmask the identity of a daayan who is someone close to her. Accompanying her in this mission is her childhood friend and love interest, the wealthy and chivalrous Aakarsh Chaudhary. Janvi and Aakarsh marry with an intent to finish the daayan.
Later it is revealed that Asha, the maid, is Aakarsh's real mother and Aakarsh is the daayan. Due to her son's love, Asha is unable to kill Janvi. She joins hands with Saptroopa who erases Aakarsh's memory so that he forgets Janvi, his love, and marries Saptroopa instead. The daayan uses this opportunity to kill Janvi and offer her as a sacrifice to make herself immortal.

title: Dastaan-E-Mohabbat Salim Anarkali
summary: Dastaan-E-Mohabbat: Salim Anarkali (transl. Story Of Love: Salim Anarkali) is an Indian historical television series that aired on Colors TV. Created by Ludhiana Pathak's Writer's Galaxy Studios, it premiered on 1 October 2018. Starring Shaheer Sheikh and Sonarika Bhadoria, the show explores the historical love story of Prince Salim and Anarkali.
plot:
Prince Salim (Uzair Bassar) visits an old dargah with his father Akbar (Shahbaz Khan) and mother Jodha Bai (Gurdeep Kohli). The Saint blesses them and foretells that Salim will be a great warrior with the capability of becoming a great king, and that one day Salim will turn against Akbar. Akbar promises that he will never allow such things to happen.
When dacoits attack the village of Agra, a girl named Saifu (Naisa Khanna) and her aunt Jhillan (Shruti Ulfat) save Salim as they flee. On learning that Saifu saved Salim's life, Akbar renames Saifu as Anarkali, which means 'blossomed pomegranate'. The seer also foretold that Anarkali will be the reason of the feud between Akbar and Salim. As they return to Agra, Salim and Anarkali become best friends. While Jodha and Akbar are happy to see Salim with his new-found friend, Akbar's first wife, Ruqaiya, (Tasneem Sheikh) and Akbar's mother Hamida (Aruna Irani) are enraged to see the niece of a servant playing with Salim. When Ruqaiya plots to kill Salim, Anarkali saves him once more.
Later, after Salim begins misbehaving when Ruqaiya puts rohypnol in his milk, Akbar decides to send him to the battlefield for 12 years until he is grown-up. Salim leaves the castle and is angry with his father's decision. However, Anarkali tearfully bids adieu to Salim and decides to write him letters throughout the 12 years in which all of this takes place.

articleSections.title: 12 Years Later
articleSections.text:
Prince Salim (Shaheer Sheikh) is now grown up and he is a brave and talented warrior who can single-handedly kill ten soldiers. Though ferocious, Salim has the soft heart of Jodha, and knows how to forgive. Salim's best friend is the Hindu warrior, Mahabbat (Meherzan Mazda), with whom Salim shares all his secrets. Anarkali (Sonarika Bhadoria), who is also grown-up, is a shy, soft-spoken, beautiful servant of Agra palace, and extremely close to Jodha. She writes letters to Salim every week, although she never gets a reply from him.
Though Anarkali loves Salim, she never expresses her desires. She knows that as a servant, she can never even dream of becoming the queen of Salim's heart. Although Ruqaiya hates Anarkali and frequently tries to defame her, Anarkali has nothing harsh against anyone. Jodha receives the news of Salim's homecoming and requests Anarkali to decorate Salim's room.
Salim returns and after meeting Jodha, he expresses his desire to meet Anarkali. Salim meets Anarkali at the terrace and is absolutely smitten with her. Although Anarkali is reluctant to see Salim again, Salim insists upon meeting her. This gives Ruqaiya an opportunity to make Anarkali fall in Salim's eyes. The next day, Ruqaiya orders Anarkali to dance with another dancer at a party arranged to celebrate Salim's homecoming. Salim is absolutely furious to see Anarkali as a rakkasha (courtesan) and slaps her in front of everyone. Salim leaves, followed by Mahabbat.
However, Mahabbat succeeds in making Salim understand that he was always in love with Anarkali. Salim decides to confess his feelings to Anarkali, who then requests that Salim leaves her alone, fearing that her worst nightmare will come true. A stubborn Salim tries to win over Anarkali and is successful. At last, Salim decides to give up, but before he does, he decides to make Anarkali confess her true feelings for him. He orders Mahabbat to arrange a party in the jungle, and to order Anarkali to come with them. Salim also arranges a dancer named Firdous to make Anarkali jealous. While Firdous dances, Salim notices Anarkali's jealousy, but she still remains silent.
Salim orders everyone to get out of the tent except Anarkali. Salim asks her why she was still silent. Anarkali replies that she is just a servant and cannot tell Salim what to do and what not. A frustrated Salim decides to make the tent catch fire and kill himself. However, this incident makes Anarkali weak, and she confesses her love for him. Hamida, after receiving the news of the fire incident, decides to meet Salim but is stunned to see him hugging Anarkali. She learns of their affair and decides to end it. Firdous, as revealed is a plot planted by Ruqaiya, tells her about Salim's love for Anarkali.
Ruqaiya asks Firdous to create a rift between them, but Firdous refuses and says she will not come between the two lovers. Ruqaiya kills Firdous. Akbar calls Nigris Jaan to teach dance to Anarkali. Firstly, Nigris behaves rudely with Anarkali but later, when she realises her love for Salim, she starts helping her. Then, Maan Bai, Salim's cousin enters and is successful in marrying him. She becomes Salim's first wife and starts creating the rift between Salim and Anarkali, but is unsuccessful. She even tries to kill Anarkali but Anarkali is saved by Salim. Maan Bai tells Akbar about their affair; he becomes furious and tells Anarkali to go away from Salim if she wants to save her life. But, later she is stabbed in her stomach and dies in the arms of Salim.

title: Divided
summary: Divided is an Indian Tamil-language game show, which debuted on Star Vijay on 21 July 2018 and ended on 4 November 2018. It is hosted by Gopinath Chandran.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text:
A team of three complete strangers attempt to answer up to 15 questions over the course of five rounds. The team has to accumulate as much money as possible. In the game, each question is either multiple-choice with one correct answer to be chosen from three options, or a list of three items to be placed in a specified order.
The team has 100 seconds to arrive at a unanimous decision on each question, and the money at stake decreases by 1% for each second that elapses before they lock in their choice. A correct answer adds the remaining money to a prize pot, while an incorrect answer cuts the pot in 10%,20% and 30% to the consequent rounds. If the team misses or wrongly answers a total of 3 questions, the game ends immediately and the team forfeits all winnings. The motive of the game begins when the prize money won by the contestants cannot be shared equally rather have to share themselves amicably.

title: Dil Hi Toh Hai
summary: Dil Hi Toh Hai (transl. It is the heart after all) is a romantic drama produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms. It aired on Sony TV and streams on Alt Balaji. It premiered on 18 June 2018 and stars Karan Kundra and Yogita Bihani.

articleSections.title: 3 months later
articleSections.text:
Ritvik's best friend, Rohit, is engaged to Palak's bestfriend, Shweta (Setu). Palak returns to Delhi. Ritvik is set to marry Ananya, Rohit's sister. After knowing Palak's innocence in their past fight, he confesses his love for her but Manjeet, Vijay and Rishabh disapprove. Misunderstandings created by Vijay between the couple make them break up. Manjeet fixes Palak's wedding to Naman Kapoor. Ritvik realises the truth and wants her back. They get married as Naman steps back.
Palak begins working for Vikrant Raheja, Geeta and her second husband's son. Vijay tells Ritvik that Palak and Vikrant have an affair. Later, he understands he is wrong about Palak. She meets Mamta who asks her to leave Ritvik. Suppressing her desire, Palak performs a false affair with Vikrant, leaving Ritvik heartbroken. Palak faints and turns out pregnant in hospital. Sacrificing her love for Ritvik's family, she lies to be pregnant with Vikrant's child.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Karan Kundrra as Ritvik "Ricky" Noon: Vijaypath and Geeta's son; Rishabh’s stepbrother; Reeva, Vikrant, Shanaya and Shivam's half-brother; Palak's husband; Gia and Dia's father (2018–2020) * Yogita Bihani as Dr. Palak Sharma Noon: Manjeet's daughter; Akshay's sister; Ritvik's wife; Vikrant's former wife; Gia and Dia's mother (2018–2020)

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The first promo of the show was shot in Lavasa. Also in 2018, the team shot some scenes in Rajasthan.

episodesList.title: Hate at First Sight
episodesList.summary: While trying to save her friend Aarohi, Dr. Palak gets a glimpse of the future heir of Noon Pharmaceuticals, Ritwik Noon. Some time passes and at a grand celebration at the Noon house, Palak crosses paths with Ritwik again. He quickly becomes the most hated man in Palak's life, as he ruins an emotion very close to her heart.

episodesList.title: A Bitter Medicine
episodesList.summary: Ritwik Noon loves his family, but hates women. Could his painful past be a reason? Palak is a diligent medical professional who doesn't work under any influence. When Noon Pharmaceuticals' file reaches her desk for approval, even Ritwik Noon himself is not able to get her to approve. How will Ritwik and Palak manage to separate the personal from the professional?

episodesList.title: The Noons Don't Give Up
episodesList.summary: The Noons try their best to bring their new medicine to the market. Ritwik might just have a clever plan to get Dr. Reddy to sign. Will Palak be able to stop this? When not working, the Noons love to come together and have fun as a family. Meanwhile, Palak's parents try to set her up with a possible marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Palak's Got a Plan
episodesList.summary: Palak is neither convinced nor ready to give up, even after learning Dr. Reddy's side of the story. With her journalist friend Setu, Palak hatches a plan to get more information about Ritwik Noon's new medicine. But Ritwik and the entire Noon family get a reality check when one of them ends up in a life-threatening situation.

episodesList.title: A Pall of Gloom
episodesList.summary: Crisis hits the Noons hard as the company's integrity is questioned by the media. Ritwik holds himself guilty and responsible for these trying times. On one hand, Palak is satisfied with the new development but Ritwik vows to make her cry. Could Ritwik's hatred for women be misplaced?

episodesList.title: A Tricky Proposition
episodesList.summary: Vijaypath successfully manages the media and the reputation of his company. Ritwik tries to manage the problem called Palak by offering her a job she can't refuse. He is ready to go to any lengths to prove to her that the new medicine is truly market ready. Palak accepts the offer but Ritwik Noon makes some arrangements to make Palak's first day at work miserable.

episodesList.title: The Turning Point
episodesList.summary: At the end of her first day at Noon Biotech, Palak is left tired and exhausted but her can-do spirit is intact. Nothing that Ritwik attempts will deter Palak from her goal. This infuriates Ritwik further and makes his resolve of creating hell in Palak's life stronger. Meanwhile, Ritwik's sister Reeva is beginning to have second thoughts over her relationship with Samar.

episodesList.title: A Battle of Egos
episodesList.summary: Palak prepares for her presentation but Ritwik is well prepared to foil it. As fate would have it, some plans are meant to fail while others are meant to fall in place. It doesn't end here, as Palak has another wild idea to show Ritwik his place. Will Palak beat Ritiwk or vice versa? Is the rivalry between Palak and Ritwik going too far?

episodesList.title: The Eligible Bachelorette
episodesList.summary: Brushing her doubts aside, Reeva announces to her family her decision of getting married to Samar. But is Samar ready to get hitched? Palak is under the impression that she has put Ritwik in his rightful place, but Ritwik Noon doesn't know how to lose. The whole office of Noon Biotech is thrown into chaos as Palak tries to handle her numerable suitors.

episodesList.title: You've Won?
episodesList.summary: After losing her self-respect and dignity at the hands of Ritwik, Palak is left with no choice but to leave her job at the Noon's. Ritwik thinks he has won but soon the tables turn and he is forced to bring Palak back into his company. What will Ritwik do to get her back?

episodesList.title: Love Potion
episodesList.summary: The battle of the egos continues as Ritwik brings out yet another evil trick from his kitty. This time, it almost works and makes Palak fall in love with him. Does this mean Palak will be back to work at Noon Biotech? At the Noon house, the wedding preparations are on in full swing, but, oblivious to Reeva, Samar contemplates a drastic step.

episodesList.title: Rajasthan Diaries
episodesList.summary: Palak and her team set up a medical camp in the deserts of Rajasthan. Ritwik follows her there too with his offer. But before that, Palak wants him to volunteer in the camp and help her patients. Ritwik readily takes on the challenge as there is hardly anything in the world his charm cannot achieve. However, Palak is shocked to see Ritwik put his life on line for the sake of her patients.

episodesList.title: A New Bond
episodesList.summary: Palak diligently cares for Ritwik while he recovers. In return, Ritwik expresses heartfelt gratitude towards Palak. This fragile side of Ritwik forces Palak to re-think her views about this man she thought she hated the most. But as she returns to work at Noon Biotech, undesired rumours force her to confront Ritwik of his true intentions.

episodesList.title: The First Dance
episodesList.summary: Samar's attempts to get Reeva to cancel the wedding go in vain. Reeva, on the other hand, does what she thinks is required to save her marriage. Will this grand wedding take place as planned? Palak reaches the Noon Mansion and finds it buzzing with wedding preparations. She is about to discover a familiar connection in the midst of it all.

episodesList.title: Friends Forever
episodesList.summary: Ritwik invites Palak to the wedding celebrations. Both Ritwik and Palak enjoy each other's company as their relation begins to develop into a beautiful friendship. Reeva comes face to face with the woman in Samar's life. Will Samar finally confess?

episodesList.title: Count on Me
episodesList.summary: Ritwik's flirty ways almost land him in trouble, but his new friend Palak comes to the rescue. Ritwik is not very impressed when he meets Palak's mother, who is obsessed with getting her daughter a suitable match. Meanwhile, the Noons are delighted to have Ritwik's close friend Ananya be a part of the celebrations.

episodesList.title: Seven Stages of Love
episodesList.summary: As the wedding day nears, the Noons get busy with several pre-wedding celebrations. A new trust begins to develop between Ritwik and Palak. She promises to never break his trust. But, soon Palak finds herself in a dilemma over Radhika and her relationship with Samar. Moreover, what will be the consequences when Ritwik learns the truth?

episodesList.title: The Missing Groom
episodesList.summary: Just a few hours before the wedding, Samar is nowhere to be found. Vijaypath and Ritwik look for him everywhere. Everyone begins to get anxious as no one can get in touch with Vijaypath and Ritwik. Palak is a mere witness to all that is happening around her. Will she continue to remain a mute spectator or take some action? She has a decision to make.

episodesList.title: Chaos Reigns
episodesList.summary: What does it take for a happy home to turn into an unhappy one? A broken wedding. The impact of this tragedy is far reaching. Several relations, both old and new, risk falling apart. When Samar arrives at the Noon Mansion to explain himself, will the family stay together or be forced to divide and take sides?

episodesList.title: Goodbye for Now
episodesList.summary: In times of crisis, members of the Noon family try to be each other's pillar of support. Nothing is more important than Reeva's recovery. But the recent catastrophe affects Ritwik the most, as he blames himself for his sister's suffering. Palak submits her resignation and receives a cheerful farewell from all the employees of Noon Biotech. But still, Ritwik has some unkind words reserved for her.

episodesList.title: Nothing but Hate
episodesList.summary: Rohit and Setu argue whether Palak is responsible for what happened with Reeva. They also confess what they think about each other. Reeva is already over Samar, but she doesn't seem to be in a mood to forgive Ritwik. Palak decides to leave for Mumbai for a few days, but Setu thinks she is running away from Ritwik.

episodesList.title: Hear Me Out
episodesList.summary: Rohit invites Setu to cover Reeva's breakup party. Seeing Rohit and Setu enjoy each other's company, Rohit's father indicates his approval of Setu. But, there is a selfish reason behind his approval. Palak finally learns the reason behind her mother's obsession of getting a rich match for her. Palak reaches the airport to hand over the hard disk to Ritwik, in return she receives money and more hatred.

episodesList.title: The Other Motive
episodesList.summary: After returning from London, Ritwik Noon takes an important life decision. He gets engaged, even though he still can't trust women. Its Setu and Rohit's engagement ceremony, but Palak chooses to stay away. Ritwik is glad to know this, but only on the surface. Just before the engagement, Rohit's father tries to clear his land deal. But he is disappointed.

episodesList.title: So We Meet Again
episodesList.summary: Everyone celebrates the happy union of Rohit and Setu. Even Palak doesn't miss this moment and chooses to be a part of it. Seeing her, Setu is delighted. But Ritwik can't stand the presence of both Palak and her mother. Meanwhile, Rohit's father continues to push the land deal through Setu's father.

episodesList.title: You''ve Been Cursed!
episodesList.summary: The celebrations are cut short when Setu's ex-husband shows up. Who invited him? This is the only question on everyone's mind. Rohit's family and Ritwik accuse Palak and her mother of hiding the truth about Setu's past. Moreover, Palak's mother is blamed for Setu's previous failed marriage.

episodesList.title: A New Journey
episodesList.summary: Rohit pleads Setu to come with him, but Setu refuses. He accuses Ritwik of being selfish and ruining his chances of a life with Setu. Yet again, Palak is ready to leave Delhi. This time it could be forever. But as she is about to board her flight, Ritwik tries to convince her to stay, for the sake of her friend Setu.

episodesList.title: A Happy Reunion
episodesList.summary: Palak and Ritwik try to persuade their respective friends, Setu and Rohit, to get back together. Rohit finds Ritwik's ideas futile, but Palak manages to convince Setu. At a coffee shop, they discuss the way forward for the couple - court marriage or a grand wedding? Seeing Ritwik getting increasingly close to Palak, Reeva warns Ananya to watch out.

episodesList.title: Lying to Myself
episodesList.summary: Ritwik and Palak begin planning Setu and Rohit's grand wedding. But without informing anyone, Rohit leaves town with Setu. As everyone in the family is worried, Palak and Ritwik try to track them down. On the way, they talk about love and passion. When Palak asks whether he truly loves Ananya, he has no clear answer.

episodesList.title: Awesome Foursome
episodesList.summary: Ritwik continues to persuade Rohit and Setu to re-think their decision. But before Rohit can decide, both the Noons and the Puris learn about the couple's wedding plans. This creates a rift between the two families. In the middle of this chaos, Palak and Ritwik gradually begin opening their hearts to each other.

episodesList.title: And Then There Were Two
episodesList.summary: On an early morning, Palak leaves her room with Setu to understand more clearly her thoughts about Ritwik. Hours later, Rohit and Ritwik look for the girls to brief them about a new plan, but they are nowhere to be found. A frantic search begins. Will the boys be able to locate Palak and Setu before their families arrive?

episodesList.title: The Great Escape
episodesList.summary: Palak and Setu are kidnapped by a dangerous local gang. For their safe return, the gang demands a ransom. Rohit and Ritwik are ready to do anything to rescue the girls. But Setu and Palak are not ones to suffer quietly. An injured Palak has an escape plan. But before they can reach out to Rohit and Ritwik, the boys are in the clutches of the kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Stand by You
episodesList.summary: Ritwik and Rohit find Setu, but Palak is still missing. A desperate and anxious Ritwik pleads the kidnappers for Palak's safety. The gang leader, Mahendra Singh, is not happy that Palak gave them the slip. He now has Ritwik at gun point. Will Palak reveal herself to save Ritwik?

episodesList.title: Till Death Do Us Apart
episodesList.summary: Rohit and Setu escape from Mahendra Singh and his goons' clutches. But Palak and Ritwik continue to fight to save themselves. Mahendra Singh's desperation and greed for a bigger ransom poses a threat to Palak and Ritwik's life. But the two are ready to die for each other when the situation spirals out of control.

episodesList.title: Wedding Bells Ring Again
episodesList.summary: Rohit, Setu, Palak, and Ritwik are safe and back at home. They decide not to tell their families about the kidnapping incident. But the future of Setu and Rohit's wedding is still uncertain, as the Puris are not ready to accept Setu as their daughter-in-law. To settle the dispute, Ritwik strikes a deal that involves sacrificing his own happiness.

episodesList.title: Words Unspoken
episodesList.summary: As the date of Ananya and Ritwik's wedding is finalised, Palak's mother gets another opportunity to organise a wedding function at the Noons'. Palak is also forced to become a part of the preparations. It gets increasingly difficult for Ritwik and Palak to talk to each other. Meanwhile, Setu's family refuses to pass the crucial land deal for Puri.

episodesList.title: Listen to Your Heart
episodesList.summary: Mr. Puri uses Setu's love for Rohit to his benefit. This time, he is sure that he will get the piece of land that he has been eyeing. A distressed Setu asks Palak to help her locate Rohit. Palak has no option but to meet Rohit's closest friend, Ritwik, to find out more about Rohit. But, in return, she gets a curt response from Ritwik.

episodesList.title: Truth Shall Set You Free
episodesList.summary: Ahead of his wedding with Ananya, Ritwik decides to confess to Ananya everything that happened between Palak and him. Ananya is on her way to meet Ritwik, and so is Palak. The three come face to face with each other. But Palak leaves the Noon mansion nursing a deep hurt in her heart.

episodesList.title: Something Left to Say
episodesList.summary: Mamta visits Manjeet and Palak to discuss ideas for Ritwik's sangeet ceremony. But she is left confused when she learns that Palak may have knowledge about Ritwik's troubled past. She wants to know if Palak and Ritwik are more than friends. As the preparations for the sangeet are in full swing, Mr. Puri eagerly looks forward to the celebrations.

episodesList.title: The Celebrations Begin!
episodesList.summary: As the sangeet ceremony begins, Mr. Puri puts his deceitful plan into action. Everyone is enjoying and having a good time. But Setu is distressed as she can't find Rohit anywhere. Mamta's performance dedicated to Ritwik makes him emotional. He thanks Palak for the idea, but she maintains professionalism.

episodesList.title: Deal-Breaker
episodesList.summary: To make sure that Setu is not troubled after her marriage with Rohit, Manjeet approaches Mr. Puri with a legal proposal. Mr. Puri is taken aback by her shrewdness. But before the deal can come to any fruition, Setu goes missing from her own sangeet ceremony. Mr. Puri's lies and deception threaten to reveal themselves in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: The Blame Game
episodesList.summary: Setu is still missing, but she has a message for everyone. It leaves the Noons and the Puris more puzzled.  An ugly blame game begins where Palak and Manjeet are made scapegoats in the entire situation. Ritwik decides to search for Setu as only she can provide some answers..

episodesList.title: The Never-Ending Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Ritwik promises to help Palak locate Setu, even if his family is against it. Palak finds some shocking activity from the CCTV footage belonging to the Puri's house. This raises grave questions about Setu's disappearance. Is Mr. Puri behind it? Meanwhile, Manjeet regrets her decision of making Mr. Puri sign the prenuptial agreement.

episodesList.title: But,I Love You
episodesList.summary: Setu sends another video message. Hidden in it, Palak finds a clue leading to Setu's abductor. Acting upon Ritwik's suggestion, Vijaypath accuses Mr. Puri of abducting Setu. Palak reaches the Noon Mansion to stop the confrontation and clear the confusion. But in a tense moment, Ritwik expresses his true feelings to Palak.

episodesList.title: A Storm Called Love
episodesList.summary: For the first time in his life, Ritwik has been true to himself. But his truth has brewed a storm all around him. Everyone is caught up in it - the Puris, the Noons, the Varmas, Manjeet, and Palak. A hurt Ananya doesn't want to blame Palak but appeals her to examine her true feelings for Ritwik. Matters have just got more complicated for Palak and Ritwik.

episodesList.title: Love Makes Things Happen
episodesList.summary: On Vijaypath's instructions, Rishabh produces detailed information about Manjeet and her wedding business. Even after learning about Manjeet's past failed wedding contracts, Vijaypath and Mamta decide to visit Manjeet to talk about Palak and Ritwik's wedding. Mr. Puri doesn't want to let that happen and tries to convince the Noons. Meanwhile, the search for Setu leads Palak and Ritwik to Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Hidden Intentions
episodesList.summary: The Noons are divided on the matter of Ritwik and Palak. Rishabh tries his best to make his family realise that Manjeet and her daughter Palak are nothing but gold diggers and that a marriage with Palak will be Ritwik's greatest mistake. He gets Saanchi to visit Manjeet and lie about Vijaypath's intentions.

episodesList.title: I Love You Too
episodesList.summary: Knowing where Ritwik's heart is, Mamta requests Manjeet to discuss their children's future. Manjeet confronts Palak if she loves Ritwik, but Palak does not give clarity. When Palak is held captive along with Setu, Ritwik gets the answer he has been patiently expecting.

episodesList.title: The Wait Is Over

episodesList.summary: Ritwik and Palak's flight to Shimla diverts to Kasauli due to bad weather. In search of a hotel, Ritwik falls in trouble. Palak and Ritwik make a run for their lives.

episodesList.title: Saved In Time
episodesList.summary: Ritwik is hospitalized as he loses consciousness after falling from the cliff. Vikrant reaches in the nick of time to save Ritwik and Palak. Palak wants to walk out of her marriage with Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Palak’s Birthday
episodesList.summary: On Palak's birthday, Vikrant plans a surprise for her. Vikrant wants to leave, but Palak requests him to stay. Gia and Dia have a day out with Ritwik.

episodesList.title: Shanaya’s Date
episodesList.summary: Shanaya is accompanied by the Noons' at her date with Karthik. Palak reminisces seven stages of love with Ritwik.

episodesList.title: The Patch Up
episodesList.summary: Setu's friends Palak and Reeva try to help with her marital issues. Setu and Rohit patch up. Ritwik questions Palak about the kiss and accuses her of being a gold digger.

episodesList.title: Vikrant’s Training
episodesList.summary: To bring Vikrant and Palak together, Ritwik shares tips with Vikrant. Ritwik has a deja vu. Vikrant tries to follow Ritwik's training but fails. Ritwik questions his father about his past.

episodesList.title: The Wrong Room
episodesList.summary: A celebration party is being arranged for Setu and Rohit's wedding anniversary. Palak, in a drunken state, enters Ritwik's room. The morning after, Ritwik tries to tease Palak about it.

episodesList.title: The Celebration Party
episodesList.summary: Ritwik and Palak read the vows penned for Setu and Rohit. Rohit is upset with Setu, as she does not arrive at the party. Ritwik shares that he feels different about Palak.

episodesList.title: The Accident
episodesList.summary: Setu meets with an accident. While searching for Rohit, Ritwik and Palak visit an old spot. Vijaypath mistakenly sends a message to Palak, meant for Vikrant. Palak learns about Vikrant's plan to divorce her.

episodesList.title: A Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: To save Rohit, Ritwik's silence creates a misunderstanding between Palak and Vikrant. Palak tries to explain herself but Vikrant shuts her out. The misunderstanding strengthens Vikrant's decision to separate from Palak.

episodesList.title: The Responsibility
episodesList.summary: Ritwik assures Palak that he will clear all the misunderstandings with Vikrant and stop their divorce. Mamta and Vijaypath approach Aman with the responsibility to find out what is going on between Ritwik, Palak and Vikrant. Rohit messes up again.

episodesList.title: The Recollect
episodesList.summary: The misunderstanding between Palak and Vikrant just keeps increasing and ends up in a heated argument. Ritwik has a strike of sudden recollection of memories and ends up in a hospital. Following the argument, Palak and Vikrant arrive at the lawyer's office to follow through their divorce.

episodesList.title: Messy Situations
episodesList.summary: Setu attempts suicide after finding out about Rohit's adultery. Palak rushes to help Setu after she receives a dire call from Setu's kids. Ritwik regains consciousness and is still a bit hazy from all the confusion.

episodesList.title: The Feint
episodesList.summary: Ritwik is now back to normal and is taken back home. Meanwhile, Setu decides she wants to stay away from Rohit. Setu hands over a letter to Palak and asks her to deliver it to Rohit. Upon arriving at the Noon Manor, Shivam informs Palak about Ritwik. Palak rushes to find Ritwik joyfully hoping he now remembers her. Ritwik comes across the letter amidst the chaos.

episodesList.title: The Engagement Day
episodesList.summary: The Noons are busy preparing for Shanaya and Kartik's engagement. Rohit tries to apologize to Setu for his mistake and Ritwik arrives in time to help him make amends. But Palak firmly stands by her friend's side. Palak invites Setu for the engagement. Shanaya gets upset at the engagement but Palak and Ritwik bring the situation under control.

episodesList.title: The Backlash
episodesList.summary: Rohit is still sulking for having lost Setu. Ritwik is happy to see Palak and Vikrant dancing so well but is still uneasy from within. When confronted by Palak regarding his memory recollections, he lashes out at everyone. Later Ritwik introduces Palak to his trophy girlfriend of the night.

episodesList.title: The Revelation
episodesList.summary: Hurt by Ritwik's sharp words and his rant, Palak is devastated to the core. Vikrant approaches Ritwik and reveals the truth about his wife and kids. Upon doctor's advice, Vikrant and Palak decide to leave the house for a few days. But does Ritwik really not remember anything?

episodesList.title: Memories Vs Reality
episodesList.summary: Ritwik discloses and proves to Rohit that he remembers everything. Meanwhile Palak and Vikrant are enjoying their date and Setu is at the spa. Ritwik has a catch in his shoulder and needs a doctor to help him out. Rohit drives him to Palak.

episodesList.title: The Big Switch
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Reeva prepare to leave for London on a business trip. Shivam and Ananya are finally ready to take things to the next level and plan to reveal their relation to everyone, but Mamta misunderstands the conversation. At the airport, Ritwik ends up with car troubles and Palak decides to help.

episodesList.title: A Shock To Remember
episodesList.summary: The Noons are not only shocked but also happy to find out about Shivam and Ananya and decide to celebrate it Noon style. Palak overhears Ritwik talking to Rohit and confronts him, Ritwik tells her that he remembers everything.

episodesList.title: Season Finale
episodesList.summary: Vikrant has a brain tumour attack and is now hospitalized, the doctors advise him to get it treated in London. Palak and Vikrant prepare to leave for London. Reeva is back home and finds out the truth about Ritwik's memory, tells Vikrant to rethink his decision. Ritwik arrives at the airport to win Palak back after overhearing Vikrant and Reeva.

title: Damaged
summary:
Damaged is an Indian mystery crime thriller streaming television series created for Hungama Play. The first two seasons are written by Shreyes Lowlekar and produced under the banner Alligator Media Productions, while the third season is written by Vrushank Juneja and produced under Endelmol Shine India. The series is a psychological crime drama noted for being led by a strong female character in each season. In the first season, the main cast features Amruta Khanvilkar, Amit Sial, Shruti Ulfat and Dhruvaditya Bhagwanani. In the second season, Hina Khan and Adhyayan Suman featured in lead roles, whereas the third season was led by Aamna Sharif and Shrenu Parikh.
The series was filmed across Mumbai. Abhishek Modak served as the cinematographer, and Ambar K. Vyas edited the series.
The first season of Damaged was released on 6 June 2018. The series opened to positive responses from audiences and critics, praising the performances of cast members, particularly Amruta Khanvilkar's, which received rave responses. The second season was released on 14 January 2020 and the third season of the show was released on 20 January 2022.

articleSections.title: Main

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
Damaged is the first web series launched by Hungama.
A two-minute trailer for Damaged, featuring the main leads, was released on 6 June 2018, with the tagline "India’s first ground-breaking show about a woman serial killer". The teaser for Damaged 2 was released on 6 January 2020, while the trailer was released on 14 January 2020. The third season teaser was revealed in the first week of January 2022.
Damaged is available to stream through Hungama Play on Vodafone Play, Idea Movies & TV, Airtel Xstream App, Amazon Fire TV Stick, Tata Sky Binge, MX Player, and Android TVs. Additionally, Hungama's association with Xiaomi will enable consumers to watch the series via Hungama Play on Mi TV.

episodesList.title: The Wall
episodesList.summary: A case of a missing famous painter is handed over to C.B.I. who is secretly buried in a wall by a beautiful baker.

episodesList.title: The Victim
episodesList.summary: An Urdu poet falls prey to a revengeful baker, while Crime Bureau of Investigation interrogates the key suspects of missing painter's case.

episodesList.title: The Trust
episodesList.summary: Another case of a missing writer is handed over to CBI, while Lovina birdie gathers trust among her close people.

episodesList.title: The Pattern
episodesList.summary: Dhruv Mullick solves a pattern of missing people, while Lovina destroys everything given to her by her ex-boyfriends.

episodesList.title: The Backstory
episodesList.summary: Bijoy narrates a story of a girl who killed her boyfriend and ran, while he captures a stalker and drowns him in a well.

episodesList.title: The Ego
episodesList.summary: An ego clash between Abhay and Dhruv proves fatal to Dhawre's job, while Lovina falls in love with an extremely good guy.

episodesList.title: The Stalker
episodesList.summary: Drunken Dhawre dies while saving Lovina birdie from a surprise attack of the stalker.

episodesList.title: The Vanisher
episodesList.summary: Vanisher' makes it to the head-lines and Inspector Meenaxi Reddy joins CBI's team.

episodesList.title: The Perfect Guy
episodesList.summary: DIG trusts Dhruv over Abhay and allows him to lead the case, while Lovina is bored by Apurva's good boy image.

episodesList.title: The Backfire
episodesList.summary: The perfect guy meets a dead end, while Dhruv and Meenaxi connect 'Bake and Berry' bakery to their individual investigations.

episodesList.title: The Fear
episodesList.summary: Abhay and Dhruv reach Lovina's house through their personal investigations. Bijoy is scared but the death of father Patrick and lust for Lovina, make him stay.

episodesList.title: The Trap
episodesList.summary: Lovina is called to Police station for the case of missing Rohan, while Rohan is kidnapped by the Stalker. Dhruv's growing ego clashes with his teammates, while Abhay gets closer to Lovina.

episodesList.title: Keep Your Enemies Closer
episodesList.summary: Dhruv is sure about Lovina's involvement and does a thorough research on her, while Meenaxi traces Rohan and learns of the stalker, Neil Bhatt.

episodesList.title: The Revelation
episodesList.summary: The cake delivered to a customer from Bake and Berry bakery arrives with a finger, which happens to be Dhawre's. DIG gives case back to Abhay, making Dhruv angry and vengeful. He investigates and learns the truth about Neil Bhatt.

episodesList.title: Game Over?
episodesList.summary: Everything boils down to Lovina Birdie. Abhay and Dhruv reach Lovina's house to save her but the confusion kills Dhruv and the fear of being caught kills Abhay. Lovina, the Vanisher, survives.

episodesList.title: The Mistake
episodesList.summary: It is Shanaya's dream come true when she meets Rashmi for the first time.

episodesList.title: The Reveal
episodesList.summary: Unfortunate killings are followed by unfortunate news.

episodesList.title: The Chase
episodesList.summary: Rashmi gets closer to finding the killer while Shanaya touches new heights in her undercover endeavour.

episodesList.title: The Face Off
episodesList.summary: It is the ultimate face-off but the question is who is more stunned with whose identity.

episodesList.title: The End
episodesList.summary: A damaging end to an unfortunate journey.

title: Dance Deewane
summary:
Dance Deewane (transl. Dance Lovers) is an Indian dance reality show that airs on Colors TV. The show features dance performers, including solo acts, Duo and groups representing any style of dance, competing for a grand prize.
The series premiered on Colors TV on 2 June 2018.  Dance Deewane (Season 1)  aired from 2 June 2018 to 15 September 2018,  Dance Deewane (Season 2) aired from 15 June 2019 to 28 September 2019, Dance Deewane (Season 3)  aired from 27 February 2021 to 10 October 2021 and Dance Deewane (Season 4) aired from 3 February 2024 to 26 May 2024. Dance Deewane Juniors, the series' spin-off, aired from 23 April 2022 to 17 July 2022.
plot: Various talented dancers are divided into three age groups, called "generations". The first generation is the youngest while the third generation is the oldest. In the end, the best-performing dancers from each generation compete against each other in the finale. The dancers usually perform alongside choreographers.

title: Dhimaner Dinkaal
summary:
Dhimaner Dinkaal is a Bengali Comedy Web series that premiered on 11 December 2017 on ALT Balaji. It is the story about a simple Bengali man who is against mobile and social media.
The series is available for streaming on the ALT Balaji App and its associated websites since its release date.
plot: The series is about an uber simple Bengali family man, Dhiman Dutta who meets a seductress on social media! It is a story that explores the strength of familial ties, culture, and good old Indian values and explains the side effects of social media.

title: Detective Didi
summary: Detective Didi is an Indian detective television series that premiered on 9 December 2017 and airs on zee TV. The series is produced by Trilogy Krikos Production. It stars Sonia Balani and Manish Goplani.
plot: Bunty (Sonia Balani) is the only woman of the house who gets the bread and butter home by solving the cases with her partner Bhim Singh Bhullar (Manish Goplani) who she later marries. Her grandfather and uncle don't make any money and are widowers. Her father is disabled and in a wheelchair after an accident where he lost his wife. Bunty is left with her deceased elder sister's son. She basically runs the house. She takes up the smaller cases of busting a wife's infidelity to solving a kidnapping case where kids are smuggled or killed. Obviously, there's a lot of danger also involved in her job.

episodesList.title: Episode One
episodesList.summary: Seeing the rising crime rate in Delhi, Detective Didi aka Bunty Sharma, takes it upon herself to wipe crime from the area. Living in the busy streets of Chandni Chow, Bunty learns of a child trafficking racket going on in the city. Bunty decides to follow the lead and catch hold of the mastermind behind this racket.

episodesList.title: Episode Two
episodesList.summary: While chasing an important clue regarding the child trafficking racket, Bunty gets hit by a bullet and falls down unconscioius. Meanwhile, Gattu gets teased by his friends while playing football that his father is not there with him. On the other hand, the Sheikh from Dubai calls up Salman to ask what is the progress with the children who have to be smuggled. Will Detective Didi regain consciousness and unmask this racket?

episodesList.title: Episode Three
episodesList.summary: Zee TV is all set to add more fun to your weekends with Detective Didi - a crime, mystery drama that revolves around a street-smart Ace Private Detective Bunty Sharma and Special Agent Bhim Singh Bhullar. Together they take on serial killers, crime lords, gangsters and all, both employing desperate measures in desperate situations. What follows is a chase akin to Tom and Jerry to solving the case first, and the bond between Bunty and Bhim who can't stand each other only to realize they cannot survive without each other.

episodesList.title: Episode Eight
episodesList.summary: Bunty sees Sangeeta running on the road as Sangeeta's body catches fire. Later, the people start protesting against Sangeeta's in-laws after they assume that they are responsible for her accident. Shortly after that, the police cross-examine Sangeeta's in-laws about the incident. Later, the in-laws tell the police that they are innocent. After a while, Bunty decides to investigate the case after Sangeeta's in-laws are released on bail.

episodesList.title: Episode Nine
episodesList.summary: Sangeeta meets Detective Didi and tells her that she faked her death to ensure her husband's grandmother is brought to justice. She tells her how she was harassed and forced to take a sonography. On the other hand, Bhim Singh arrests Rakesh who is held responsible for Sangeeta's death. Later on, Sangeeta asks Detective Didi to help her give justice to all the women who have been murdered for not paying their in-laws the required dowry.

episodesList.title: Episode Eleven
episodesList.summary: Bunty is saved from the incoming train by Dipika Kakkar when her foot gets stuck on the track. Inspector Bhullar calls her and tells her that he has found the place where the stolen babies were kept and asks her to reach that place immediately. But the place turns out to be empty. They find a few nametags and after checking the history of thefts they find that all the babies were born in the same hospital. Inspector Bhullar concludes that one of the hospital staffers must be involved.

episodesList.title: Episode Twelve
episodesList.summary: Bunty finds a dead girl hanged to a tree, which leaves her stunned. She immediately calls the police for the investigation. Shortly after that, Bunty tries to console the dead girl's mother and promises her that she will get justice for her daughter. After a while, Bhim Singh Bhullar is surprised to see a peacock's feather in the dead girl's hair. Consequently, Bunty assumes that the peacock's feather is crucial evidence to solve the case.

episodesList.title: Episode Thirteen
episodesList.summary: Detective Didi tries to rescue Bhim Singh, who is tied to the ceiling but gets drugged by another pandit. Following that, Bhim Singh beats up the pandits who try to drug him and disguises himself as one of them. Later, he tries to rescue Detective Didi when a pandit tries to molest her. After that, they flee the ashram and Detective Didi confesses her love for Bhim Singh in her drug-induced state. However, Bhim Singh takes a video of Detective Didi without her knowledge.

episodesList.title: Episode Fourteen
episodesList.summary: A strange man, who is disguised as a clown, throws acid on Annie's face. He immediately hands the bottle to a confused Gattu. He later gets arrested when a witness testifies against him. Meanwhile, Detective Didi helps Nalini, an acid attack survivor, get married to a wonderful man, When she reaches the police station, she scolds Bhim Singh for arresting Gattu without listening to his side. So Bhim Singh interrogates Gattu and goes in search of the attacker.

episodesList.title: Episode Fifteen
episodesList.summary: Detective Didi chases a clown who tries to throw some acid on Bhim Singh's face. The following day, she tells Bhim Singh about the incident. He goes in search of criminals who have recently bought acid and arrests the manager of a nightclub. On the other hand, Detective Didi follows Rani and overhears her conversation with a doctor. Later, she bumps into a man who looks like Rani and tells Bhim Singh her whereabouts. However, someone hits Detective Didi on the head.

episodesList.title: Episode Eighteen
episodesList.summary: Bunty learns about Pratiksha's death, which leaves her stunned. Bunty then finds out that the famous celebrity's death is a conspiracy. After a while, at the crime scene, Bhim Singh Bhullar is trying to find evidence when Bunty arrives there to investigate. However, Bhim Singh Bhullar asks Bunty to leave after he is unwilling to let Bunty intervene in the case. Shortly after that, Bunty decides to solve the case and find the culprit behind Pratiksha's death.

episodesList.title: Episode Nineteen
episodesList.summary: In an attempt to force a confession from Vishal, Sandhya gives him a severe beating. Bunty shows up and manages to stop her. She tells Sandhya to be patient while she looks for the real killer who is still on the loose. Her investigation leads her to Vishal’s house where Kaka comes forward and provides her with the evidence she’s looking for. Later, Payal is questioned and she lies to the detectives and tries to prove her innocence. Due to this, Sandhya slaps her in a fit of rage.

episodesList.title: Episode Twenty
episodesList.summary: Detective Didi is a crime thriller drama starring Manish Gopalalni and Sonia Balani in the lead. The story revolves around a street-smart ace private detective Bunty Sharma and special agent Bhim Singh Bhullar. Together they take on serial killers, crime lords, gangsters and all, both employing desperate measures in desperate situations. What follows is a chase akin to Tom and Jerry to solving the case first, and the bond between Bunty & Bhim who can’t stand each other only to realize they cannot survive without each other.

episodesList.title: Episode Twenty One
episodesList.summary: Bunty and Bhim play Holi, the festival of colours. A woman approaches Bunty and asks her to save her child who has been sold for money. Later, Bunty goes to the school to pick up Gattu. The watchman tells her that Gattu’s uncle took him home. When she starts asking people nearby about Bunty, she hears a tantrik talking about how the lunar eclipse is an auspicious time for sacrificing a child. Bunty and Bhim start searching for Gattu. Afterwards, Bunty finds a bag full of money at her house.

episodesList.title: Episode Twenty Two
episodesList.summary: Out on the street, Bunty and Gattu meet Priya. She insists on them coming with her as they have no place to stay and are out of cash. Later, Bhullar and his men come across a dead body of a man who was a suspect in a rape case but was let go. They notice rapist tattooed on his forehead and his private part missing. Meanwhile, Bunty meets Priya’s fiance Sada who was caught by a gang of women who tattooed rapist on his forehead but he was able to escape before they could harm him.

episodesList.title: Episode Twenty Three
episodesList.summary: Bunty is worried because Gattu has been kidnapped. After that, Bhullar assures her that he will do his best to find Gattu. Later that night, a woman threatens to harm Gattu if she refuses to follow her instructions. Following that, Bunty is relieved to find Gattu. On the other hand, Bhullar arrests a group of men and realises that they were the ones who kidnapped him. The following day, Bhullar promises Gattu that he will always protect Bunty because he loves her.

episodesList.title: Episode Twenty Four
episodesList.summary: Inspector Bhim Singh Bhullar lets Bunty walk out of the prison as she is cleared of all the charges after an investigation. Meanwhile, Munna celebrates the acquisition of Bunty's house with his friend. Later, a double murder in the city puts the policemen in a fix. But Bunty decides to solve the case with the help of a hacker. With the help of Bhim Singh Bhullar, Bunty manages to nab the killer. After the arrest, Bhim Singh Bhullar confesses his feelings for Bunty.

title: Dil Sambhal Jaa Zara
summary: Dil Sambhal Jaa Zara (transl. Be Careful My Heart) is an Indian drama television series broadcast on StarPlus from 23 October 2017 to 2 February 2018. The series was produced by Vikram Bhatt which starred Sanjay Kapoor and Smiriti Kalra. It is the remake of Turkish TV series Aşk-ı Memnu.
plot: Ahana Raichand (Smriti Kalra), a young woman, was always loved by her father. Her mother, Laila Raichand (Niki Aneja Walia), is a sly, ambitious, greedy woman who cheated on her husband. Ahana's father dies of shock taking his wife's betrayal too hard. Ahana witnesses their argument, thereby developing an intense hatred for her mother. Ahana, frustrated at her life at home after her father's death, finds solace in Anant Mathur (Sanjay Kapoor), a widowed friend of her father. Saloni Raichand (Cheshtha Bhagat), Ahana's elder sister, is about to be married to her sweetheart, Tarun Gupta (Puneet Sharma). Tarun's father, Mahendra Gupta (Indraneel Bhattacharya), is not keen on letting them get married since he is aware of Laila's gold-digging tendencies. He wants Saloni to sign a prenup. When Laila finds out she is infuriated and wants to cancel the wedding. The plot twist comes in the form of Saloni's pregnancy. Laila agrees to the wedding on the condition that Tarun provides 3 crore rupees to her. Tarun and Saloni get married. Meanwhile, Laila sets her eyes on marrying Anant as he is a rich businessman in order to pay off her debts and increase her social status. But Anant proposes to Ahana and they decide to get married. Rehaan Khanna (Aashim Gulati), son of Anant's friend, convinces Roshni, Anant's daughter, to give her blessings. Anant goes to Laila to ask for Ahana's hand in marriage. Laila is furious. She agrees to the marriage and puts forward a condition to Anant. As the story continues Ahana and Anant face many obstacles in their marriage due to the age difference, society, rivalry and family. Rehaan begins to fall for Ahana, while simultaneously learning that she married Anant just to defy and insult her mother for revenge. As he loves Anant who is like a father-figure to him, he doesn't want to see him cheated and tells Anant that Ahana didn't actually love him, not realizing that Ahana truly loves Anant and that revenge against her mother was a bonus. On revealing her supposed intentions, it is not taken up well by Anant at first, which leads Rehaan to leave the house. Later being asked for answers, Ahana reveals the initial reason behind the marriage before Anant, which shatters him. Misunderstandings brew up. Soon after, Ahana gets pregnant. Elated, she tries to reveal this to Anant. In a series of misunderstandings and the growing distance between them, she is forced to decide to abort her unborn child. Laila is left broke by Mahendra, she has an accident. Rehaan realizes his mistakes. After knowing the abortion bit, Anant again hates Ahana. Rehaan asks for Ahana's forgiveness. She forgives him soon after and is taken care of by him. He supports her through the hard times and they go for a Goa trip. Rehaan and Ahana grow closer during the trip. Meanwhile, Anant realizes his mistake and wants to give a second chance to their marriage. Ahana returns home but misunderstandings still prevail in their relationship. Meanwhile, Anant gets to know about Ahana and Rehaan's relationship through Rehaan's ex-girlfriend Vyoma. The show ends with Anant about to confront Ahana and Rehaan about the same.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Initially titled as Ishq Gunaah, it was renamed Dil Sambhal Jaa Zara while in pre-production.
The series was filmed at sets created in a studio at Kanhurmarg in Mumbai.
Initially Samir Soni was cast as the lead Anant Mathur and had also shot for the pilot episode but was soon replaced by Sanjay Kapoor as the makers felt the former not suitable for it.
In November 2017, lead Smiriti Kalra did not shoot for a week after she suffered back injuries by tripping from the staircase while shooting.
On 3 January 2018, a strike in Mumbai by Dalit group affected the filming of the series due to which the shooting was wrapped up too early in morning itself.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: The very less ratings of the series make the channel to axe it abruptly within about four months of premiere.
