title: Dill Mill Gayye
summary:
Dill Mill Gayye (transl. Hearts Have Met) is an Indian medical drama television series that aired on Star One from 20 August 2007 to 29 October 2010. It was a sequel to the Star Plus series Sanjivani: A Medical Boon. The series is available digitally on Disney+ Hotstar.
The show focuses on a new generation of medical interns with the crux being the love story between Dr. Armaan Malik, portrayed by Karan Singh Grover and Dr. Riddhima Gupta which was originally portrayed by Shilpa Anand, who was later replaced by Sukirti Kandpal and then Jennifer Winget.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Karan Singh Grover as Dr. Armaan Malik – Intern and later senior resident doctor at Sanjeevani, Riddhima's love interest. (2007-2010) *Shilpa Anand as Dr. Riddhima Gupta – Intern at Sanjeevani, daughter of Dr. Shashank and Padma Gupta, younger sister of Dr. Anjali and Armaan's love interest. (2007-2008) **Sukirti Kandpal as Dr. Riddhima Gupta – Intern, Armaan's love interest. (2008-2009) **Jennifer Winget as Dr. Riddhima Gupta/Dr. Riddhima Modi– Senior resident doctor at Sanjeevani and Siddhant's ex-wife, Armaan's love interest. (2009-2010) ** Anand also portrays Dr. Shilpa Malhotra, intern at Sanjeevani, and Riddhima's half-sister (Kartik's daughter), who is Armaan's love interest. (2010) *Karan Wahi as Dr. Siddhant Modi – Abhimanyu's younger brother. Tamanna's love interest and Riddhima's ex-husband. (2009-2010)

articleSections.title: Guest appearances
articleSections.text: Mohit Malik (2008) Crossover with Miley Jab Hum Tum *Sanaya Irani – as Gunjan *Arjun Bijlani – as Mayank *Mohit Sehgal – as Samraat *Rati Pandey – as Nupur *Navina Bole – as Dia, Siddhant's friend *Anupriya Kapoor – as Suhani *Nishant Singh Malkani – as Adhiraj Singh *Jaineeraj Rajpurohit – as Mr Saxena *Deepak Pareek – as Professor Shukla

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
After the end of Sanjivani: A Medical Boon, Siddharth P. Malhotra decided to make Dill Mill Gayye as a sequel of the show. The actor Mohnish Bahl reprised his role of Dr. Shashank from Sanjivani and was the only common link between the shows.
It was not supposed to be a long running show. The initial plan was to wrap up within a couple of episodes, but due to positive response from audience within three weeks, the creative team decided to extend it.
In an interview with Times of India, Pankit Thakker talked about three actresses playing the role of Dr. Riddhima Gupta and stated that:

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Earlier, Haroon Qazi was cast as Dr. Armaan but due to creative differences he was replaced with Karan Singh Grover.
Anand initially auditioned for the role of Dr. Anjali Gupta, but the casting team selected her to play the lead, Dr. Riddhima Gupta. Later, Sunaina Gulia was cast for in the role of Dr. Anjali. Pankit Thakker was originally paired up with Muskaan Mihani. But he believed his chemistry with Muskaan was mostly coming out friendly. Hence, he discussed with the creative directors if they could change the track so they'd paired him up with Sunaina. She was replaced by Sukirti Kandpal, who had auditioned for a role in 2007 but was originally rejected by the casting team. Later in April 2009, Kandpal also quit the show
In June 2009, Mayank Anand quit Dill Mill Gayye to pursue a career as a book writer.
In March 2010, Karan Singh Grover and later in June 2010, Shilpa Anand returned to the show on fans' demands. After coming back two years later, Anand played a different character, Dr. Shilpa Malhotra, and once again she was paired opposite Karan Singh Grover.
In May 2010, Neha Jhulka quit the show as she was not happy with her storyline.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: In 2008, during shoot of a basketball playing scene actress Shilpa Anand began feeling unwell and almost passed out on the set due to over heat, but she continued shooting.

articleSections.title: Special scenes
articleSections.text: The series had shot many scenes that resemble some scenes from Bollywood. "The aur pass" scene and Lonavala sequence between Karan Singh Grover and Shilpa Anand were inspired by the Bollywood film Dil Toh Pagal Hai.

articleSections.title: Critics
articleSections.text:
The Times of India reported that Dill Mill Gayye was a TRP-tripper when Karan Singh Grover and Shilpa Anand played Dr. Armaan and Dr. Riddhima and also stated that their sizzling on-screen chemistry took the show to new highs. In 2012, They listed Karan Singh Grover among "Big icons of Small Screen" and stated that he was a huge teenage icon in 2007. Even one and half year after the show going off air, there were demands for another season.
Shweta Ksheri of India Today wrote, "With a fresh cast and a new storyline, the romantic medical drama was successful in attracting the younger lot."

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text:
In an exclusive Interview with Spotboye, Shilpa Anand revealed that she quit the show in 2008 because she had a fight with the executive producer during the shoot of the "Zara Zara Touch Me Touch Me" dance sequence. Her replacements were not well-received by the audience and her exit caused a sizeable drop in the ratings.
In 2009, when Sukirti Kandpal quit the show, the producer Siddharth P. Malhotra approached Shilpa Anand for returning to Dill Mill Gayye but she asked for high amount of money, which caused a conflict between her and the producer. Cinevistaas Limited stated that they lodged a complaint against Karan Singh Grover for routinely reporting hours late for work, which made them incur a loss, and that actress Jennifer Winget slapped him on the set. They did not speak to each other for months and shot their scenes separately at two different times. The second season of the show didn’t do well. On 29 October 2010, the series went off air due to low TRP.

episodesList.title: Dr. Riddhima Defeats Dr. Armaan
episodesList.summary: Follows the lives of surgical interns and resident doctors of Sanjeevani. Set in the backdrop of Sanjeevani Hospital, it deals with the pressures, drama, romance, inter personal relationships and humour in their lives.

episodesList.title: Tiff Between Armaan and Riddhima
episodesList.summary: After Riddhima runs some clotting tests on a patient, she gets in to an argument with Armaan. However, Kirti intervenes and later confirms Riddhima's diagnosis and treatment. Already miffed, Armaan then warns Riddhima to be careful. Why is Armaan so annoyed?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Wins Her Patients' Hearts
episodesList.summary: After Armaan and Riddhima argue over their bet, Riddhima overhears Armaan scolding a girl and then she attends to a pregnant women. The same patient asks Kirti to replace Anjali with Riddhima for her surgery. Will Riddhima succeed in operating on the pregnant woman?

episodesList.title: Sapna Falls In Love With Dr Rai
episodesList.summary: Sapna meets and falls in love with Shubhankar Rai, a cardiologist. Rai is treating Sunaina, who suffers from an eating disorder. However, Armaan manages to make her eat. But he later gets into trouble when the police hold him responsible for his ex-girlfriend's suicide attempt.

episodesList.title: Armaan Goes to Jail
episodesList.summary: Despite Armaan's clarifications, police arrest him and take Riddhima's statement. Afterwards, Armaan is released and Shashank asks everyone not to disclose Armaan's incident publically. However, Riddhima continues to hold Armaan responsible for Maya's condition.

episodesList.title: Riddhima Testifies Against Armaan
episodesList.summary: After Riddhima sees Armaan holding a knife pointed at Maya, she tells the police that Armaan tried to kill Maya. In the meantime, one of the accident patients misbehaves with Riddhima and she slaps him. Disturbed, Riddhima then gets more upset after she hears Maya's telephonic conversation.

episodesList.title: Riddhima Proves Armaan's Innocence
episodesList.summary: On learning the truth about Maya, Riddhima teams up with Atul to prove Armaan's innocence. However, Maya falls into Riddhima's trap and confesses to framing Armaan. Even though Armaan is freed of the charges against him, will he forgive Riddhima for sending him to jail?

episodesList.title: Armaan Refuses to Forgive Riddhima
episodesList.summary: Even though Riddhima apologises to Armaan, he refuses to accept the same. Afterwards, she tries to talk to him at his party, but he gets furious and scolds her. Later, while returning home, Vivek catches Riddhima and misbehaves with her. Will Armaan come to save Riddhima?

episodesList.title: Sanjeevani's Medical Camp
episodesList.summary: After Kirti, Armaan and Riddhima's operation, Shashank and Kirti talk about the upcoming medical camp. Although Armaan has not accepted Riddhima's apology, she gets a chance again as she and Armaan are set to travel together to reach the medical camp. Will Armaan finally forgive her?

episodesList.title: Armaan Troubles Riddhima
episodesList.summary: During their journey to the medical camp, Armaan purposely irritates Riddhima. On reaching the camp site, the Sanjeevani doctors and interns start attending to the villagers. Riddhima and Armaan also offer their services to the villagers.

episodesList.title: Anjali Frames Armaan
episodesList.summary: Everyone except Anjali supports Riddhima's idea to open a social service ward in the hospital. An offended Anjali then tries to trouble Riddhima and blames it on Armaan. Later, Armaan, Riddhima, Atul and Anjali play truth and dare. Will Armaan dare Riddhima to seek his revenge against her?

episodesList.title: Riddhima and Armaan Get Lost
episodesList.summary: Riddhima accepts Armaan's challenge of entering the forest in the dark. But once inside, she gets lost and is unable to find her way back. The local people and all the Sanjeevani doctors try to find her, but fail. Will Armaan safely bring back Riddhima from the forest?

episodesList.title: Riddhima and Armaan Find Their Way
episodesList.summary: Riddhima and Armaan finally find their way and reach the others who are waiting for them. At the hospital, while Riddhima works on Vijay's case, Armaan operates Mini. Later, Anjali feels jealous as Riddhima secures highest marks in the intern of the month competition.

episodesList.title: Armaan Teases Riddhima
episodesList.summary: After Riddhima and Anjali patch up, Armaan teases Riddhima for spending the entire night with him in the forest. However, Riddhima soon loses her peace when her patient, Vijay, suddenly starts bleeding and dies on the operation table. Will Riddhima be blamed for his death?

episodesList.title: Armaan Dreams About Riddhima
episodesList.summary: Armaan dreams of proposing to Riddhima and gets scared. Then, he feels her presence around him and the other interns make fun of him. Afterwards, Sapna hands over her medical case to Anjali and Kirti deducts ten points from Sapna's marks. Will Sapna hold this against Anjali?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Wins The Basketball Match
episodesList.summary: Although Padma wishes Anjali luck for the basketball match at Sanjeevani, the latter ignores her. During the game, Armaan gets distracted by Riddhima's beauty and her team wins the match. Did Armaan lose the match on purpose to make Riddhima happy?

episodesList.title: Armaan Tries to Woo Riddhima
episodesList.summary: After Anjali and Riddhima's argument over the basketball match, Riddhima gets irritated with Armaan's annoying behaviour. While the other interns handle their patients, Armaan discusses his problem with Atul. Does Atul have a solution to Armaan's problem?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Tricks Armaan
episodesList.summary: While Anjali prepares to win the intern contest, Armaan tells Riddhima that he has fallen for a girl, but she makes fun of him. Later, Armaan invites Riddhima for dinner. But instead of Riddhima, he finds his ex-girlfriends. Did Riddhima send his ex-girlfriends to him?

episodesList.title: Armaan Surprises Everyone
episodesList.summary: After Armaan surprises Atul, Sapna and Anjali with his behaviour towards Riddhima, Kirti assigns everyone's duty and appreciates Armaan for his work. Later, when Riddhima and Armaan get time, she asks him about his changed behaviour. Will Armaan confess his feelings to Riddhima?

episodesList.title: Anjali Gets Jealous Of Riddhima
episodesList.summary: While Riddhima is upset on learning about Mini's medical condition, Sapna gets annoyed as her parents emotionally blackmail her for marriage. Meanwhile, Anjali's jealousy towards Riddhima increases after the latter is again chosen as the intern of the month.

episodesList.title: Anjali Challenges Armaan
episodesList.summary: After Shashank allows Riddhima to assist him in his next surgery, she finds a love letter in her locker and doubts Armaan for fooling around with her. Anjali learns about Armaan's love for Riddhima and challenges him to make Riddhima fall in love with him. Will Armaan accept her challenge?

episodesList.title: Shashank Gets Padma's Reports
episodesList.summary: While the entire staff of Sanjeevani hospital is confused with Armaan's changed behaviour, Riddhima doubts his real intentions. Later, Shashank learns that Padma is suffering from brain tumour. Will Shashank now convince Padma to reveal the truth to her daughter?

episodesList.title: A Surprise Party For Riddhima
episodesList.summary: Atul, Sapna and Anjali plan a surprise party for Riddhima and seek Armaan's help in bringing her to the party. At the party, as Sapna feels sad on seeing Shubanker dance with his wife, Riddhima feels shy as Armaan invites her for a dance. Is Armaan doing all this to win Anjali's challenge?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Disappoints Armaan
episodesList.summary: While dancing with Riddhima at the party, Armaan reminds her about her promise and asks her out for a movie. However, she invites the other interns too. Meanwhile, Shashank tells Padma that they will have to tell the truth to Riddhima and Anjali. What are they talking about?

episodesList.title: Armaan Expresses His Love
episodesList.summary: After the movie, Armaan drops Riddhima home. But on their way, they share some romantic moments and Riddhima begins to understand her love for Armaan. However, she feels shy when Armaan expresses his feelings towards her. Will she express hers too?

episodesList.title: Anjali Spoils Riddhima's Date
episodesList.summary: Even though Riddhima commits to meeting Armaan in the evening, Anjali spoils their plan. Later, Riddhima even tries to express her feelings for Armaan to Anjali, but fails. In the meantime, Shashank fears for Padma's life as she feels dizzy. Will Shashank reveal the truth to Anjali and Riddhima?

episodesList.title: Shashank Tells Dadi About Padma
episodesList.summary: While Shashank tells Dadi about Padma's health and his decision to tell the truth to his daughters, Armaan pretends to leave Sanjeevani to make Riddhima express her feelings. Just when she is about to express her love for him, Armaan and Riddhima get to know that Mini is in critical condition.

episodesList.title: Armaan Becomes Emotional
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Kirti get into an argument when she tells him that he is getting emotional about Mini's case. However, Shahshank intervenes and scolds Armaan for disrespecting his senior. Later, Armaan breaks down on seeing Mini's condition. Will Riddhima help him cope with this tragedy?

episodesList.title: Padma has Brain Tumour
episodesList.summary: After Mini gains consciousness, Armaan decides to bear her treatment expenses in London. Meanwhile, Shashank informs Padma about her tests and tells her that her treatment for brain tumour needs to start immediately. Will Padma's illness unite her with Anjali and Riddhima?

episodesList.title: Padma's Farewell
episodesList.summary: Padma resigns from her post and gives Shashank the reasons for doing so. As Shashank arranges for her treatment at Malhotra hospital, Riddhima organises a farewell dinner for Padma at her house. When will Riddhima learn the truth about her relationship with Padma?

episodesList.title: Sanjeevani Doctors Play Dandiya
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Riddhima spend some romantic moments in and out of the hospital. Later, the doctors of Sanjeevani visit Sapna's house on the occasion of dandiya. There too, Riddhima and Armaan share romantic moments as the guests dance to the dandiya beats.

episodesList.title: Anjali's Bet
episodesList.summary: While Anjali takes back her bet and asks Armaan to stop playing with Riddhima's heart, Riddhima overhears their conversation and leaves the place. Even though Armaan tries to talk to Riddhima and express his true feelings, she ignores him. Will he succeed in convincing her?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Slaps Armaan
episodesList.summary: While the doctor informs Shashank that Padma is in a critical condition, Armaan takes Atul's help in reaching out to Riddhima to clarify the misunderstanding. Armaan keeps trying, but fails. Finally, he gets into Riddhima's house, but she slaps him instead. Will her slap deter Armaan's intentions?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Ignores Armaan
episodesList.summary: Despite Armaan's efforts, Riddhima refuses to listen to him and asks him to leave her alone. However, Sanjeevani brings them together as they are to treat a patient, who has been shot by a bullet on his shoulder. Will personal differences affect their professional relationship?

episodesList.title: Armaan Fakes an Accident
episodesList.summary: Armaan seeks Riddhima's forgiveness by standing outside her house the entire night. Meanwhile, Padma's health deteriorates and Shashank takes her to another hospital. Later, Armaan meets with an accident. How will Riddhima react when she learns about his accident?

episodesList.title: Armaan Learns Shashank's Secret
episodesList.summary: Armaan succeeds in his ‘accident’ plan and becomes happy on seeing Riddhima's concern for him. As Armaan's condition improves, he gets shifted to the general ward. Meanwhile, Armaan overhears Shashank telling someone that Riddhima is not his daughter.

episodesList.title: Armaan Tries to Win Over Riddhima
episodesList.summary: After hearing Shashank's conversation and learning Riddhima's real identity, Armaan takes Atul's help in this matter and they agree to not disclose the truth to Riddhima. However, he is left hurt when he discovers that Riddhima is making fun of his feelings. How will Armaan win Riddhima back?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Riddhima Patch Up
episodesList.summary: Armaan takes a security personnel's help to spread the rumour that he has lost faith in his life and is going to commit suicide. Eventually, when Riddhima realizes that it was just a prank, she yells at Armaan. Despite their argument, they patch up and decide to stay friends.

episodesList.title: Armaan Confronts Shashank
episodesList.summary: Armaan is assigned an abortion case. He gets into an argument with the other doctors about whether to keep the baby or abort her pregnancy. While discussing the same with Shashank, Armaan accidently reveals that he is aware about Riddhima's birthmother. How will Shashank react to this?

episodesList.title: Anjali Catches Shashank's Lies
episodesList.summary: Anjali spots Shashank and asks him to meet her at Sanjeevani but he lies and tells her that he is out of town. Later, the doctors plan to go out for the night. However, on their way, Anjali spots Shashank's car. Will Anjali and Riddhima finally catch Shashank's lies?

episodesList.title: Armaan Rescues Shashank and Padma
episodesList.summary: Armaan comes to Shashank and Padma's rescue, when Anjali and Riddhima reach Padma's ward and find her with Shashank. Later, as Shashank thanks Armaan for controlling the situation, Anjali becomes suspicious and questions Shashank about Padma. Will Shashank tell Anjali the truth?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Confesses to Armaan
episodesList.summary: Riddhima finally confesses her love to Armaan. On the other hand, despite Anjali pestering Shashank about Padma, he refuses to divulge the truth. Later, while searching for some documents in Shashank's room, Anjali finds some adoption papers. Does she now know Shashank's secret?

episodesList.title: Anjali Confronts Shashank
episodesList.summary: Anjali realises that either she or Riddhima is adopted. To clarify the same, she calls Shashank, but he rudely refuses to talk. She confronts Dadi, but she also makes excuses and escapes from the situation. Later, Anjali eavesdrops on Dadi and Shashank's conversation. Will she get her answers?

episodesList.title: Anjali Assumes She is Adopted
episodesList.summary: While Shashank gets nervous that Anjali knows about the adoption, the latter reveals the truth to Riddhima. On hearing this, Riddhima rushes back home. Later, Armaan meets Riddhima and becomes shocked on learning that Anjali has wrongfully assumed herself as adopted.

episodesList.title: Shashank Breaks His Silence
episodesList.summary: After Armaan, Riddhima, Atul and Sapna celebrate Anjali's birthday at their house, Riddhima and Anjali confront Shashank about the adoption papers. Shashank gives in and tells them about Riddhima's adoption and her relationship with Padma. How will Riddhima take this news?

episodesList.title: Riddhima is Annoyed With Armaan
episodesList.summary: While Armaan tries to get through to Riddhima, Padma tells Shashank that she has full faith in him. Later, Riddhima scolds Armaan for not telling her the truth earlier and Shashank informs her about Padma's medical condition. Will Riddhima take care of her mother?

episodesList.title: Armaan Guides Riddhima
episodesList.summary: After Armaan guides Riddhima in the right direction, she reaches Gill's nursing home and convinces Shashank to operate on Padma, as he had refused earlier due to nervousness. However, the operation is successful, and Riddhima and Shashank are both relieved.

episodesList.title: Diwali Celebrations At Sanjeevani
episodesList.summary: While everyone at Sanjeevani is busy celebrating Diwali, Kirti suspects that Shubanker is having an affair with Sapna. She then assigns all the interns their duties and asks them to be extra careful as it is Diwali and there could be emergencies coming in.

episodesList.title: Kirti Blames The Doctors For Dadu
episodesList.summary: After Kirti delegates all the responsibilities, Anjali and Riddhima find out that one of their patients, Dadu, is losing his pulse. Later, Dadu suffers from a heart stroke and his health deteriorates. Kirti blames the doctors for his condition and warns that their negligence will not be overlooked.

episodesList.title: Who is Responsible?
episodesList.summary: As Armaan, Riddhima, Atul, Sapna and Anjali worry over Dadu's condition, Harsh wishes to meet Dadu. Later, Kirti finds out that the reason behind Dadu's present condition is use of propranolol. She asks Riddhima, Anjali, Sapna and Atul to explain themselves. Which intern gave Dadu this medicine?

episodesList.title: Dr. Kirti Blames Herself
episodesList.summary: Dr. Kirti wants to know who gave propranolol to Dadu while Dr. Armaan suspects Dr. Ridhima. Dr. Shashank demands a confession from the culprit. Dr. Kirti says that she will probe the matter and blames herself for what has happened. Who is the culprit?

episodesList.title: Ridhima Admits to Her Mistake
episodesList.summary: Dr. Kirti comes to know that it is Dr. Ridhima who had given propranolol to Dadu. She is furious and blames Dr. Ridhima for Dadu’s deteriorating health. Dr. Shashank is shocked by what has happened. Finally, Dr. Ridhima admits her mistake.

episodesList.title: Armaan Seeks Atul's Help
episodesList.summary: Atul is concerned for Ridhima and helps her prepare for her viva voce. Dr. Kirti assigns Armaan and Anjali to handle Dadu’s case. Atul and Sapna are assigned to take care of Harsh and Sumit. Meanwhile, Armaan is not convinced that Ridhima could have made a mistake and seeks Atul’s help.

episodesList.title: A Basketball Game
episodesList.summary: Armaan waits for Ridhima in the basketball court and challenges her in a match. Harsh worries about his Dadu and asks Armaan about Ridhima. Meanwhile, Dr. Kirti introduces Simran to the other doctors. Armaan, Atul and Sapna request Dr. Kirti to allow Nana to participate in their game.

episodesList.title: Kirti Advises Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan tries to talk to Ridhima about the Diwali night, but she is in no mood to talk about that incident. Kirti tells Armaan to take the help of a doctor. Meanwhile, the lab technician tells Armaan about propranolol.  Sumit expresses his grief to Ridhima.

episodesList.title: Preparations For The Skit
episodesList.summary: Kirti tells Deshpande not to take part in the skit because of his health but he refuses to listen to her. Later, Kirti tells Ridhima that she can only be backstage. Shashank takes Padma to Delhi to have a second opinion. All the interns prepare for the skit.

episodesList.title: Ridhima Explains to Armaan
episodesList.summary: Everyone, including Armaan, is concerned about Ridhima taking the blame for Anjali’s fault. Armaan asks Ridhima for an explanation. She tells him that Anjali made the mistake. Armaan wants to know why Ridhima is sacrificing her career for Anjali.

episodesList.title: Dr.subhankar's Daughter
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Ridhima, along with Atul, Anjali, Sapna, Simran and Nana, practise for their play. Sapna gets nervous in front of Dr. Subhanker and forgets her dialogues. Anjali is upset because Dr. Kirti gets the role of Soni. Meanwhile, Sapna is shocked to learn that Dr. Subhanker has a daughter.

episodesList.title: Ridhima's Viva Voce
episodesList.summary: Everyone conveys their best wishes to Ridhima. Kirti conducts Ridhima’s viva. Meanwhile Armaan, Anjali, Atul and Sapna make fun of Ridhima. But in spite of all odds Ridhima clears the test.

episodesList.title: The Doctors Stage a Play
episodesList.summary: All the doctors participate in a play. Sapna is chosen for Soni's role. During the play, Atul forgets his lines. Meanwhile, Armaan keeps staring at Riddhima, while Dr Shashank, Padma and Dadi enjoy the play. Will Riddhima and Armaan get closer?

episodesList.title: Shashank is Proud Of Riddhima
episodesList.summary: Shashank tells Riddhima that he is proud of her because she got over the bad phases in her career. Meanwhile, Atul and Anjali get stuck in the lift. Later, Kirti and Shubhankar have a friendly fight, while Armaan and Riddhima pull each other’s legs. What happens in the lift?

episodesList.title: Sapna Sees an Orphan Child
episodesList.summary: Kirti assigns each doctor to different wards. In the midst of her assignment, Sapna sees an orphan child and feels sad. Meanwhile, Kirti and Subhankar discuss their past. Later, Armaan asks everyone out for a cup of coffee. Will Riddhima accept the offer?

episodesList.title: Armaan Calls Riddhima and Lies
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Atul look after patients during their night duty. Armaan calls Riddhima and lies to her about an emergency. Riddhima rushes to the hospital to take care of the patients while Armaan sleeps. Later, Sapna talks about the orphan child to Shubhankar. Will Armaan's bluff be caught?

episodesList.title: Kirti Scolds Riddhima
episodesList.summary: Kirti scolds Riddhima for fighting with Armaan in the hospital and violating the rules of Sanjeevani. To get her revenge, Riddhima keeps Armaan's mobile phone ringer on. Later, during a meeting, Armaan's phone rings and Dr. Kirti gets infuriated. Will Armaan find out that Riddhima was behind it?

episodesList.title: Manjulika Slaps Armaan
episodesList.summary: Riddhima tries to put down Armaan in front of Kirti. She also manipulates Manjulika and makes her slap Armaan. Armaan pretends to be injured by the slap. Meanwhile, Atul thinks that Anjali is in love with him. Riddhima calls Armaan. What does she tell him?

episodesList.title: A Stranger Attacks Riddhima
episodesList.summary: Riddhima plays a prank on Armaan. Later, Riddhima is attacked by an unknown person. Meanwhile, Anjali and Atul ask their patient to quit smoking the hookah. Later, a patient flirts with Riddhima and that makes Armaan jealous. Who attacked Riddhima and why?

episodesList.title: Chaos At The Hospital
episodesList.summary: An unfortunate bus accident sends Sanjeevani into a tizzy. Kirti summons all the doctors to tend to the survivors of the accident. Armaan and Riddhima find themselves tending to patients in the same room. Will their fights have an adverse effect on the patients?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Atul Win The Match
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Atul challenge Riddhima, Anjali and Sapna to a Basketball match. The girls play well and take a lead but Armaan plays dirty and the boys win. As per the rules of the bet they placed, the boys demand Armaan's prize. What was the bet?

episodesList.title: Riddhima Accuses Armaan
episodesList.summary: Armaan doesn't kiss Riddhima as per the bet. Strangely, this disappoints Riddhima. Later, Armaan and Riddhima go out. Armaan loses his way and Riddhima accuses Armaan of trying to take advantage of her. This upsets Armaan and he tells Ridhima that he will stay away from her. Will he?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Riddhima Reach Lonavla
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Riddhima reach Lonavala to check on the kids in the orphanage. They take a liking to Armaan and later figure that there is a dispute between Armaan and Riddhima. Riddhima continues to be rude to Armaan, so he leaves her alone. Will she miss him?

title: Doli Saja Ke
summary: Babul Ki Bitiya Chali Doli Saja Ke is a Hindi language Indian soap opera that aired on Sahara One channel worldwide. The series premiered on 7 May 2007 and ended on 13 November 2009.

title: Dance Bangla Dance
summary:
Dance Bangla Dance is a Bengali reality show program, which airs in Zee Bangla. It was later remade in Hindi as Dance India Dance. It first started on 6 April 2007, following Dance India Dance by Mithun Chakraborty, who had been the show's host from the beginning.
This show has made national record in 2012 by Limca Book of Records for making 100 non-stop episodes in the sixth season.
According to a news article published in Anandabazar Patrika, Ananda Plus on 6 December 2013, the 2014 season would not be judged by Chakraborty. In December 2013, it was announced on fellow Zee Bangla show Dadagiri that Dev would be a judge on it in season 8. Other past judges have included Swastika Mukherjee and Ananya Chatterjee.

title: Durgesh Nandinii
summary: Durgesh Nandinii is an Indian television series that aired on Sony TV, which is loosely based on Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's novel Durgeshnandini, the first Bengali romance and the first ever novel in Bengali that was published in 1865.
plot: The story of Durgesh Nandinii represent two sides of Indian life – the modern, rich life on one side and the rural countryside life on the other. The story of this serial takes off when the millionaire industrialist Dharamadas Shrivstava dies and makes an unknowledgeable, parentless girl name Durgesh Nandinii, who lives a small countryside village (Lalgunj) the entire trustee of his property/business. After hearing the news that the father has given his entire business fortune to some stranger, the two sons and a daughter gets completely shocked. The whole family is greatly annoyed as Durgesh arrives in their bungalow with her family and cattle and sets up her own little village within their beautiful rich house. From hereon the story takes off.

title: Dhoom Machaao Dhoom
summary:
Dhoom Machaao Dhoom (transl. Rock Let's Rock) is an Indian musical sitcom that aired on Disney Channel India from 8 January 2007 to 10 January 2008, totaling 100 episodes. The story revolves around Priyanka Sethi and a band she forms with her three friends called the Pink Band. The show is one of the first Disney Channel India Original Series.
The show is notable for being the debut platform of many actors who later went to have a successful acting careers on television; Sriti Jha, Kinshuk Mahajan, Toral Rasputra, Maanvi Gagroo, Vikrant Massey and Jay Bhanushali.
plot:
Priyanka Sethi returns to Delhi from New York with her mother after her parents divorce and has trouble adjusting to her new school. Priyanka, who sings, composes and plays guitar, often spends time in her school's music room, where she befriends three unlikely people: Malini, who plays keyboards secretly due to her conservative father's opposition to music; Bikki, an extrovert Punjabi girl who plays tambourine; and Kajal, a hot-headed rebellious girl who plays drums. The four of them create a band of their own, called Pink Band and try to break stereotypes regarding music, bands and societal norms, and soon become celebrities popular with other girls.
The queen bee of the school, Koel, is jealous of them and frequently attempts to sabotage the band. Despite all odds, the band sticks together, and the story shows how they achieve international fame with their will and music.

title: Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan
wikiTitle: Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan
summary:
Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan (English: Prithviraj Chauhan, the Brave Warrior of the Land) is an Indian historical drama broadcast on StarPlus. It was produced by Sagars which is based on Prithviraj Raso, a Brajbhasha poem by Chand Bardai which portrays the life of Prithviraj Chauhan, a 12th-century Rajput emperor in India. Rajat Tokas played the younger Prithviraj Chauhan and Anas Rashid played adult Prithviraj Chauhan.
The series is considered one of the costliest ones produced at that time.
plot: The drama is based on Prithviraj Chauhan, a ruler of the Chauhan dynasty. Proficient in military skills, he took the throne of Ajmer at age 13 after his father died in battle. His maternal grandfather, Anangpal Tomar, ruler of Delhi, declared Prithviraj Chauhan his heir after discovering his courage and bravery. This antagonizes his cousin King Jaichand (Jaichand of Kannauj) who was expecting to be declared the heir. Chauhan falls in love with Sanyogita (Samyukta), the daughter of his enemy, Jaichand and elopes with her at her swayamvara ceremony.
reception:
During June 2006, it garnered its peak rating of 5.67 TVR.
In September 2006, then Vice President of India Bhairon Singh Shekhawat appreciated the channel and producers for the series.
Rajat Tokas received the best actor award in Indian Television Awards in 2007 for his lead role of Prithviraj Chauhan.

articleSections.title: Background
articleSections.text: The serial is based on the tales of the three most powerful ruling Rajput families of that time: those of Ajmer, Kannauj and Delhi. Roopsundari and Kamlavati are daughters of the King of Delhi, Anangpal I. Kamlavati is married to Someshwar Chauhan of Ajmer and Roopsundari to Vijaypal of Kannauj. Someshwar and Kamlavati are worried about not having an heir. They offer prayers and seek blessings from the God for a child. Someshwar thanks Vijaypal and Roopsundari for supporting them. Kamlavati suggests that Someshwar marry another woman so that the dynasty will have an heir, but he dismisses that suggestion. Finally, Someshwar is happy to know that Kamlavati will soon conceive, and proclaims it. After some time, Kamlavati and Someshwar pray to God and have a son they name Prithviraj Chauhan III. Prithvi is sent to Gurukul to study and gain martial skill. A brilliant student, Prithvi attends the Vansaj of Eklavya who can hit targets with a bow and arrow by merely hearing them which is also known as Shabd Bhedi Baan Vidya.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series was filmed at sets created in Sagar Sun City in Baroda with ₹4 and half crore spent for erecting the sets of palace which also consisted of a desert and a lake and with a budget of ₹20 crores .
In November 2008, the shootings and telecast of all the Hindi television series including this series and films were stalled on 8 November 2008 due to dispute by the technician workers of FWICE (Federation of Western India Cine Employees) for increasing the wages, better work conditions and more breaks between shootings. FWICE first took a strike on 1 October 2008 when they addressed their problems with the producers and production was stalled. A contract was signed after four days discussions and shooting were happening only for two hours content in a day then after which differences increased between them while channels gave them time until 30 October 2008 to sort it out. On 19 November 2008, the strike was called off after settling the disputes and the production resumed. The new episodes started to telecast from 1 December 2008.

title: Deal or No Deal
wikiTitle: Deal or No Deal (Indian game show)
summary:
Deal or No Deal is an Indian adaptation of the popular international Deal or No Deal format, which is owned and produced by Endemol International.
It premiered on 23 November 2005 on Sony Entertainment Television and aired on three nights each week. The first series had a set similar to the Spanish version, and the theme song and music cues were the same as those used in the Dutch version. Contestants held the boxes. The top prize is 10,000,000 rupees (about $142,000 USD), and the lowest prize is 25 paise (a paisa is the Indian counterpart to a cent/penny). The second lowest prize was originally 1 rupee, but was later changed to a Chlormint (an Indian breath refresher). It was hosted by Madhavan, but he quit after fulfilling his 35-episode contract, and was replaced by Mandira Bedi.
The second series premiered in late January 2006 and had a set virtually identical to the Australian version, except there were 22 briefcases. In this series, when the contestant picked a case, the contestant that held the case could guess the amount in it. If they guessed correctly, they would win Rs. 50,000.
After the second series, Mandira Bedi quit, citing time constraints as the reason for her departure. Therefore, the third season of the series, which premiered in April 2006, was presented by a new host, Rajeev Khandelwal, and aired once weekly. The third series features a new set and new graphics that are virtually identical to those used on the American version. Even though it was a lot similar to the US version, the third series did not have any games that carried over and did not show previous offers when it was time for the offer. Models were also introduced to hold the briefcases, instead of the contestants in series 1 and 2. In this series, once the host calls out the name of the contestant, he asks them a question with 2 possible answers. If they give the correct answer, they will get to play. At the end of most episodes of series 3, Rajeev ended by saying, "Keep Smiling!" This version ended in July 2006, as it was believed viewers couldn't connect with the concept.

title: Des Mein Niklla Hoga Chand
summary: Des Mein Niklla Hoga Chand is an Indian television series that aired on StarPlus. The show was initially directed and produced by Aruna Irani under AK Films and since late 2004 by Sunjoy Waddhwa's Sphere Origins until its end. It originally aired from 29 October 2001 to 28 March 2005.
plot:
The story is about the family of Pritam Singh, an NRI who settled in the United Kingdom. The show is largely centered on Preetam's granddaughter, Parminder (Sangeeta Ghosh), who holds traditional Indian values. The story takes off when Parminder meets Dev (Varun Badola) at her cousin's wedding in Chandigarh. They fall in love, but Pammi is already engaged to Dr. Rohan in London. They eventually get married, but alas happiness is not written in their destiny as Dev's ex-fiancé Anu marries Pammi's brother and has made it her task in taking revenge on Pammi by ending her and Dev's marriage.
This is a story of love, revenge and hate as the twists and turns in this story determine the fate of the lives of Pammi and Dev.

articleSections.title: Indian Telly Awards - winners
articleSections.text: In 2002 ** Best Costumes for a TV show - Ritu Deora *In 2003 ** Best Programme of the Year ** Weekly Serial of the Year Shared with Sanjivani ** Best Title Singer for a TV Show - Sukhwinder Singh ** Best Director of the Year - Aruna Irani ** Best Child Artist of the Year - Hansika Motwani *In 2004 ** Best Weekly Serial

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Based on the backdrop of Punjab, the series was produced and directed by Aruna Irani. It was shot extensively in United Kingdom and India. Some initial scenes were shot at Chandigarh.
When Varun Badola quit, Amar Upadhyay was cast for his role of Dev in May 2003.
In October 2003, the series had a crossover with Kasautii Zindagii Kay when both completed two years on the same day with the characters Bubbles Singh from the series and Tapur from Kasautii getting married.
Initially produced by Aruna Irani under AK Films, during October 2004, StarPlus transferred the production of the series to Sphere Origins owing Irani's poor health conditions then. However, as it did not improve, it ended on 28 March 2005.

articleSections.title: Critics and impact
articleSections.text:
In 2004 Outlook India quoted, "The soap has carried forward over the years in a compelling, realistic manner."
The series was criticized by the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee for portrayal of Sikhs and for non-baptized actors playing roles of baptized Sikhs.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
It became one of the top rated Hindi GEC soon after its premiere ranging between 9 and 13 TVR.
In the week 29 December 2002, to 4 January 2003, the series entered the top 10 watched television series after many months, which was earlier occupying positions 11 and 12, garnering 7.4 TVR and the following week, it occupied ninth position with 8.09 TVR. It had also beaten the top shows Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, Kahaani Ghar Ghar Ki and Kasautii Zindagii Kay to the top spot during early May 2003 garnering 10.9 TVR. The crossover episode between Des Mein and Kasautii during October 2003 garnered 14+ TVR.
However, during 2004, the ratings of the series started to decline and the series ended in 2005.

title: Dishayen
summary: Dishayen is an Indian television series produced by Time Magnetics and broadcast on DD National. The series premiered on 8 October 2001 and ended on 18 January 2005.
plot:
Neha and Nikita are twins. Nikita dreams about Bollywood stardom while Neha is the simpler one. Their father wants Nikita to marry Rajeev. In desperation, Nikita tells her twin that she will commit suicide unless Neha pretends to be her and marry Rajeev. After all, Nikita reasons, it is Neha who always wanted the quiet family life. On their wedding night, Neha admits to Rajeev that she is not Nikita. Rajeev knew about the substitution; he agreed because he wanted a wife like Neha. The sisters’ aunt learns about the switch and tells the bridegroom's mother Mrs. Gayatri. The angry mother-in-law makes Neha leave her house, but Neha slowly wins over her in-laws, except for her brother-in-law Sameer, the black sheep of the family.
A film producer gets Nikita drunk and takes semi-nude photos of her so that he can blackmail her. Nikita tells Neha about this, and they decide to do something, but instead suffer an accident. Nikita survives, but Neha goes missing. Neha's in-laws think Nikita has died, and Nikita realises that a way out of her problems is to impersonate Neha. Her plan works and she becomes well-adjusted to Neha's new family, except Sameer and the twins' cousin cause trouble for her, believing that she is Neha. Nikita slowly transforms into the dutiful wife Neha was and develops feelings for Rajeev. It is revealed that Neha survived the accident. As her memories return, she heads back to her marital home. She is kept unaware of the truth by Rajeev and Nikita.
Ex-convict Vishal is the love child of the twins' father, Sharma, and another woman. Vishal shows up one day to make his father pay for his sins. The twins' mother spurns Sharma, but the twins become accepting of their half-brother. Neha is distraught when she learns that Nikita is carrying Rajeev's baby, because Neha too is pregnant with Rajeev's child. Neha confronts Rajeev and asks him to divorce Nikita.
Meanwhile, Vishal becomes enemies with Sameer. The hostility escalates, until Sameer learns about the twins' pregnancies. He is upset, as he realises that he has a soft spot for Nikita. In a freak accident, Nikita loses her child. She sees that divorce from Rajeev is imminent, which makes her doubly sad. Strangely, her abortion brings her parents together and they accept Vishal as their son. Sameer, whose ego is bruised beyond repair, mends fences with Vishal and turns himself in to the police for his crimes. Neha, meanwhile, learns that Rajeev never served divorce papers to Nikita. She thinks that Rajeev's fidelity is wavering. Rajeev becomes upset because he is equally answerable to both the sisters. When Rajeev fails to serve Nikita the divorce papers, Neha gets angry and threatens to divorce him. Sameer sides with Neha and they both leave the house, but both suffer a brutal accident. The families go to see them. Sameer dies after apologising for his misdeeds. When Nikita and Rajeev go to see Neha, she has delivered twins. She hands the twins to Rajeev and Nikita, then dies.

title: Dollar Bahu
summary: Dollar Bahu (lit. 'Dollar daughter-in-law') is an Indian Hindi-language television series that aired on Zee TV channel in 2001. The series is based on a novel, Dollar Bahu by Sudha Murty. The story portrays the struggle of a middle-class family to graduate into an upper-class one through their son in the USA. Besides, as the title refers, the series was shot in both India as well as in the United States. In addition, when the serial's shooting began in the USA, the September 11 attacks occurred.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text: The story is about two daughters-in-law of a family, one from America and the other one from India. Now, how their mother-in-law treats them (Rupees and Dollar) is uncovered. The story is more of the mother-in-law who thinks that her American daughter-in-law (dollar bahu) is better than her counterpart in India, since she lives in the land of dreams, USA. Henceforth, she desires to live with her son in America. However, when she lives a year or so in America, she realises that the Indians living there face the same problems and challenges as those of living in India. Now she realise that "grass always looks greener on the other side". And when she comes back to India, she shows immense love to the first daughter in law whom she felt to be a trash and her grandson. Finally after getting a slap on feelings by her dollar bahu, Gouramma understands the fact that, may be dollar can remove the poverty from one's life. But family is much more important than that of dollars.

episodesList.title: Is Chachi Being Taken For Granted? (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: Chachi's mom enters the house and tries to create misunderstanding between Chachi and Suhasini. Chachi's mom feels that everyone in Diwan house is taking Chachi for granted.

episodesList.title: Chachi Invests In Fraud Company (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: Chachi's mom is insisting her to invest in shares to make big money. The share broker invests in a fraud company and Chachi loses her cash. How will Chachi's mom help her recover her loss?

episodesList.title: Chachi's First Novel For Printing
episodesList.summary: Sameer a.k.a Chachu decides to become Chachi's manager. Chachu is helping Chachi publish her first novel.

episodesList.title: An Unknown Kid Walks Inside
episodesList.summary: An unknown kid walks inside the Diwan house. Sunita a.k.a Chachi, out of her motherhood, takes care of the kid. Is this kid going to con chachi or he is innocent in his act?

episodesList.title: Mrs. Diwan Gets Caught By The Police
episodesList.summary: Mrs Diwan aka Badi Maa gets caught by the cop for breaking traffic rules. Will her Mahila Mandal election results get affected because of this police case?

episodesList.title: Mysterious Scented Pink Letter (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: A mysterious scented pink letter enters the Diwan house. Both the Nani's start doubting their son-in-law. How does this mystery resolve?

episodesList.title: Mysterious Scented Pink Letter (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: The mystery of unknown Pink scented letter continues. Suhasini and Sunita's mom spy on their respective sons-in-law. Will they find out for whom this mysterious pink letter was sent in Diwan house?

episodesList.title: Shortage Of Water Supply In Diwan Family
episodesList.summary: Less monsoon leads to shortage of water supply in the city. This causes huge trouble for members of Diwan family. How do the members of the Diwan family manage with less water?

episodesList.title: Chachi's Makeover To Win National Award
episodesList.summary: Sunita aka Chachi wins national award for her novel "Jhopada". Who is her inspiration behind her award winning novel?

episodesList.title: Who Dominates Whom?
episodesList.summary: Suhasini's friend influences Chachi and Suhasini to dominate their respective husbands. Both Chachi and Suhasini start throwing tantrums on their spouses. However, the husbands too are smart. Who dominates whom?

episodesList.title: Suhasini Worries About Her Weight
episodesList.summary: Suhasini worries about her weight and goes on strict diet. Will she lose weight and get Balraj's attention back? What is Suhasini new health regime?

episodesList.title: Chachi's Novel Haunts Her (Pt.1)
episodesList.summary: Sunita writes a novel which coincides with Sameer's encounter with local wrestler and don Tony. Watch how Chachi's novel haunts her and how Sameer deals with the don.

episodesList.title: Tony Don Lives In Diwan House (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: Chachu offers local don Tony stay in their Diwan house. This creates a lot of tension for Sunita. She is constantly under fear that Tony will cause harm to Chachu. Will he or won't he?

episodesList.title: Dadu Turns Poet
episodesList.summary: Badi mom goes out of town for few days to help homeless people. Since she is away Dadu starts missing her and turns in a Poet. How are Dadu's romantic poems?.

episodesList.title: Kareema Leaves Diwan House
episodesList.summary: Kareema decides to leave the Diwan house and fly to Dubai. He is upset because Balraj forgot to get him a gift from Delhi. However Diwans are trying hard to convince Kareema to stay. Will Kareema stay or leave?

episodesList.title: Vishal and Abha's Magic Pencil
episodesList.summary: Vishal and Abha barter their robot for a magic pencil. Will their wishes come true through the magic pencil?

episodesList.title: Kirti is Sanju and Sanju is Kirti (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: Sameer aka Chahcu hypnotizes Kirti and Sanju. He exchanges their personalities which upsets everyone in the house.

episodesList.title: Kirti is Sanju and Sanju is Kirti (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: Sanjay a.k.a Sanju becomes Kirti and Kirti becomes Sanjay. Sameer aka Chachu hypnotizes them and exchanges their personalities. How do they normalize?

episodesList.title: Chachi Suspects Sameer
episodesList.summary: Sunita doubts Sameer of having an affair and therefore, hires a detective. Will the detective confirm Chachi's doubt or will he prove her wrong?

episodesList.title: Here Comes Gareeba
episodesList.summary: After Kareema leaves for Dubai, Diwan's are facing big time trouble with house hold work. On a certain day when the ladies of the house refuse to cook food, Gareeba enters the house.

episodesList.title: A Thief and A Horror Film
episodesList.summary: The entire Diwan family is out leaving Vishal and Kareema at home. Vishal calls for a cartoon film However, he receives a horror film. At the same time a thief enters the house.

episodesList.title: Vishal Falls in Love
episodesList.summary: Vishal falls in love with his new classmate, Sheetal. Everyone in the family is helping Vishal in impressing his lady love. Is Vishal successful in his first love?

episodesList.title: Astrologer Sahil
episodesList.summary: Sahil chachu enters the Diwan house in disguise. He tries to fool the Diwan family by giving them chits. How does the family find out about chachu?

episodesList.title: Diwan Family Adds Spice to Couple's Life
episodesList.summary: Diwan family is helping an engaged couple in adding spice to their life. What is the mystery here?

episodesList.title: Shimla Trip Excuse
episodesList.summary: Suhasini and Balraj plan a vacation to Shimla for teh family hoping to stay back instead. Will their plans succeed?

episodesList.title: Four Tiwaris
episodesList.summary: Chachu has to handover 50,000 rupees to Tiwari but what happens when four of them turn up claiming to be Tiwari?

episodesList.title: Sanju Crashes Chachu's Car (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the household is helping Sanju make amends with Shilpa. However, Sanju has committed a bigger mistake.

episodesList.title: Sanju Asks for Forgiveness (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: Chachu is upset with Sanju for damaging his brand new car. Sanju handcuffs himself to Chachu for forgiveness but what will happen when potential business partners land up at the Diwan house?

episodesList.title: Dingu joins Diwan Family
episodesList.summary: Sanju's friend, Dingu, enters the house and ends up causing trouble in everyone's life. How will the Diwan family put his antics to better use?

episodesList.title: Priya's Unfair Tricks (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: Suhasini has a new competitor, Priya, who has opened her parlour right opposite her's. Suddenly, clients turn up unsatisfied and angry at Suhasini's house. Is this a coincidence or does Priya have some unfair tricks up her sleeve?

episodesList.title: Priya Uses Keerti against Suhasini (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: Priya is finally caught red-handed tampering with Suhasini's products. Does Priya have further plans for revenge?

episodesList.title: Fairness Lamp (Pt. 3)
episodesList.summary: Kirti finally sees the evil in Priya's ways. Sahil gets a fairness lamp from US that inadvertently turns Shilpa darker and confusion ensues!

episodesList.title: Bomb in Diwan House
episodesList.summary: Diwana get a bomb threat from a recently freed criminal who wants revenge on Durgadas Diwan. How will the family members avert this crisis?

episodesList.title: Balraj Snoring
episodesList.summary: Suhasini is unable to sleep at night because of Balraj's snoring but he refuses to admit that he snores. How will Suhasini, along with Chachu and Chachi convince Balraj?

episodesList.title: Gareeba in Love with Rohit
episodesList.summary: Gareeba dreams of marrying Kirti's NRI friend, Rohit while imagining all sorts of scenarios.

episodesList.title: Chhoti Nani Boss
episodesList.summary: Chhoti Nani declares herself in-charge while the adults are not there but it ruins plans for Sahil and kids. How will they teach her a lesson?

episodesList.title: Kid's Government in Diwan House
episodesList.summary: All four kids have financial demands from the elders. How will the elders teach them the value of money?

episodesList.title: Diwans Leave for London (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: Diwan family prepare to travel to London to attend Sarla dadi's grand-niece's wedding.

episodesList.title: Stay at Daisy Masi's Home (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: As the Diwans arrive in London, Daisy Masi is late to receive them at the airport. They land up at her house and find a stranger-- is there a thief at Daisy Masi's house?

episodesList.title: Madame Tussaud's and Shopping in London (Pt. 3)
episodesList.summary: Priya promises to take Sampat to London to find out Suhasini's cosmetics supplier. Meanwhile, Diwans bond with their relatives and go shopping.

episodesList.title: Priya and Sampat Reach London (Pt. 4)
episodesList.summary: Priya and Sampat arrive in London to visit the cosmetic supplier, only to realise that Sampat has forgotten the address at home. Angry and frustrated, Priya leaves him on his own in the middle of the city and keeps his passport with her.

episodesList.title: Balraj Loses his Way in London (Pt. 5)
episodesList.summary: Balraj, being as forgetful as he is, forgets the address of his friend's house he was supposed to visit. As he tries to find his way around the city, he accidentally lands up on a date with an Indian woman. What will happen when Suhasini spots them together?

episodesList.title: Wedding Ceremonies (Pt. 6)
episodesList.summary: The family continues to tour London. Priya is convincing her friend's fianceé to get a new haircut but turns out that the bride is from Diwan family. Sangeet celebrations are underway and everyone enjoys.

episodesList.title: Wedding Day (Pt. 7)
episodesList.summary: The family enjoys their last days in London, participating in the wedding festivities.

episodesList.title: London Stories: Sanju Flirting (Pt. 1)
episodesList.summary: The family comes back from London. Sahil, Dingu, and others trouble Shilpa with stories of Sanju's failed attempts at flirting in London.

episodesList.title: London Stories: Daisy's Creditor and Chachi Eve Teased (Pt. 2)
episodesList.summary: Everyone gathers around where Daisu and Chachi share stories about when they were chased by strangers in London!

episodesList.title: London Stories: Suhasini's Lookalike, Lily (Pt. 3)
episodesList.summary: Chachi's mother spots Suhasini entering a hotel in disguise and is shocked. As she goes to the Diwans for help, Sameer tells her about how Diwans met Lily in London.

episodesList.title: London Stories: Diwans Help Lily (Pt. 4)
episodesList.summary: Sameer narrates how they rescued Suhasini from Lily's brother and brought Lily back to India.

episodesList.title: 1 Year Anniversary Celebration
episodesList.summary: The cast along with producer, Jaya Bachchan and director, Anand Mahendroo celebrate 1 year of the show.

episodesList.title: Director Talks about Characters
episodesList.summary: Anand Mahendroo goes through the nuances of every character and the casting process while Sameer (Shekhar Suman) talks about filming each episode.

episodesList.title: Balraj's Employee: Vivek's Suspicious Wife
episodesList.summary: Vivek's wife shows up at the Diwan house asking for shelter from her cheating husband. Zubeida, a house help, also shows up to Diwan house asking for shelter after having been kicked off work. Vivek turns out to be Balraj's employee. How will this triangle fit?

episodesList.title: Balraj Fractures his Leg
episodesList.summary: Balraj hurts his leg in an accident while Suhasini has to go somewhere. She leaves everyone to take care of her husband but their plans leave Balraj with no one!

episodesList.title: Someone Breaks Balraj's Favourite Vase
episodesList.summary: Balraj receives a beautiful vase as an award at work. However, someone at home breaks it. Will Balraj discover who was the culprit?

episodesList.title: Shivani's First Love
episodesList.summary: Shivani, the Election Commisioner's daughter, comes to the Diwan house, looking for the "most handsome" boy she saw at the party the previous night. Everyone suspects it is Sahil. Will he marry Shivani?

episodesList.title: Chachi Goes Insane Without Somu
episodesList.summary: Chachi spends sleepless nights without Sameer. The kids suspect she has turned to drugs. How will the kids deal with this situation?

episodesList.title: Chef Keerti
episodesList.summary: Keerti has joined cooking class but the brothers are not impressed by her efforts

episodesList.title: Kareema's Personality Disorder
episodesList.summary: Kareema wants to get pretend-hit on the head so that he can pretend having a personality change and get out of housework. But what happens when he really gets hit on the head?

episodesList.title: Charming Madan Visits The Diwans
episodesList.summary: Suhasini and Balraj's college friend comes to visit and Balraj gets jealous when Suhasini starts paying him more attention.

episodesList.title: Sageer Deewana Jingle Writer
episodesList.summary: Kareema rediscovers his love for poetry and starts minting money. Can he juggle his poetry with work at the Diwan house?

episodesList.title: Dingu Tries To Impress His Girlfriend's Father
episodesList.summary: Dingu tries to impress his girlfriend's father by pretending to be a doctor. Will he succeed?

episodesList.title: Detective Chachi
episodesList.summary: Chachi, in Sameer's absence, turns detective after reading a crime thriller. The children try different ways to make her feel successful as a detective.

episodesList.title: Final Episode
episodesList.summary: The cast gather to say goodbye to the wonderful run of 'Dekh Bhai Dekh'.

title: Dasht
summary:
Dasht (Urdu: دشت, Dashh-th) (transl. Desert) is a 1993 Pakistani drama television series. It is a Balochi tribal love story directed by Abid Ali and F. H. Qureshi and written by Munnu Bhai. Noman Ijaz and Atiqa Odho acted in the lead roles alongside supporting cast of Ayub Khoso, Abid Ali, Noor Muhammad Lashari, Fazila Qazi, Naina, Asad Malik and Sabiha Khanum.
Dasht aired on 5 February 1993 on Pakistan's first private channel NTM, earning critical acclaim and was a major commercial success catapulting the onscreen pair of Odho and Ijaz to stardom. The audience appreciated their on-screen chemistry and the duo later worked together in several successful dramas including Nijaat (1993), Talaash (Telefilm 1994), Arzoo Jeenay Ki Tu Nahin (2014), and Khan (2017), and are often referred to as Pakistan television's most loved on-screen couple. The series was also the debut of Asad Malik's successful acting career.
The music was composed by Wajid Ali Nashad with the lyrics written by poet, critic, and playwright Atta Shad. The soundtracks of the series were also successful and popular. Odho's Balochi attire and jewelry and Ijaz's Balochi-style turban chaddar & Bughti Shalwar became a trend.  Shugal Pakistan ranks the series amongst the "11 Unforgettable Classic Dramas of Pakistan".
plot: The story is set among three warring tribes in rural Balochistan (in Pakistan). Born into this tribal warfare are Shahtaaj Atiqa Odho and Balaaj Noman Ejaz. Despite being surrounded by violence all their lives, both are gentle souls with a love of music and poetry. While both are from opposing tribes - they ultimately fall in love! Fearing that their union could unite two tribes, the head of the third tries everything to stop this from happening. The Drama was a tale of unrequited love and parental opposition while the culture, thinking, and issues of tribes in Balochistan served as sidelines of Shahtaaj's (Atiqa Odho) and Balaaj's (Nauman Ejaz) story of two youngsters from rival tribes who fall in love.. The plot was a modern-day take on classic tragic romance stories such as Layla and Majnun, Heer Ranjha, and Romeo and Juliet.
reception: In 1993, the onscreen pair of Atiqa Odho & Nauman Ejaz "shot into stardom" following the release of Dasht. According to critics "The drama which proudly displayed Baloch traditions, was memorable in terms of its dialogues, plot twists, superb acting, cinematography, and music." Dasht was Abid Ali's first self-produced and self-directed drama serial which became a hit project of its time and this happened to be the first-ever private production in Pakistan.

title: Doosra Keval
summary: Doosra Keval is a 1989 TV serial starring Shahrukh Khan, Arun Bali, Vineeta Malik, Natasha Rana, Rajendra Nath and Jayshree Arora.
plot: This is story of a family where Keval, a village lad, goes to town and never returns. The story is told through the memories of his mother, daughter and the villagers. At the end, Keval's (Shahrukh Khan) friend comes to his home and his family accepts him as the second Keval. This is considered as a reincarnation of Keval; hence, the name "Doosra Keval" (Hindi) or "The Second Keval".

title: Daaman
summary: Daaman (transl. Hem), set in the Muslim backdrop, is an Indian television drama series that aired on Sahara TV now as Sahara One in 2001. The series won 'Best Location Sound' category award at the RAPA Awards in 2002.
